Title: Technical Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

MRM Madrid is looking to expand its Data team with a Technical Data Analyst.

Key Responsibilities


Technical Support & Production Deployment: Work closely with the Advanced Analytics team to transform prototypes, scripts, and experimental models (notebooks) into automated, stable, efficient, and production-ready services.
Data Engineering & ETL/ELT: Design, optimize, and maintain robust data pipelines. Ensure data sources are properly structured, clean, and continuously available so analytical models can consume high-quality data.
Analytical & Business Insight: Actively participate in the analysis phase by understanding the analytical objectives of each project, performing exploratory data analysis, validating data quality, and ensuring technical outputs address specific business questions.
Robustness & Best Practices: Introduce software engineering standards into the analytics workflow, including version control, data testing, modular development, and technical documentation.
Model Monitoring: Support the monitoring of variables feeding deployed models to detect data drift and ensure long-term model performance.


Desired Technical Skills


Advanced proficiency in Python with a strong focus on data manipulation and optimization (Pandas, NumPy, production-ready scripting).
Expert-level SQL skills for querying, extracting, transforming, and modeling complex data in data warehouses.
Solid experience building and automating data ingestion and processing pipelines using ETL/ELT tools such as Airflow, dbt, or similar.
Familiarity with deployment workflows, APIs (FastAPI/Flask), containerized environments (Docker), and version control systems (Git).
Proven ability to analyze metrics, formulate hypotheses, and communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.


What We Offer


permanent contract
#Hybrid model
Flexible schedule
Training plans in our extensive training platform.
23 working days of vacation, plus 2 long weekends of your choice, plus 3 days at Easter, plus 3 days at Christmas.
The day of your birthday off!
Incorporation in a multinational company with high professional, economic and financial solvency that leads new, innovative and large-scale projects.


Who We Are

MRM is a modern relationship marketing agency that builds enduring brand relationships. MRM's core capabilities help grow relationship lifetime value and span across CRM & Loyalty, Customer Experience, Commerce and MarTech, underpinned by Data & Analytics. MRM operates in a borderless, integrated way to allow for greater collaboration and velocity. MRM is part of McCann Worldgroup and the Interpublic Group of companies (NYSE: IPG), and spans 35 offices across North America, Latin America, Europe, the Middle East, and Asia Pacific.

Title: Data Analyst (Finance)
Description:
About Revolut

People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 80+ million customers get more from their money every day.

As we continue our lightning-fast growth,‌ 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.

About The Role

Our Data Science team solves complex problems with smart, practical solutions. Data Analysts and Scientists work directly with product teams to uncover insights, guide decisions, and improve how customers experience Revolut. They do this by delivering smart, scalable solutions that move the business forward.

We’re looking for a Data Analyst who can dig into our complex databases, look for the root cause of a problem, and design their own solutions by writing code to implement them.

Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.

What You’ll Be Doing


Working on ETL processes
Creating and maintaining new aggregated views and tables to simplify data querying
Automating analytics, including P&L attribution, daily risk reporting, and short-term investments performance
Performing behavioural liquidity and cash flow analysis
Analysing ad-hoc performance enhancements
Undertaking model-based performance optimisation


What You'll Need


Experience in an analytical role supporting a markets-based business, or at a major financial institution, asset manager, or liquidity provider within a treasury or risk role (FTP, ALM, IRRB, etc.)
A bachelor's degree in a quantitative discipline
Impeccable data manipulation and analysis skills with Python and SQL
Evidence of solid mathematical and statistics knowledge
Fluency in English


Nice to have


An advanced degree in a STEM subject
To have participated in university Olympic medal competitions in physics, maths, economics, or programming


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.


Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.
Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.


We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

Exploración y explotación de datos mediante BigQuery y SQL.

GA4

Title: Data Security & Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
Desde Hays estamos colaborando con uno de los principales bancos de Europa en la búsqueda de un/a Data Security & Business Intelligence Analyst para incorporarse a su Hub de Ciberseguridad en Madrid.




Buscamos una persona con experiencia en Business Intelligence y análisis de datos, capaz de extraer, transformar y modelar información procedente de bases de datos SQL para la creación de dashboards e indicadores de seguridad que sirvan de apoyo a la toma de decisiones a nivel corporativo. El entorno tecnológico está centrado en la suite de Microsoft, especialmente Power BI y SQL Server.




Responsabilidades

Extracción, análisis y modelado de datos desde entornos SQL.
Desarrollo y mantenimiento de dashboards en Power BI.
Definición e implementación de KPIs y métricas de negocio.
Análisis de necesidades y evolución de soluciones BI existentes.
Coordinación con equipos técnicos, funcionales y stakeholders internacionales.
Elaboración de reporting y documentación asociada a las soluciones desplegadas.
Participación en iniciativas vinculadas al ámbito de la ciberseguridad.

Requisitos Imprescindibles

Experiencia trabajando con SQL.
Experiencia en Power BI.
Conocimientos de entornos Microsoft BI (SSIS, SSAS, SSRS será valorable).
Nivel de inglés alto (mínimo B2/C1). Trabajo diario en entorno internacional.
Capacidad para interactuar con diferentes áreas de negocio y tecnología.




Valorable

Experiencia en proyectos de ciberseguridad.
Conocimientos de Vulnerability Management o Patch Management.
Experiencia con herramientas como Qualys o Tanium.
Conocimientos de Python.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Incorporación a uno de los mayores grupos bancarios de Europa.
Participación en proyectos estratégicos dentro del Hub de Ciberseguridad.

Salario entre 32.000 € y 38.000 € brutos anuales + Retribución flexible
Modalidad híbrida: 1 día presencial a la semana en oficinas ubicadas en Arturo Soria (Madrid).
Entorno internacional y posibilidades de crecimiento profesional.




Si te interesa combinar análisis de datos, Business Intelligence y ciberseguridad en un entorno global, nos encantará conocerte.

Title: Analista de datos
Description:
En ALTEN tenemos claro que el éxito de nuestros proyectos se debe a las personas que forman nuestro equipo.

Por eso, si tienes experiencia como Analista de Datos / Analista Digital y te apasiona transformar datos en insights que impulsen la toma de decisiones, nos comprometemos a potenciar tu talento, satisfacer tus expectativas laborales y hacerte sentir como en casa. ¿Quieres construir hoy el mundo de mañana? ¡Sigue leyendo!




Formarás parte de un proyecto estratégico de analítica digital, enfocado en el análisis de tráfico, consumo y engagement de usuarios, colaborando con diferentes áreas de negocio para convertir los datos en conocimiento accionable y generar impacto real en la estrategia digital.




¿Cuáles serán tus funciones?

Dar apoyo al equipo en la elaboración y presentación en PowerPoint de los resultados obtenidos a través del análisis de datos de Google Analytics 4 (GA4).
Coordinar peticiones y solicitudes de análisis, manteniendo un inventario actualizado de las mismas y estimando los tiempos de entrega.
Colaborar en la documentación y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado completas (eventos, parámetros, conversiones y dimensiones personalizadas), garantizando la coherencia y escalabilidad de la medición.
Gestionar y explotar Google Analytics 4 (GA4) como principal herramienta de análisis mediante datos almacenados en BigQuery dentro de un entorno Data Proc.
Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener dashboards en Looker Studio orientados tanto a negocio como a perfiles no técnicos.
Validar la calidad del dato, identificando incidencias y asegurando su consistencia y trazabilidad.
Analizar datos para detectar tendencias, desviaciones e identificar oportunidades de mejora mediante insights accionables.
Trabajar de forma transversal con equipos de negocio, SEO y redacción para garantizar una medición y análisis adecuados de los resultados.
Elaborar informes y reportes de rendimiento de redes sociales.
Documentar procesos, metodologías y buenas prácticas del área de analítica digital.




¿Qué buscamos?

Experiencia demostrable presentando resultados e insights a clientes internos o externos mediante el análisis del consumo de sitios digitales con Google Analytics 4.
Experiencia en la creación, gestión y mantenimiento de guías de etiquetado avanzadas.
Conocimiento y experiencia en la implementación y uso de Looker Studio.
Conocimiento de BigQuery en entornos Data Proc (contando con el apoyo de equipos técnicos especializados).
Capacidad para transformar datos en información clara, útil y orientada a la toma de decisiones.
Experiencia trabajando con KPIs y métricas enfocadas a objetivos de negocio.
Dominio de Excel y PowerPoint.
Capacidad de trabajo en equipo y excelentes habilidades de comunicación.
Alta capacidad analítica, pensamiento crítico y atención al detalle.




Modalidad: Híbrido en Madrid.




¿Quiénes somos?

Somos un equipo. Formamos parte de ALTEN, una multinacional europea especializada en proporcionar servicios de consultoría, tecnología de la información y servicios de ingeniería a las principales compañías del mercado español.

Si te gustan las cifras, te diremos que en España contamos con una facturación de 217 millones de euros, 9 sedes y un equipo formado por más de 5.240 profesionales.

Además, en ALTEN nos enorgullecemos de ofrecer igualdad de oportunidades con independencia de género, edad, diversidad de capacidades o país de origen. Nuestro compromiso está con el talento y con las personas que lo tienen.

Si crees que eres talento, ¡apúntate! 🚀

Buenas habilidades de comunicación para presentar resultados de forma clara.
Persona dinámica, proactiva y con ganas de aprender, que disfrute trabajando en equipo y tenga iniciativa para aportar.

Experiencia con herramientas como Salesforce, BigQuery, Tableau, Looker Studio o Google Analytics.
Formación en ADE, Economía, Estadística, Matemáticas, Ingeniería, Data Analytics o similares.

Title: Data Analyst - RDT Workforce Enablement
Description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.

The Position

Data Analyst - RDT Workforce Enablement

Roche Digital Technology (RDT) is where innovation meets purpose. As a global team at the heart of Roche, we are a community of business-minded technologists committed to help shape tomorrow’s digital future of healthcare. Our mission is to power Roche through cutting-edge digital technologies, harnessing the potential of artificial intelligence, data, and scalable tech innovations. Driven by purpose and passion, we’re building a future where digital is a core strength across all of Roche, enabling smarter ways of working, unlocking human potential, and driving breakthroughs that truly matter for millions of patients around the world.

At Roche, we offer a hybrid work model that combines flexibility with in-person collaboration. For now, we require our employees to be in our offices on average two days per week. The specific office days may vary depending on business needs, such as workshops, conferences, town halls, team meetings, and other collaborative events.

Data Analyst - Data Products & Insights Team in Workforce Enablement - is responsible for leading, translating business challenges into analytical problems, and delivering data-driven insights and actionable recommendations to stakeholders. This role involves independently conducting comprehensive data analysis, preparing detailed reports, and presenting findings to various business units to inform strategic and operational decisions. In this role, you will act as a key liaison between business units and data engineering teams, ensuring that data structures, analytical logic, and business definitions are documented, clearly understood, and leveraged for maximum strategic impact.

The opportunity:


Scope / (Content Leadership): Leads data analysis projects and delivers high-value insights. Works independently on specific projects from inception to completion
Accountability/Problem Solving: Solves complex business problems using data. Validates insights and ensures their accuracy with no supervision required
Stakeholder Management: Manages direct communication with key business stakeholders regarding analytical findings. Engages proactively with broader business units to thoroughly understand their data needs.Facilitates discovery workshops with stakeholders to capture business rules, define key performance indicators (KPIs), and translate them into technical specifications for implementation.
Impact/Strategy: Drives medium- to large-sized projects that directly influence business decisions. Ensures that analysis projects are closely aligned with broader business strategy and goals. Documents As-Is and To-Be data flows and business processes, ensuring clear traceability between business decisions, reporting outputs, and underlying data sources.
Complexity / (Product Size): Handles more complex datasets and multifaceted analysis tasks.
Business / Technical ability: Applies strong analytical skills and the ability to communicate complex insights effectively. Demonstrates proficiency in advanced data analysis techniques


Who you are:

Education / Experience

Demonstrated experience independently conducting comprehensive data analysis
Proven track record of translating business challenges into analytical problems and delivering actionable, data-driven recommendations
Experience acting as a standalone role between data teams and business functions, ensuring insights inform strategic and operational decisions



Technical Skills

Strong expertise in advanced data analysis techniques and handling more complex datasets
Ability to independently validate insights and ensure high data accuracy
Proficient in utilizing data visualization tools to develop compelling visualizations and comprehensive dashboards



Additional Qualifications

Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to manage direct communication with key business stakeholders and present findings to various business units
Strong analytical mindset with a focus on ensuring complex insights are understood by non-technical audiences and leveraged for maximum impact


What you get:

Salary range 14,175 - 26,325 PLN gross based on the employment contract.


Annual bonus payment based on your performance
Dedicated training budget (training, certifications, conferences, diversified career paths etc.)
Recharge Fridays (2 Fridays off per quarter available)
Take time Program (up to 3 months of leave to use for any purpose)
Vacation subsidy available
Flex Location (possibility to perform our work from different places in the world for a certain period of time)
Take Time for Charity (additional paid leave of maximum 2 weeks to engage in the charity action of your choice)
Private healthcare (LuxMed packages), group life insurance (UNUM) and Multisport
Stock share purchase additions
Yearly sales of company laptops and cars and many more!


Apply directly and join us in shaping the future of healthcare.

If you feel this offer suits a friend of yours, feel free to share it.

Want to know what it’s like to be a part of Roche IT first-hand? Check out our blog!

Compensation & Benefits
The expected salary range for this position, based on the primary location of Warsaw Grafit is 170,100.00 PLN - 315,900.00 PLN. Final compensation will be determined by a number of factors, including your skills, experience, qualifications, and location. In addition to base pay, this role may be eligible for a discretionary annual bonus with a target of 15% subject to both individual and company performance.

This position also offers an attractive benefits package.

A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.

Let’s build a healthier future, together.

Title: OPEX BI Analyst/ Continuous Improvement Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a motivated and analytical Business Intelligence & LMS Analyst to join our European team. This role combines data analytics, reporting, business process improvement, and Learning Management System (LMS) support.

The successful candidate will help develop scalable reporting solutions, provide business insights through data analysis, support LMS administration and reporting activities, and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives across multiple European countries.

This is an excellent opportunity for a junior to mid-level professional who enjoys working with data, technology, and cross-functional teams in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities



Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and KPI monitoring tools.
Analyze operational, productivity, and business performance data to support decision-making.
Manage and improve reporting solutions used across multiple European countries.
Work with large datasets using Excel, SQL, and other analytical tools.
Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and reporting quality.
Support LMS administration activities, including user management, reporting, and data analysis.
Assist with content management and system maintenance activities.
Monitor LMS performance metrics and produce relevant reports.
Support end-user adoption and training initiatives.
Contribute to continuous improvement projects and business process optimization initiatives.
Assist in documenting processes, creating training materials, and supporting knowledge transfer activities.
Support the deployment and adoption of scalable digital solutions across Europe.
Collaborate with stakeholders from Operations, IT, HR, and Operational Excellence teams to identify improvement opportunities and deliver solutions.



Required Qualifications & Skills



Experience with Power BI, including data modelling, dashboard development, and KPI reporting.
Advanced Microsoft Excel skills and experience working with large datasets.
Basic knowledge of SQL and database structures.
Knowledge and practical understanding of Artificial Intelligence tools and their application in business environments.
Experience with or knowledge of LMS, including user administration, content management, and reporting.
Ability to document processes and create user-friendly training materials.
Professional Competencies
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Excellent attention to detail and data accuracy.
Proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Ability to work independently and collaboratively in an international environment.
Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.



Language Requirements



Fluent English (essential), both written and spoken.
Additional European languages are considered an advantage.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (f/m/d)
Description:
Workload 80 - 100%

The role is designed to:


Support early-stage ideation initiatives and existing product teams.
Generate insights from usage data and customer behavior.
Focus on exploratory analysis, identifying meaningful product and usage metrics.
Develop indicators for evidence-based product decisions.
Collaborate closely with product and engineering teams to ensure actionable insights.



What will you do


Analyze usage data and customer behavior to generate insights during early‑stage ideation
Support discovery and experimentation with exploratory analyses and rapid insights
Define and evolve product and usage metrics that indicate success and value
Work closely with product managers to translate questions and hypotheses into analyses
Advise engineering teams on where and how data should be collected within applications
Automate relevant metrics and analyses as products mature
Take analytical ownership for products emerging from ideation initiatives
Stay current with modern analytics techniques and AI‑enabled analytical approaches



What You Bring & Who You Are


Strong experience in data analysis, analytics, or a similar hands‑on role
Excellent analytical thinking and ability to turn data into clear insights
Proficiency with common analytics tools and languages (e.g. Python, SQL, BI tools)
Experience working with product, usage, or behavioral data
Proven interest in AI‑enabled products and modern analytical approaches
Curiosity and motivation to continuously learn and experiment
Comfortable working in early‑stage, exploratory environments
Strong communication skills with technical and non‑technical stakeholders

Senior Data Analyst - Regulatory Reporting

Location: Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Regulatory reporting team and we are seeking a Senior Analyst Intern to join our Regulatory Reporting domain!

Our data mission is to support Ebury’s regulatory compliance by ensuring accurate and timely submission of all required reports to our stakeholders and auditors.

The Data team works closely with Finance, Compliance and Product to coordinate and automate reporting in multiple jurisdictions. We partner with MLROs and Regulatory Reporting specialists to translate official technical requirements into robust data models, validations, and automated deliveries. Work closely with other Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Compliance Officers, and the Regulatory Reporting team.
Be responsible for modelling data in our platform to build critical regulatory and compliance reports.
Manage the reporting processes: requirements gathering, building optimised data models, performing validation checks, and delivering compliant files to regulators.
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using BI tools (Looker / Looker Studio) for stakeholders and internal auditors.
Contribute to the automation and enhancement of our regulatory reporting processes to ensure compliance and accuracy.


What we’re looking for


4-6 years Experience in Data/Business Analytics – applied to Finance or Compliance is a plus.
Advanced SQL skills – able to read and write queries across complex datasets.
Experience with our modern data stack tools: dbt, Google Cloud BigQuery, Looker, Sigma, Git.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail.
Experience working with Python.
Previous exposure to Regulatory or Financial Reporting.
Knowledge of Financial Services or Capital Markets (Payments, FX, Treasury, Accounts) is desirable but not mandatory.
Ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Fluency in English (Spanish, a plus)


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions
Private health insurance, gympass.
Support to progress your career in the Data & Analytics world
Work in a collaborative environment and contribute to a new data infrastructure built on a modern data stack
23 days of annual leave plus your birthday off and all the Madrid public holidays.
Fun in-person off-sites and virtual get-togethers
Personal development including language courses

Title: Mid Product Data Analyst
Description:
Your mission


We're looking for a Mid Product Data Analyst to join our Players tribe. You will own the analytics for a product domain end-to-end: from governing the tracking that captures user behaviour, to running the analyses that shape what gets built next. You will partner closely with product managers, engineers, and designers to make sure every key decision is grounded in data, not intuition.


What you'll be doing



Design and implement event tracking to capture user interactions and behaviour within your product domain.


Govern tracking quality in your domain: validate that events are firing correctly, maintain the Gold Standard event set, and keep tracking debt under control.


Use AI tools (Claude, Cursor) to accelerate your analytical work; validate AI-assisted output for accuracy and business context before it influences decisions.


Analyze user funnel drop-offs to identify root causes of friction and lost conversions.


Evaluate A/B test results to assess the impact of product changes, and make sound recommendations even when results are inconclusive.


Build and maintain dashboards to track product performance and KPIs across your domain.


Work closely with data engineers and analytics engineers to co-create reliable data products and pipelines.


Run structured analyses across multiple data sources to surface trends and product opportunities.


Collaborate with product managers, engineers, and designers to embed data in every product decision.


Translate insights into clear, actionable recommendations for product improvement and feature development.



Our ideal player



Bachelor's degree in Mathematics, Data Science, Statistics, Economics, or Computer Science, or related fields.


Minimum 2 years of experience in data analytics or a similar role, ideally with more than 1 year in product analytics.


Strong SQL knowledge and experience working with relational databases.


Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or Power BI.


Understanding of experimentation (A/B Testing, Multivariate Testing).


Familiarity with event-based analytics tools like Mixpanel or Amplitude.


Basic understanding of machine learning and data engineering concepts.


Basic knowledge of programming languages like Python or R.


Good communication and presentation skills, and the ability to work independently and as part of a cross-functional team.



Extra points



Experience using AI tools (Claude, Cursor, ChatGPT, or similar) in a data or analytics workflow, including building prototypes.


Experience in a marketplace.


Cloud data warehouse experience (Google BigQuery, AWS Redshift, or similar).


Knowledge of dbt or other data pipeline tools.


Experience with predictive modeling (Forecasting, MMM, Neural Networks).


Based in Madrid or Barcelona, Spain.



Our hiring process



People Interview — First contact and cultural fit at Playtomic.


Technical Interview — With our Product Analytics Manager.


Stakeholders Interview — With a PM and Head of Data.


Final Cultural Interview — With our Product Lead.





About PLAYTOMIC




We are the world's largest racket sports App for players and clubs. Our goal is to socialize sports practice: through the app, players can book courts, find other players with similar skill levels, and join a social community dedicated to playing.




Since 2017, Playtomic has earned the trust of national and international investors, consolidating it as one of the main world players in sports digitalization. You will find +150 co-workers around the world with headquarters in Spain and offices in Madrid, Italy, Portugal, Sweden, Finland, Belgium, the UK, EEUU, and Mexico.




Take a look at our candidate playbook!

Title: Senior Product Analyst
Description:
Are you looking to have an impact on the daily life of millions of entrepreneurs in France (and tomorrow in Europe)?

Are you looking for a work environment that values trust, proactivity, and autonomy?

Then Pennylane is the right place for you !

Our vision

We aim to become the most beloved financial Operating System of French SMEs and Accounting Firms (and soon, European ones).

We help entrepreneurs rid themselves of time-consuming tasks related to accounting and finance while providing them with access to key financial information to assist in making the best decisions for their business.

About Us

Pennylane is one of the fastest growing Fintechs in France (and soon to be in Europe!)

In 5 years of existence, we’ve managed to :

💻 Make ourselves known as a groundbreaking accounting and financial software for small businesses and their accountants

💰 Raise a total of €400 millions, including from Sequoia, the famous fund from the Silicon Valley who invested early in companies like Google, Facebook, Airbnb, Stripe, Paypal and much more...

👨‍👩‍👧‍👦 Grow from 7 cofounders to 1000 happy Pennylaners : we’re now recognized as one of the greatest places to work in France (and also remotely), with a 4.6/5 rating on Glassdoor.

🌍 Build an international environment with more than 25 nationalities, with a strong remote-friendly culture, where 30% of the employees are already working from all parts of Europe

🤝 Earn the trust of thousands of customers and accounting firms and obtain outstanding ratings

🚀 Already more than 1 300,000 small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) and over 6000 accounting firms use Pennylane in France!

WHY this position is of utmost importance to reach our mission

At Pennylane, every decision that is not backed by data is likely to be challenged (when data is available of course). This culture is embraced by the leadership team, and actively promoted everywhere. The role of the data team is to make this possible by treating data like a production asset, making it available company-wide, and using it proactively to improve Pennylane’s user experience.

By joining us as a Senior Product Analyst, you will have a pivotal role in helping Product teams understand how users behave in our product, identify the most important opportunities, and turn those insights into roadmap decisions.

HOW You Will Contribute To The Company

As a Senior Product Analyst, you will be part of the Science & Analytics team focused on Product topics (6+ people), inside the Data department (40+ people).


You will help Product teams deeply understand user behaviors across Pennylane’s frontend experiences, using tools such as Amplitude and our data warehouse to identify adoption patterns, friction points, opportunities, and risks.
You will turn behavioral data into clear, strategic insights that help Product leaders decide what to build, improve, simplify, or stop.
You will be a real sparring partner for Product leaders, feeding their strategy by anticipating the most important questions, framing the right analyses, and translating findings into product roadmap recommendations.
You will contribute to developing a stronger product measurement mindset across Product, Design, Engineering, and Data: helping teams define success metrics, clarify what needs to be measured, and think about measurement earlier in the product development process.
You will partner with the relevant owners on tracking and implementation when needed, ensuring measurement choices remain pragmatic, actionable, and connected to product decisions.
You will contribute to our self‑service approach to analytics by understanding Product partners’ needs and promoting a data‑driven culture. You will contribute directly to data models in the data warehouse (using dbt) used by Product teams.


WHAT You Can Expect From Your Life At Pennylane

Within one month:


You will learn everything about our company, our teams, and our vision during the first onboarding week.
You will get familiar with our stack, and have delivered a few small projects which will give you a concrete taste of our tools & processes.
You will be given time to meet your future stakeholders, and gain a deep knowledge of the Product area you support.


Within 3 months:


You will be fully in charge of supporting a Product area, prioritizing your topics with its decision makers and helping them connect user behavior insights to roadmap choices.
You will be confortable with our technical stack (Python, Redshift, DBT).
You will contribute to larger cross-company projects.


Within 6 months:


You will proactively contribute to the Product area’s roadmap by surfacing strategic opportunities from behavioral analyses.
You will work with Product, Engineering and Data practitioners to improve how we measure product success.
You will share your learnings and best practices within the team.


And beyond: the data team will continue growing with the company

Which means:


Opportunities to recruit and mentor new team members,
Increased accountability in project leadership,
Responsibilities to design and implement new processes, tools and best practices to make sure that your team works even more efficiently.


Who are we looking for?

You’re the right candidate if you:


Have had previous experiences as Product Analyst or Data Analyst working closely with Product teams, ideally in scale-up environments (5-6 years)
Are seasoned working with SQL, DBT and data visualization tools, and have strong experience with product analytics tools such as Amplitude or similar event-based analytics platforms
Are comfortable collaborating with Product Managers and Designers, as well as engineering partners, beyond the data team
You have a strong product and business acumen, and are seen as a trusted partner by your business stakeholders
Are able to connect user behavior, product usage and business impact into clear strategic recommendations
Have strong communication skills and are capable of articulating your ideas clearly
Are Fluent in English - French is a plus


What does the recruitment process look like?


A first interview with our Talent Acquisition Manager
A case study interview to discuss a topic closely related to one of our priorities (60 min)
A past project interview to hear about your experience (60 min)
An interview with our Tech & Product leaders to discuss our company culture (45 min)


What do we do to make your work life easier

🌴 Wherever you are based, you will get 25 vacations days paid by Pennylane

💵 You’ll have a competitive compensation package

📈 You'll get company shares to enjoy a piece of the success story you're building with us

🏡 You’ll have a budget to turn your home into a more comfortable workspace, as well as a monthly allowance to work from a coworking space whenever you feel like it

⛹️ Through our partner Gymlib, you’ll have access to 8000 fitness spaces in Europe and more than 300 activities related to wellness

💻 You’ll get the latest Apple equipment

🏢 Depending on the teams and the requirements of the position - you'll be able to work remotely from your country of residence, as long as it is in Europe and within a maximum time difference of two hours from the CET time zone

🎉 We are committed to regularly coming together for company events such as Tech Days (which bring remote Pennylaners together every 3 months) or our annual company seminar, fostering significant moments of cohesion for everyone.

If you are based in France, you will have a French contract following French regulation on top of the additional perks : 6 to 12 RTT, 5 weeks PTOs, lunch credits (Swile), Alan Blue healthcare cover and regular events in cities where Pennylaners are mostly presents (Lyon, Bordeaux, Nantes…)

We're working on providing those last advantages to our people based outside of France as well, but it can be quite more complex depending on different countries.

Who are we looking for ?

To thrive at Pennylane, you need :


To speak English (level is assessed and appreciated according to the department you’re applying to)
To be energized by an ever-shifting work environment
To be highly collaborative (within your team or other stakeholders)
Sufficiently experienced to prioritize business-led actions on your day to day activity


We know that some people are less likely to apply than others, if they don’t feel like they meet the full list of criteria.

If you’re hesitating, we encourage you to apply : who knows, it might be the start of a meaningful and long-lasting collaboration.

Important information for candidates

Recruitment scam attempts are on the rise. We invite you to remain vigilant during your exchanges.

Applications through official channels only : apply exclusively through our job postings published on our official platforms (career site, official partner pages).

Always verify the sender's email address: our communications are sent from professional email addresses with the domains @pennylane.com or @pennylane-partners.com

We will never ask you for payment or financial information

(bank details, payment for an interview, equipment purchases, etc.) as part of the recruitment process. If such a request is made to you, it is fraudulent. We invite you to not respond and to report it to us immediately.

We also want to emphasize that we fully embrace diversity, equity and inclusion and that we’re doing our best to create a safe and inclusive environment.

We are committed to providing an equal employment opportunity regardless of gender, sexual orientation, origin, disabilities, or any other traits that make you who you are. If anything, diversity makes us a more fun place to work at.

🇫🇷 Données personnelles

Pennylane traite vos données pour gérer votre candidature et évaluer votre adéquation au poste. Si votre candidature n’aboutit pas, vos données peuvent être conservées 2 ans à compter de notre dernier échange ou de la clôture du recrutement afin de constituer & gérer un vivier de candidats. Vous pouvez vous opposer à tout moment et demander la suppression de vos données en écrivant à : dpo@pennylane.com.

Notre data policy

🇬🇧 Personal Data

Pennylane processes your data to manage your application and assess your suitability for the position. If your application is unsuccessful, your data may be retained for 2 years from our last exchange or the closing of the recruitment process, in order to build and manage a candidate pool. You may object at any time and request the deletion of your data by writing to dpo@pennylane.com. Learn more

🇩🇪 Personenbezogene Daten

Pennylane verarbeitet Ihre Daten, um Ihre Bewerbung zu bearbeiten und Ihre Eignung für die Stelle zu beurteilen. Sollte Ihre Bewerbung nicht erfolgreich sein, können Ihre Daten bis zu 2 Jahre ab unserem letzten Austausch oder dem Abschluss des Rekrutierungsverfahrens gespeichert werden, um einen Kandidatenpool aufzubauen und zu verwalten. Sie können jederzeit Widerspruch einlegen und die Löschung Ihrer Daten beantragen, indem Sie an dpo@pennylane.com schreiben. Mehr erfahren

🇪🇸 Datos personales

Pennylane trata sus datos para gestionar su candidatura y evaluar su idoneidad para el puesto. En caso de que su candidatura no sea seleccionada, sus datos podrán conservarse hasta 2 años a partir de nuestro último contacto o de la finalización del proceso de selección, con el fin de constituir y gestionar una reserva de candidatos. Puede oponerse en cualquier momento y solicitar la eliminación de sus datos escribiendo a dpo@pennylane.com. Más información

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Tus tareas

El equipo de Asesoria AVM forma parte de la unidad de Inteligencia Inmobiliaria de Accumin Intelligence y es el responsable del desarrollo, mantenimiento y entrega de modelos automáticos de valoración (AVM) bajo el marco normativo vigente en España, principalmente de la Orden ECO 805/2003 y la regulación del Banco de España aplicable a entidades tasadoras homologadas.




El departamento trabaja en estrecha colaboración con entidades financieras, fondos y servicers, proporcionando valoraciones masivas de activos inmobiliarios con los estándares de calidad, trazabilidad y documentación exigidos por el regulador. La apertura de este proceso responde a la necesidad de reforzar el equipo con un perfil senior que contribuya al análisis y mejora continua de los modelos, la validación de datos y la elaboración análisis de las valoraciones, en un contexto de crecimiento de la demanda por parte de nuestros clientes y de expansión de las capacidades del área. Además que contribuya al crecimiento del equipo tanto en España como internacional, ampliando capacidades y clientes.




Tu perfil




¿En qué consistirán sus tareas principales?

Gestión, apoyo y supervisión al equipo de asesoría de carteras y AVM consistente en 6 personas.
Análisis y revisión de resultados de valoración inmobiliaria AVM. Participación en el diseño, calibración y actualización de modelos estadísticos para la valoración automática masiva de activos inmobiliarios (residencial, terciario, suelo).
Análisis y control de calidad del dato. Exploración, limpieza y validación de bases de datos inmobiliarias (testigos de mercado, registros públicos, datos internos), identificando inconsistencias, outliers y gaps que puedan afectar a la representatividad y fiabilidad de los modelos.
Monitorización y estudio del error de los modelos. Seguimiento periódico de las métricas de desempeño de los modelos en producción (MAPE, mediana de error, ratio hit rate, etc.), detección de desviaciones y elaboración de propuestas de mejora.
Elaboración de análisis de mercado y resultados de valoración de carteras. Redacción de dossieres de modelo, fichas metodológicas, informes de validación y registros de cambios.
Automatización de procesos. Desarrollo de scripts y flujos de trabajo en Python y/o SQL para la automatización de cargas de datos, ejecución de modelos y generación de informes de calidad, contribuyendo a la puesta en producción de los procesos del área.
Análisis ad-hoc para clientes. Soporte en la elaboración de estudios y análisis específicos requeridos por entidades financieras, fondos o servicers, incluyendo segmentaciones de cartera, análisis de mercado local y comparativas de valor.
Reporting e interpretación de resultados. Preparación de presentaciones y reportes que trasladen de forma clara los outputs de los modelos y los análisis realizados, tanto para uso interno como para interlocutores externos no técnicos.




¿Qué esperamos de tí?

Titulación de Grado en Economía, ADE, Ingeniería o Matemáticas.
Valorable otros cursos relacionados con este ámbito.
Experiencia profesional mínima de 3 años en puesto similar.
Conocimiento del mercado de carteras NPL
Nivel básico de Python, y nivel avanzado de Excel y PPT.
Valorable el uso de herramientas de visualización de datos.
Inglés C1 y español C2.




¿Qué tipo de persona buscamos?

Buscamos a una persona con alta capacidad analítica y de razonamiento.
Que sea planificada y organizada.
Capaz de adaptarse a cambios, adoptando una actitud flexible.
Tenga gran capacidad comunicativa.
Orientada a la calidad en su trabajo y mucha iniciativa.




¿Por qué nosotros?

Contrato indefinido.
Incorporación inmediata.
Trabajo en equipo que permite estar en continuo aprendizaje.
Modalidad de teletrabajo híbrida al 40%, que permanecerá vigente mientras la empresa no decida modificarlo de manera general, en base a la productividad de la Compañía.
Horario flexible de 9:00 a 19:00 de lunes a viernes.
Servicio de menú diario incluido.
Compromiso a fomentar un entorno inclusivo donde todas las personas puedan desarrollarse y alcanzar su máximo potencial, porque creemos en la igualdad de oportunidades

Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Company Description

With over 25 years’ experience, plus the same enormous passion and ambition we had on day-one, we’re trailblazers in the pet e-commerce industry. Our solutions make over 12 million customers genuinely happier – and that’s something we really care about. We work together to continually adapt; embracing change and the challenges it brings so that we can keep doing better. Join us and discover a place where your potential meets your passion for pets. That’s the power of plus.

Job Description

Trabajo en equipo

Proactividad en la búsqueda de nuevas soluciones y mejoras

Title: Customer Strategy Analyst - Santander Insurance
Description:
Country: Spain

IT STARTS HERE




Santander (www.santander.com) is evolving from a global, high-impact brand into a technology-driven organization, and our people are at the heart of this journey. Together, we are driving a customer-centric transformation that values bold thinking, innovation, and the courage to challenge what’s possible.




This is more than a strategic shift. It’s a chance for driven professionals to grow, learn, and make a real difference.




Our mission is to contribute to help more people and businesses prosper. We embrace a strong risk culture and all our professionals at all levels are expected to take a proactive and responsible approach toward risk management.




The Wealth Management & Insurance division covers three businesses in all Santander Group countries: Insurance, Asset Management and Private Banking. We work to provide the best solutions to our clients in these three businesses in the 10 countries where we are present.




THE DIFFERENCE YOU MAKE




Santander Insurance is looking for a Customer Strategy Analyst based out of Madrid.




The role will develop a deep understanding of key customer performance indicators to support value creation and strategic decision-making. Reporting to the Customer 360 & AI Director within the Customer Strategy & AI team.




As a customer strategy analyst your mission will be to build and maintain a robust and scalable analytical framework to monitor, understand and drive customer strategy performance across global and local markets. The role will support data-driven decision making by providing actionable insights on key customer KPIs, identifying performance drivers, and assessing the business impact of strategic initiatives.




We’re shaping the way we work through innovation, cutting-edge technology, collaboration and the freedom to explore new ideas. To succeed in this role, you will be responsible for:




1. Customer Analytics Framework

Develop and maintain a robust analytical environment to monitor customer performance across geographies, ensuring consistency between global and local views.
Define and standardize KPIs, metrics and analytical methodologies to ensure comparability and alignment across countries.
Design and enhance reporting tools and dashboards to provide clear visibility on customer performance.




2. KPI Monitoring & Performance Tracking

Track and analyze the evolution of key customer KPIs, including:
Customer lifetime Value
Net Promoter Score (NPS)
Customer churn
Customer base evolution
Product holding (e.g., insurance policies per customer)
Identify trends, deviations vs. targets and early warning signals.
Provide regular performance updates to key stakeholders and senior management.




3. Deep-Dive Analysis & Insights Generation

Conduct in-depth analyses to identify key drivers of performance, improvement levers and potential risks to achieving budget and strategic targets.
Segment customers and behaviors to uncover actionable insights.
Support hypothesis generation and validation using data.




4. Business Impact Assessment

Analyze and quantify the impact of strategic initiatives (e.g., commercial actions, retention strategies, cross-selling initiatives) on customer KPIs and business outcomes.
Develop frameworks to measure ROI and effectiveness of initiatives.
Support prioritization of initiatives based on data-driven insights.




5. Stakeholder Management & Collaboration

Work closely with business, data and local teams to ensure alignment on definitions, analyses and insights.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear and actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders.
Support decision-making processes at both global and local levels.




WHAT YOU’LL BRING




Our people are our greatest strength. Every individual contributes unique perspectives that make us stronger as a team and as an organization. We’re enabling teams to go beyond by valuing who they are and empowering what they bring.




The following requirements represent the knowledge, skills, and abilities essential for success in this role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.







Professional Experience

At least 5 years of professional experience in the insurance industry, preferably in roles related to analytics and performance tracking.
Proven experience in data analysis, KPI monitoring and business performance management.
Experience working with large and complex datasets across multiple sources.
Artificial intelligence application on task and process automation, data analytics and innovation. (Preferred)




Education

Bachelor’s degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Finance, Engineering, Business Administration, or a related field.




Languages

Very high proficiency in English and Spanish are required.
Portuguese is desirable (Preferred)




Hard Skills

Proficiency in SQL and Excel for data extraction and analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau) to build dashboards and reports.
Familiarity with data models, data structures and analytical frameworks is a plus. (Preferred)




Soft Skills

Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to translate data into actionable insights.
Ability to connect data analysis with business impact and decision-making.
Strong communication skills, with the ability to convey complex insights to non-technical stakeholders.







WE VALUE YOUR IMPACT




Your contribution matters, and it’s recognized. You can expect a fair, competitive reward package that reflects the impact you create and the value you deliver. But we know rewards go beyond numbers.

We’re enable our teams to go beyond through global opportunities and broad career paths.
Flexibility that works. Enjoy a hybrid working models—some days remote, some days onsite with your team—along with flexible hours.
Learning for life. Access hundreds of courses on our platforms, including exclusive access to our global learning space: Santander Open Academy (www.santanderopenacademy.com)
Competitive rewards. Receive a highly competitive salary with performance-based bonuses, motivating you to keep growing with us.
Financial advantages. Benefit from preferential banking terms, special interest rates on loans, life insurance, and more.
Your health is our priority. Through BeHealthy, our global wellness programme, we promote Holistic wellbeing.
We know family is everything. That’s why we offer childcare support and family-friendly programmes tailored to each life stage.
Always by your side. Get access to Santander Contigo, our program for employees and their families offering legal, emotional, and administrative advisory services.
Extra benefits. Gym/WellHub membership, medical centers in some of our facilities, meal subsidy, parking, shuttle service from various points in Madrid, as well as exclusive discounts and offers for Santander employees. And that’s only the beginning—we’ll tell you more when you join!




We’re here to keep you motivated, help you reach your goals, and celebrate your progress, every step of the way.




LOCAL COMPLIANCE




Santander is proud of being an organization where there are equal opportunities regardless of age, gender, disability, civil status, race, religion or sexual orientation. We are committed to providing an inclusive and accessible application process for all candidates.




WHAT TO DO NEXT




If this sounds like a role you are interested in, then please apply.

READY TO TAKE THE NEXT STEP IN YOUR JOURNEY?

Collaborate with stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver data-driven insights

Support data warehousing and data integration across multiple sources

Title: Senior Digital Analytics
Description:
Desde Adsearch IT & Digital buscamos incorporar un/a Senior Digital Analytics para una consultora especializada en Data, Analytics, AdTech y Marketing Digital, con proyectos estables y de alto nivel técnico.




Buscamos un perfil con experiencia real en dashboarding, integración y análisis de datos, capaz de trabajar de forma autónoma con diferentes fuentes y herramientas y de convertir datos complejos en información accionable para cliente.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Formarás parte de un equipo especializado en Data & Analytics, participando en proyectos para diferentes clientes y sectores.




Tus principales responsabilidades serán:

Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards avanzados, principalmente en Looker Studio.
Integrar y cruzar datos procedentes de diferentes fuentes y plataformas: Google Ads, Meta, GA4, CRM, redes sociales, etc.
Preparar, transformar y homogeneizar datos para su posterior explotación y visualización.
Trabajar con BigQuery/SQL y herramientas de extracción e integración como Supermetrics, Funnel.io u otras soluciones ETL.
Elaborar reporting de campañas y análisis de rendimiento, definiendo y haciendo seguimiento de KPIs como CPA, ROAS, CTR, conversiones, inversión, etc.
Analizar datos de negocio, comportamiento de usuario y funnels, identificando insights y oportunidades de mejora.
Participar en proyectos de medición digital, configuración y revisión de GA4/GTM y definición de necesidades de tracking.
Tener contacto directo con cliente, entendiendo sus necesidades y trasladándolas a soluciones de datos y reporting.




¿Qué buscamos?

4+ años de experiencia en Data Analytics, Digital Analytics, Marketing Analytics o posiciones similares.
Experiencia sólida y demostrable en dashboarding, especialmente con Looker Studio / Data Studio.
Experiencia integrando y cruzando múltiples fuentes de datos.
Buen conocimiento de BigQuery y SQL para transformación y explotación de datos.
Experiencia con herramientas como Supermetrics, Funnel.io o similares.
Conocimientos de GA4 y Google Tag Manager.
Experiencia con datos de Google Ads y campañas digitales.
Capacidad para entender KPIs de marketing y convertirlos en análisis y reporting de negocio.
Experiencia trabajando con clientes y diferentes proyectos simultáneamente.
Capacidad de autonomía, priorización y resolución de problemas técnicos.




Será un plus:

Experiencia con Power BI.
Experiencia en entornos de agencia o consultoría.
Haber trabajado con diferentes sectores y modelos de negocio.
Experiencia coordinando o dando soporte técnico a otros perfiles.
Experiencia asumiendo responsabilidades de Team Lead.




¿Qué buscamos realmente?

Más allá del conocimiento de herramientas, buscamos una persona hands-on y con profundidad técnica, que no se limite a conectar una fuente y construir un dashboard, sino que entienda de dónde vienen los datos, cómo integrarlos, transformarlos y estructurarlos correctamente y cómo convertirlos posteriormente en análisis útiles para el negocio.




Si te interesa un proyecto donde trabajar con data, marketing digital, clientes y proyectos de diferentes sectores, nos encantará conocerte.




¿Te interesa?

Inscríbete en la oferta y envíanos tu CV.

Liaise with our data science team, updating and improving reports
Build and foster relationships within the commercial community

Present findings to key stakeholders

Title: (Senior) Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Barcelona
Description:
Location: Come and join us in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona!

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our operational squads. In this role you will be able to become an expert in our business and data analysis systems and environment to allow you to champion data-driven decisions as part of the Data Operations team.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Focus on analysing and presenting recommendations/process changes/new initiatives to management using insights derived from data.
Use your technical skills such as actively engaging in configuration and programming in the data environment, querying data via SQL from the data lake, automating data processes, deep dive analysis in Python and adjusting ETL tasks.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
Develop monitoring tools to measure performance and help the business achieve its objectives.
Create queries to answer operational and business questions across our many operational teams to support decisions.
Communicate results in a clear and impactful manner.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


Educated to Degree Level or higher in an analytical discipline such as Engineering, Computer Science or Economics
5+ years of experience in an analytical role
You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Curiosity about AI and its practical applications in analytics, experience using LLMs or AI-powered tools in a data context
Excellent technical skills including SQL knowledge, familiarity with visualisation tools (Metabase in particular is a plus) and python/R
Enthusiastic, outgoing and personable - you have the ability to think on your feet, work independently and also proactively with others to find solutions to issues
You understand how to engage and influence decision makers and have excellent communication skills
Driven - you are motivated to find solutions to problems and constantly go the extra mile
Strong communication and interpersonal skills as well as excellent written and spoken English


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

ABOUT US:

Freenow by Lyft empowers smarter mobility decisions, helping people to move freely and cities to thrive. Through our multi-mobility app, we feature broad options for everyone across 9 European markets and over 180 cities. Millions of passengers can access services including taxis, private hire vehicles, carsharing, car rental, e-scooters, e-bikes, e-mopeds, and public transport within a single app.

In July 2025 Freenow was acquired by Lyft, a global mobility platform, which connects riders and drivers for billions of rides across North America and Europe. Together, Freenow and Lyft are creating a more caring and connected world, with transportation for everyone. We are a global, diverse, highly motivated, and collaborative team that strives for excellence and likes to have fun. Ready for your next ride?

Title: Senior Data Analyst – Performance Analytics & AI
Description:
As Senior Data Analyst – Performance Analytics & AI, you will play a key role in transforming data into actionable business insights and supporting data-driven decision-making at executive level. The role will initially report to the Head of Group Performance Improvement and is expected to transition into Omya Services & Solutions over time.

Key Responsibilities


Translate SAP and enterprise data into reliable, structured, and decision-ready management insights.
Interpretate performance data, including profitability drivers, margin leakage, cost structures and value improvement opportunities.
Build and maintain analytical models and dashboards to support Group Performance Improvement priorities.
Translate analytical outputs into financially sound conclusions and value improvement actions.
Enable KPI and value realization tracking by developing the technical reporting logic, visualization layer, and data refresh processes.
Apply AI-enabled tools to improve the speed, quality, and scalability of performance analytics and digital capabilities.
Engage with Finance and Business teams to connect data insights to business realities and conversion into measurable value creation.


Key Requirements


University degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Analytics, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field.

Hands-on experience with SAP and enterprise reporting environments, combined with strong agility in applying AI-enabled tools.
Strong expertise in data visualization and business intelligence tools such as Power BI, SAP Analytics Cloud, or similar platforms.
Ability to work independently while managing multiple priorities in a dynamic and fast-paced international environment.
Collaborative mindset, proactive listening skills, curiosity, and solid business acumen.


What do we offer?


Hybrid Work Model: Flexibility to work from home and in the office according to company policy, promoting a healthy work-life balance.
Ticket Restaurant: Daily meal allowance to support your well-being.
Flexible retribution: Kindergarten & Transport benefits.
30 Labor Days of Holidays per year: Ample time off to relax and recharge.
Language Lessons: Access to language lessons to support personal and professional growth.
Medical Insurance: 60% company-subsidized medical insurance for employees, with the option to extend coverage to family members at a competitive rate.
Open and Modern Office Environment: Work in a collaborative, innovative, and comfortable space designed for your success.

As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We are now looking for a Data Analyst for Finance to join our team in Barcelona (hybrid). The Finance Data Analytics team has been transformative during the last two years by helping our stakeholders succeed in their mission. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Join the world's leading travel subscription platform
