Over 1700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities - 99% permanent contracts - 36.3 average age



We're the world’s leading travel subscription platform. We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription program, which has topped over 7.7 million members since launching in 2017. Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalized service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. As a Finance Data Analyst you will be in charge of:


Responsible for execution of key analysis, being the data entry point for the business team and including taking ownership of the different data sources from the business side. Understand the business needs, gather the data and present the key insights: “Contribute to the Finance strategic roadmap with numbers”
Elaborate business cases to support strategic decisions
Create dashboards and tracking: master the internal Business Intelligence tools to contribute to the monitoring and tracking of our business KPIs. Work with data engineering and data science teams to be able to leverage all our internal data
Contribute to the delivery of Finance strategic projects: participate in the delivery of the key internal projects, giving support from the business side to ensure progress and effective delivery of the desired outcomes.



what do you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
2-4 years experience in a role with strong analytical component
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement,
Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc)
Strong analytical skills, fast-learner, with high attention to detail and focused on results and productivity
Business Proficiency in English and fluent in Spanish
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Looker Studio),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management (as Google Cloud Platform),
SAP knowledge.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



and what's in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and the possibility of choosing your equipment and, even better, keeping it for free after 3 years.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, paddle tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

If you’re excited about this role but you do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Title: Junior Data Analyst
Description:
1. Propósito del Puesto (Misión)

Garantizar la explotación estratégica de la información y la evolución del entorno de datos en Netquest, identificando oportunidades de mejora, desarrollando herramientas analíticas y siendo una pieza técnica clave para la toma de decisiones basadas en datos.




2. Responsabilidades Principales

Interpretar datos e indicadores clave de rendimiento (KPI) para ayudar a la empresa a maximizar el valor de la información.
Colaborar con diferentes áreas de negocio para definir y priorizar necesidades de información.
Proporcionar soluciones de informes y herramientas de BI para partes interesadas internas y externas.
Desarrollar y mantener cuadros de mando (dashboards) en herramientas de BI (ej. Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau).
Manipular datos y realizar análisis ad-hoc utilizando Python y consultas avanzadas en SQL.
Identificar, analizar e interpretar patrones y tendencias en grandes volúmenes de datos (millones de registros).
Monitorizar fuentes de datos y colaborar con Data Engineers para resolver inconsistencias y garantizar las políticas de calidad.
Trabajar de manera colaborativa dentro del área de Datos con Data Scientists, Data Engineers y otros analistas.




3. Relaciones Clave (Interfaces)

Internas: Equipo de Datos (Data Science, Data Engineering, Data Analytics) y responsables de diversas áreas de negocio.
Externas: Clientes y colaboradores externos receptores de herramientas de análisis o informes ad-hoc.




4. Requisitos del Perfil

Formación y Experiencia:
Educación: Grado Universitario en Ingeniería, Estadística, Matemáticas, Economía, Informática o campo cuantitativo similar.
Experiencia: Mínimo 2 años de experiencia previa desempeñando funciones como Data Analyst.
Conocimientos Técnicos e Idiomas:
Dominio de Python (librerías como pandas, polars, numpy, matplotlib, ggplot, seaborn).
Sólidos conocimientos y optimización en SQL.
Experiencia en herramientas de Business Intelligence (Apache Superset, QlikSense, Tableau, PowerBI).
Idiomas: Fluidez en inglés (comunicación verbal y escrita clara).
Valorables: Experiencia en servicios Cloud (especialmente AWS) y herramientas de gestión de datos como dbt.
Competencias Y Habilidades:
Excelente pensamiento analítico y capacidad para la resolución de problemas.
Habilidades de storytelling para comunicar hallazgos complejos de forma sencilla.
Trabajo en equipo, adaptabilidad y enfoque orientado a la calidad de los datos.




5. Qué Ofrecemos

Ubicación: Barcelona
Modelo de trabajo: Híbrido (2 días en la oficina y 3 días de teletrabajo)
Beneficios sociales:
Contrato indefinido.
Seguro médico privado con cuadro médico o reembolso (50% cubierto para el empleado).
Plan de retribución flexible: vales de comida (tickets restaurante), transporte y guardería.
Horario flexible (entrada de 8:00 a 10:00, salida de 17:00 a 19:00) y viernes de jornada intensiva.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup transforming the industry — from enhancing guest experiences to driving business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners, including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, and Google Travel, Guesty empowers property managers to deliver exceptional guest experiences while running efficient, data-driven operations.

Today, we're proud to have 800+ team members across 16 countries, all working together to shape the future of hospitality technology.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Marketing organization. This role will partner closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, develop scalable reporting, analyze campaign performance, and help optimize marketing strategies through data. The ideal candidate has strong SQL expertise, experience with BI tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Marketing team.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Analyze marketing performance across Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email, paid search, paid social, and organic channels.
Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs, including ROI, ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, conversion rate, marketing spend, and campaign performance.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Partner with Marketing, Product, and Business teams to support strategic decision-making.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting accuracy across dashboards and reports.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and scalable analytics solutions.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Analyst.
Expert-level SQL skills with experience writing complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, query optimization, and data transformation). This is a core requirement.
Strong experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and business metrics.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong English communication skills.


Highly Preferred


Experience as a Marketing Data Analyst within a SaaS, IT, software, or technology company.
Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing metrics, including: ROI, ROAS, Attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), Marketing Spend, Conversion Rate
Experience supporting B2B SaaS marketing teams.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is an advantage.
Experience with AI tools or analytics automation is a plus.


Join us and discover a workplace where career growth, collaboration, and enjoyment can all exist together.

﻿

We provide equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, age, national origin, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other protected characteristic under applicable law.

About The Role

We are looking for a switched‑on Data Analyst to manage and evolve our reporting pipelines, analytics and automation workflows across European digital transformation unit supporting sales and marketing programs.

This role goes beyond traditional reporting. It combines designing, building, and maintaining end-to-end data pipelines ensuring high‑quality, standardized and scalable reporting for the business.

This role has a strong focus on reporting ownership, automation and data quality, while working closely with business stakeholders and technology teams to ensure data is translated into reliable insight and effective decision‑making.

Apply if


You think you are good match for most of the requirements in the job description.
You are a team player, and you enjoy working in a multicultural team.
You approach business and technical issues with flexibility and rigor.
You are comfortable owning reporting end‑to‑end, including recurring deliverables, data validation, fixing issues, and improving existing dashboards - not just designing new ones.
You like having clear ownership and accountability rather than jumping between loosely defined initiatives.
You are comfortable working close to the business, translating requests into concrete analytical solutions, even when requirements are incomplete at first.
You can work independently, manage priorities, and take responsibility for outcomes, not just tasks.
You see automation, standardization and scalability as core parts of your professional identity, not as side work.
You are curious about experimenting with emerging AI capabilities in analytics environments.


Key Responsibilities

Reporting and Analytics foundations


End‑to‑end ownership of reporting frameworks and data pipelines
Enabling consistent, decision‑ready reporting across the European business through automated reporting and ad-hoc analysis.
Ensure a high level of data quality, consistency and reliability across all reports.
Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting infrastructure and metrics definitions.


Automation and process improvement


Identify opportunities to streamline, automate and optimize analytics and data processes.
Design, execute and continuously improve scalable and automated reporting and analytics solutions.
Define and document data pipelines, dependencies and sources.
Coordinate with IT and Data Platform teams on the implementation of automation and enhancements.
Support sustainable and well‑governed processes rather than ad‑hoc solutions.


Business Partnership & Enablement


Work closely with business stakeholders translate business objectives into clear analytical requirements and reporting specifications.
Support digital transformation initiatives by providing trusted data and analytics foundations.


Reporting & Analysis


Support insight generation related to customer behavior and business performance, in collaboration with advanced analytics or specialist teams where relevant.
Own the end-to-end lifecycle of dashboards and reporting
Perform structured and ad‑hoc analysis to support business questions and priorities.


AI-Enhanced Analytics


Explore opportunities to leverage Generative AI to, automate reporting narratives and insights generation, improve data, accelerate development of data pipelines.


Required Experience

Experience, skills & profile


Proven experience in a Business Data Analyst, BI Analyst or Analytics role.
Proven ability to collaborate with Data Engineers and Data Analysts to build infrastructure.
ELT mindset and familiar with dbt concepts.
Comfortable with Python for data processing, scripting and automation.
Experience working with Cloud Data Warehouse (ideally Snowflake)
Advanced SQL skills (Data modeling basics, complex joins and transformations, query optimization)
Hands‑on experience creating and maintaining reports and dashboards using Power BI and DAX.


Personal attributes


Comfortable owning analytics deliverables end‑to‑end.
Able to drive clarity in ambiguous situations.
Comfortable working in a multicultural, cross‑functional environment as a team player
Professional written and spoken English is required.
EU citizenship or valid work permit required.


Working Conditions


Hybrid work model: 2 days in the office and 3 days remote per week.

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Data Analyst

Groupe SEB, reconocida como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar en España - GREAT PLACE TO WORK 2022 & 2024 - es la compañía líder mundial en su sector.




Rowenta, Tefal, Moulinex, Krups, Lagostina, WMF, Emsa... son algunas de las 30 marcas que pertenecen a Groupe SEB y que son parte de la vida diaria de millones de consumidores en más de 150 países. Buscamos un/a Data Analyst formando parte del equipo de ventas online en el departamento Comercial. La persona estará ubicada en nuestras oficinas centrales en Poblenou (Barcelona) y reportará al E-Commerce Activation y al equipo online de Key Accounts.




Funciones




Tu misión será extraer datos, crear dashboards y transformar estos datos en insights accionables, contribuyendo a optimizar el rendimiento de nuestras principales cuentas online.




Dashboards, Análisis y seguimiento de KPIs: Preparación, análisis y seguimiento de indicadores cualitativos y cuantitativos relacionados con la actividad online.
Creación y mantenimiento del Dashboard comercial de Amazon.
Compartir con los equipos EU5 la evolución de la cuenta de Amazon.
Configuración y elaboración de informes mediante herramientas destinadas a monitorizar contenidos.
Manejo de otras herramientas relacionadas con las ventas online.

Formación Universitaria: Ade, Economía, Marketing, Ingeniería, Matemáticas o similares.
Se valorará una titulación adicional relacionada con el eCommerce.
Experiencia previa de mínimo 2 años como Data Analyst. Preferiblemente en una compañía multinacional en el sector de Mass Distribution/Retail/Farmacéutico.
Nivel alto de Excel.
Conocimientos de Qlik Sense, Power BI, Pacvue.
Capacidad para transformar datos en conclusiones relevantes para el negocio
Nivel alto de inglés: B2.2/C1.




Qué ofrecemos?




Teletrabajo dos días a la semana.
Horario flexible (jornada completa): de lunes a jueves de 8h o 9h a 17:35h o 18:35h con 1h para comer; viernes de 8h o 9h a 14h o 15h.
Jornada intensiva desde el 22 de junio hasta el 6 de septiembre de 8h a 15h.
Salario: salario base + variable + ticket restaurante + ayuda teletrabajo
Beneficios sociales: tarjeta Cobee, seguro médico, plan de pensiones, día de cumpleaños libre, descuento en nuestros productos y en otras firmas, office con víveres, fruta en la oficina,...

Dechra is one of the fastest-growing and most consistently successful global veterinary companies. Our size enables us to maintain a personal approach, remain flexible and respond quickly to change, allowing us to make decisions with agility.

At the same time, we are a strong and well-established company, with the product portfolio and technical capabilities needed to provide our customers with the support they need.

OUR PEOPLE

Are solution oriented and pro-active
Love working together
Have a 'can do' mentality
Are easy to approach
Value honesty
Are professional
Are able to punch above their weight
Have the desire to win
Have fun

YOU WILL FIT IN

If you have strong analytic and problem-solving skills
If you are able to understand the business and deliver based on a strong commercial focus
If you are self-motivated and highly organized
If you are responsive and flexible to change
If you are cooperative and have the desire to make a difference together
If you are structured and independent

TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a key role at Dechra in Iberia as the company is growing fast and data analysis is gaining importance to support business decisions and improvements.

The Data Analyst is ultimately responsible for making available and clear all data necessary to contribute to translate the strategy and plans into clear reports by using relevant data. The tasks and responsabilities include:

Analysis of sell in and sell out data across all the business areas.
Management of the source master data (customer and product) ensuring the reliability and veracity of data.
Validating development requests from the business allowingreports improvement and upgrades.
Management of the CRM data and reports (maintenance and update).
Preparation of periodic and ad hoc reports to analyse comercial stategies.
Collection and consolidation of data from different sources (mainly Excel and SQL Server).
Process documentation.
Involvement in budgeting and forecasting process.
Evaluation and process of the data to facilitate the decision taking from sales, marketing and business managers.
Develop strong internal relationship with the sales team to understand the market and support them.
Ensure the connection between CRM and marketing.
Providing user support services to ensure problems are remediated quickly and effectively.
Providing training (Targit, Salesforce, BI software) for new users and new functionality for existing users.

SKILLS & KNOWLEDGE

This job might be for you when you have:

A higher education or degree within the area of Computer science, Economics, Finance, or related bachelor degree.
Experience of Business Intelligence systems.
Ideally a minimum of 2/3 years' experience in a similar position.
Basic programming skills for data manipulation.
Ability to develop key and beneficial relationships with stakeholders.
Excellent commercial networking approach to enable the growth of the business.
Ability to structure and organize effectively and deliver to tight deadlines.
Excellent interpersonal and communication skills, written and verbal.
Natural leadership skills to lead high performing teams.
High level of Excel use.
Knowlegde of SQL/Power BI/Targit/ Salesforce.
Ideally based in Barcelona.

LANGUAGE SKILLS

Spanish Fluent (verbal and written)

English Fluent English

Title: BI Analyst – Revenue Operations
Description:
Descripción de la empresa

Doctoralia es una plataforma global líder en el sector de la salud digital. Nuestro objetivo es conectar pacientes con profesionales de la salud de forma sencilla, rápida y eficiente. ¿Cómo hacemos esto? A través del marketplace y la App móvil, conseguimos que los usuarios puedan buscar profesionales y/o clínicas del sector privado, leer reseñas de pacientes, consultar la disponibilidad y reservar directamente online. 📱💻

Doctoralia forma parte del grupo Docplanner desde 2017, una empresa multinacional con presencia en más de 13 países. 🌍

Contamos con el respaldo de inversores como Goldman Sachs, One Peak Partners, Point Nine y Target Global, hemos recaudado más de 450 millones de euros y estamos cerca de alcanzar la rentabilidad con más de 180 millones € ARR.

Descripción del empleo

Buscamos a alguien que se haga cargo de: consolidar el reporting comercial en dashboards gobernados (Tableau/Superset), dar acceso fiable al data warehouse a los equipos que lo necesiten, y sacar del Excel manual todo lo que hoy se sostiene a base de fórmulas y copia-pega.

Es un rol de ownership local de BI: construirás y mantendrás la infraestructura de datos que sales/cs opp —y el resto de la organización comercial— usan para trabajar.

What You'll Do


Diseñar, construir y mantener dashboards y modelos de datos en Tableau/Superset para Sales, Customer Success y áreas comerciales
Migrar reporting crítico desde Google Sheets hacia herramientas de BI, con trazabilidad y control de versiones
Dar y administrar acceso al data warehouse para los equipos que lo requieran, garantizando calidad y consistencia del dato
Traducir necesidades analíticas de Sales Ops, CS y Marketing en especificaciones técnicas y dashboards accionables
Detectar y corregir problemas de calidad de dato en la fuente, no solo en el reporte final
Documentar modelos de datos y procesos de BI para que sean sostenibles sin depender de una sola persona


Requisitos


2-6 años de experiencia como BI Analyst, Data Analyst o similar, con foco en construcción de dashboards (no solo consumo)
Dominio de herramientas de BI como Tableau y/o Superset (o similares) buscamos a nivel de construcción, no solo de uso
SQL avanzado: capacidad de escribir y optimizar queries complejas sin depender de otros
Experiencia trabajando directamente con un data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift o similar)
Comodidad migrando procesos manuales (Google Sheets) hacia sistemas gobernados
Nivel de ingles alto o bilingüe.


Nice-to-have:


Conocimiento de Python para automatización de pipelines o limpieza de datos
Dominio y experiencia con CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot) y su estructura de datos
Conocimiento y experiencia en modelos de negocios y GTM modelo SaaS, funnel de ventas etc.


Eres la persona que buscamos si...


Eres una persona proactiva y con mentalidad de ownership: no esperas a que te digan qué construir, identificas dónde falta gobierno de dato y lo propones.
Estás cómod@ operando con ambigüedad: el rol y las herramientas van a seguir evolucionando mientras el equipo global centraliza más tooling
Eres alguien entrepreneurial: te motiva construir algo desde una base poco estructurada, no solo mantener un sistema ya hecho


Información adicional

💶 Salario adecuado a tu experiencia.

🤝 Lo más importante: un equipo increíble que te acompañará y te apoyará en el camino.

⚕️ Seguro médico privado.

🎂 Día de cumpleaños libre para pasar el día con tus seres queridos.

📚 Clases de idiomas gratuitas.

🧠 Acceso ilimitado al chat de iFeel para apoyo en salud mental y bienestar emocional.

🏠 Modalidad híbrida con presencia mínima de 1 día a la semana desde nuestras oficinas de Barcelona.

🔎 Nuestro proceso de selección 🔎

✅ Primer match – Una charla con Alejandro (TAP).

📚 Prueba técnica - Para entender bien tus conocimientos básicos del rol.

💡 Conversación estratégica – Intro call con Elias, tu próximo manager.

👉 Presentación de un Business Case - Con Elias.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
At Gracia101, we're looking for a Data Analyst with strong SAP BW, SAP BusinessObjects (WebI), and Power BI experience to join our team




We're looking for someone with strong expertise in Power BI, SAP, and Web Intelligence to support data-driven decision-making. Main responsibilities include developing dashboards, managing data models, ensuring data consistency across systems, and delivering high-quality reporting solutions for business stakeholders.




Technical Skills

Strong expertise in Power BI (data modelling, DAX, visualization)
Hands-on experience with SAP BI / SAP BW / SAP data structures
Advanced Web Intelligence (WebI) report development
Advanced Excel
Knowledge of data modelling concepts
SQL/data querying knowledge (recommended)
Experience working with multiple data sources / system integration




Key Responsibilities

Design, develop, and maintain Power BI dashboards and data models
Build and enhance SAP BusinessObjects (Web Intelligence – WebI) reports
Extract, transform, and analyze data from SAP and other enterprise systems (e.g., DataOne)
Ensure data consistency and reconciliation across systems (SAP, BI tools, Excel)
Develop and maintain advanced Excel models for analysis and reporting
Translate business requirements into technical data solutions and visualizations
Perform data validation, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
Collaborate with finance and business teams to identify reporting needs
Support data governance, documentation, and reporting standards
Drive continuous improvement in reporting processes and automation




Nice-to-Have

Experience in FP&A / Finance reporting environment
Exposure to data governance / data quality frameworks
Experience in system migrations or BI transformations (WebI → Power BI)




Requirements

Degree in Business, Finance, Data Analytics, IT or similar
+3–5 years experience in BI / reporting roles
Experience working with enterprise data environments (SAP-based)

Title: Senior Digital Data Analyst (Marketing Intelligence)
Description:
Desde Timup, consultora de selección, estamos colaborando con una agencia creativa en la búsqueda de un/a Senior Marketing Analytics Specialist, una posición con recorrido hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Buscamos una persona que combine una sólida capacidad analítica con una visión estratégica del marketing y la comunicación. Alguien capaz de transformar datos en recomendaciones de negocio, ayudar a medir el impacto real de las campañas y convertirse en un partner de referencia tanto para clientes como para los equipos internos.

La persona incorporada tendrá un papel clave impulsando una cultura data-driven dentro de la organización, liderando proyectos de medición y contribuyendo a maximizar la efectividad de las estrategias de comunicación.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Serás responsable de analizar el rendimiento de campañas y acciones de comunicación, tanto digitales como offline, convirtiendo los datos en insights que permitan tomar mejores decisiones de negocio. Además, liderarás la interlocución con clientes en todo lo relacionado con analítica y medición, participando activamente en la evolución del área.




Responsabilidades

Analizar el rendimiento de campañas de comunicación y marketing, evaluando su impacto sobre la marca y el negocio.

Diseñar, desarrollar e interpretar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para clientes y equipos internos.

Liderar la relación con clientes en materia de analítica, reporting y medición de resultados.

Integrar información procedente de diferentes fuentes para obtener una visión global del rendimiento de las acciones de marketing.

Colaborar estrechamente con equipos multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades de optimización.

Impulsar el uso del análisis de datos como herramienta para mejorar la efectividad de las campañas y la toma de decisiones.

Participar en la evolución de metodologías y procesos de medición dentro de la compañía.




¿Qué buscamos?

Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics o Performance Analytics.

Experiencia previa en agencia o en entornos digitales de ritmo dinámico.

Dominio de herramientas de visualización de datos como Tableau (muy valorable), Power BI, Looker o Qlik.

Conocimientos sólidos de marketing digital, comunicación y medición de campañas.

Experiencia trabajando con SQL, análisis de datos y estadística aplicada.

Capacidad para sintetizar grandes volúmenes de información y convertirlos en recomendaciones accionables.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación de resultados.

Nivel alto de inglés (C1).




Se valorará especialmente

Conocimientos de Python.

Experiencia con herramientas como Adverity, Supermetrics o Datorama.

Conocimientos de Social Listening (Brandwatch, Lumen/Talkwalker, Pulsar, entre otras).

Uso de herramientas de IA como Claude, Gemini o NotebookLM aplicadas al análisis de datos y automatización de procesos.




¿Qué ofrece la compañía?

Incorporación a una agencia creativa reconocida, con un entorno altamente colaborativo e innovador.

Posición con recorrido profesional y posibilidad de evolucionar hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Modelo de trabajo híbrido.

Horario flexible y jornada intensiva durante el verano.

Plan de retribución flexible.

Acceso a formación continua y desarrollo profesional.

Programas de bienestar y beneficios sociales.

Participación en un entorno donde los datos tienen un papel estratégico en la toma de decisiones y el crecimiento de los clientes.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Expansion
Description:
We power people’s progress.

At Preply, we’re all about creating life-changing learning experiences. We help people discover the magic of the perfect tutor, craft a personalised learning journey, and stay motivated to keep growing. Our approach is human-led, tech-enabled - and it’s creating real impact.

We’ve just reached unicorn status with a $150M Series D, accelerating our vision to transform education through human-led, AI-enhanced learning. Today, 100,000+ tutors teach 90+ languages to learners in 180 countries - and we’re only getting started. As a category-defining company, we’re shaping what the future of learning looks like at global scale.

Every Preply lesson sparks change, fuels ambition, and drives progress that matters. Joining Preply means helping define the future of education at global scale, and building something that truly matters for millions of people, every day.

Meet the team

The Business Strategy Analytics team's mission is to transform data into strategic insights that empower our leaders to make informed decisions, effectively track progress, and unlock growth opportunities. Through deep metric understanding, holistic business views, and detailed analytics, we enable concrete actions that drive business success.

What You’ll Be Doing


Partner with Expansion leadership on major transformation initiatives shaping the value proposition, business model, customer experience, monetization strategy, and operational playbook for new geographies, segments, and product lines.
Evaluate and prioritize new market entries, customer segments, and strategic bets through rigorous market sizing, competitive benchmarking, and customer analysis
Run focused, data-driven deep dives into expansion-stage customer behavior, unit economics, funnel performance, and competitive dynamics to surface where to double down and where to pivot.
Lead cross-functional performance analyses across Expansion workstreams — surfacing trends, explaining the drivers behind new-market KPIs, and delivering clear, actionable insights to the executive team.
Build the analytical models that underpin Expansion decisions: market sizing and TAM/SAM/SOM models, ramp and forecasting models for new launches, scenario models to pressure-test strategic options, and financial models to quantify the upside (and downside) of each bet.


What You Need To Succeed


5+ years of experience in business analytics, product analytics, consulting, or a related analytical role.
Excellent communication and storytelling skills, capable of influencing Leadership-level stakeholders.
Proficiency in SQL and data visualization tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).
A proactive, curious mindset with a drive to investigate discrepancies and identify opportunities.
Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to synthesize complex data into clear narratives.
Exceptional attention to detail and a rigorous, structured approach to analysis.
Proven Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills (e.g., driver-based modeling, sensitivity analysis, financial impact estimation).
Experience leading cross-functional analytics projects and engaging diverse stakeholders.


Nice to have


Experience in corporate strategy or strategic consulting, with a track record of supporting senior leadership on high-impact, cross-functional initiatives
Experience in fast-growing, data-driven startups, marketplaces, or subscription businesses
Hands-on experience with Looker and Snowflake


Why you’ll love it at Preply


An open, collaborative, dynamic and diverse culture;
A generous monthly allowance for lessons on Preply.com, Learning & Development budget and time off for your self-development;
A competitive financial package with equity, leave allowance and health insurance;
Not in Barcelona? We offer an attractive relocation package to join us in our Preply Barcelona Hub
Access to free mental health support platforms;
Access to Gympass-partnered wellness and gym centers throughout Spain to promote and support well-being and physical health;
The opportunity to unlock the potential of learners and tutors through language learning and teaching in 175 countries (and counting!).


Our Principles

Title: Senior Product Data Analyst (Hybrid)
Description:
As you contemplate your future, you might be asking yourself, what's the next step? Start your journey with us!

We're seeking a Senior Product Data Analyst to join our Experiments & Insights team in Barcelona (hybrid) to help different teams across the organization to succeed in their mission by providing insights generation and data analysis support in a healthy data-informed environment. If you're ready to soar, we're ready to take you there.

Why eDreams ODIGEO

We’re the world's leading travel subscription platform.


We pioneered Prime, the first and largest travel subscription programme, which has topped over 7.8 million Prime members since launching in 2017.
Millions of customers every year across 44 markets – 5 brands: eDreams, GO Voyages, Opodo, Travellink, and the metasearch engine Liligo
More than 100 million searches per day on our websites - more than 6 billion AI daily predictions
Over 1,700 employees – More than 60 different nationalities from all continents – 99% permanent contracts



Prime members are subscribed to global travel, gaining access to a comprehensive multi-product offering for all their travel needs—including hotels, rail, flights, dynamic packages and car rental, among others— compounded by industry-leading flexibility features and exclusive, member-only benefits. This entire Prime experience is powered by a proprietary, industry-leading AI platform that delivers a smarter, hyper-personalised service and comprehensive travel experience globally to its members.

What you will do:

The Role's Key Responsibilities and Tasks

As an eDOer, you will have clear objectives, great challenges and a clear overview of how your work contributes to the global company project and its customers. Our Experiments and Insights team is the centre of excellence for Online (AB) Experimentation and for providing best practices to generate insights and learning from and for the experiments.

In this role, you would be performing as a product data analyst (tasks are described below) to support a set of product teams, but you will be also part of the next experimentation generation at eDreams Odigeo. The team is constantly investigating best in class methodologies and processes to implement in our business/analysis and tests, which means you will be required to apply your mathematical knowledge in some strategic projects that are focused on taking more accurate decisions maintaining a strong statistical confidence level. Your will be working with multi-disciplinary teams - Qualitative Researchers, Designers, Product Owners, Developers, and Pricing Managers - to blend different statistical and data analytics techniques to generate a holistic understanding of the users and markets.

As a Product Data Analyst inside the team, you will be in charge of:


Analyse performance and identify behaviours in our different websites and interfaces related to our products;
Analyse performance and user behaviours in the A/B Tests experiments or Pre-Post run by the product teams;
Help the product teams to generate their testing hypotheses by providing exploratory analysis about our products, past tests, etc,
Data cleaning and validation,
Definition of new tracking that will all mostly be added in Google Analytics (to be able to answer different kinds of research/product questions);
Build and maintain dashboards (mostly using LookerStudio) and/or reports (mostly in Google Sheets) to share performance information with senior management and C-level stakeholders;
Lead data-driven initiatives to improve company decision making and business knowledge;
Responsible for one or more team’s projects such as the investigation and implementation of new methodologies, new data analysis techniques or the usage of new tools;
Collaborate with user researchers and designers to detect gaps in knowledge about our user; identify research opportunities to fill those gaps.
NOTE: Data you will be using could come from Google Analytics API or Google Analytics tables in BigQuery, other sources of data stored in BigQuery such as internal databases, customer service database, etc., as well as our data stored and accessible in Microstrategy.



What you need to succeed:

Good to have

Bring your unique perspective, speak up, and offer disruptive solutions. You'll have the opportunity to learn and grow while making a real impact on our team. Here's what you need to succeed:


Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative discipline is a requirement (Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics, etc.),
Minimum of 6 years experience in a role with strong analytical component,
Previous experience in user behavior analysis (product performance) using data from any of the following: Google
Analytics/Adobe Analytics/Mix Panel/ Amplitude/Matomo.
Strong knowledge of the math and statistical concepts behind A/B testing,
Strong knowledge of SQL is a requirement, as well as experience in working with databases and large sets of data,
Advanced Office skills. Strong experience with analytical tools, ideally with the Google toolset (spreadsheets, google docs, etc),
Knowledge of visualisation tools like LookerStudio, Tableau, Looker or Qlikview,
Business Proficiency in English,
A self-starter and team player, who also enjoys having fun!



It would be a plus if you have:


R or Python programming skills (mostly for data extraction and data manipulation),
Google Analytics knowledge (as well as Google Analytics API, googleAnalyticsR library for R, GA4, etc.),
Previous experience in programming,
Knowledge on data structure and data sets management in Google Cloud Platform.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience with Applied AI Tools: Demonstrated comfort using practical AI tools such as Gemini, or other AI-powered assistants.
Experimentation Mindset: Curiosity and eagerness to explore, experiment with, and integrate emerging AI-driven solutions into workflows.
AI-Enhanced Problem Solving: Ability to effectively leverage AI tools to streamline processes, and enhance productivity.
Adaptability and Learning Agility: Enthusiastic about continuously learning and quickly adapting to new AI features and capabilities.



What’s in it for you?

The best talent deserves the best benefits

At eDO, we want you to be a part of our success story and great culture. Here's what we offer:


A rewarding Compensation package! 💥 Prime Plus membership, competitive salary and benefits package, including flexible benefits, performance-based bonuses, birthday day off, discounts and partnerships, relocation support and premium equipment with role-based selection options and device ownership through our equipment lifecycle program when it reaches its refresh cycle.
Continuous learning to fuel your growth and explore new horizons! 📚 Learn and grow with free Coursera access, soft skills workshops, tech training, leadership development, and more. Plus, enjoy a great onboarding program.
Grow opportunities to empower your career, and unleash your potential! 🚀 Personalised career paths and the eVOLVE Program will help you discover, grow, and thrive. Internal mobility opportunities let you pursue horizontal career changes and promotions.
Your Well-being is our priority. Embrace Freedom and Flexibility! 💙 At eDO, we value flexibility, employee care, and transparency. We offer a hybrid home-office model focused on outcome, not time-in-seat. You'll be able to find the right work-personal life balance that suits you best.
Work hard, party hard! We believe in having fun and connecting with colleagues! 🎉 Join eDO for after-work events, padel tournaments, parties, and more. Create communities based on your passions, like sports and music. Come to work as you are, with no dress code, and enjoy free fruit, coffee, and tea at our offices.
Enjoy a dynamic and healthy environment! 💫 Be innovative, take risks, and share your ideas. Our diverse and open-minded teams support high performance, learning, and growth. You'll work in an Agile mindset environment with recognition at our core.



Wanna take a peek into what it's like to work at eDO? Follow us on LinkedIn and discover more about life at eDO!

If you are ready for a career opportunity with unmatched benefits, continuous learning, and a supportive work-life balance, look no further! Take your career to new destinations by applying now and help our diverse, inclusive, and passionate team shape the future of travel.

Apply now!

We are an equal-opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status or disability status. Our people are the key to our success. Each one of them is unique in their own way and the respect for their uniqueness is and will always be a passion and motivation. Don’t meet every requirement? If you’re excited about this role but do not feel your experience aligns perfectly with all the requirements we strongly encourage you to apply nevertheless.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence & Data Analyst
Description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Sr Business Intelligence and Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and governing scalable business intelligence solutions and data architectures. The role enables data-driven decision-making across the EMEA commercial organization by transforming complex, multi-source data into actionable insights through robust data models, optimized pipelines, and Power BI reporting.

This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and Business Analytics (EMEA) and is part of the EMEA Sales Operation and Enablement team and will be in Barcelona (Spain) or Prague (Czech Republic) and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To


Design and deliver end-to-end Power BI solutions, including robust data models, interactive dashboards, and scalable semantic layers (e.g., star schemas and data marts).
Build and optimize high-performance data architectures by integrating multiple enterprise sources (ERP, CRM, CPQ) and developing efficient SQL queries.
Establish and govern KPI frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment across business reporting.
Drive data quality, governance, and best practices in data transformation, normalization, documentation, and access control.
Perform advanced analytics, including exploratory data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling to support sales and performance tracking.


The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include


B.Sc./M.Sc. in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or related field.
Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).
Solid knowledge of data architecture principles (data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing).
Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), ERP, and other enterprise systems.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements


Ability to travel 10%


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


Sales Operations, preferably in Sanitary/Pharmaceutical Sector is a plus
Lean Change Management Models, data-driven transformation and continuous improvement methodologies in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities
Experience with Lean or data-driven transformation methodologies is a plus.


Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefits that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programmes contribute to life beyond the job.

Join our winning team today. Together, we’ll accelerate the real-life impact of tomorrow’s science and technology. We partner with customers across the globe to help them solve their most complex challenges, architecting solutions that bring the power of science to life.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are

Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.

Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise Direct hands-on experience with at least one of MMM or incrementality testing. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.
Growth Data Modelling - Ability to write advanced, production-grade code and build robust data models to transform raw marketing telemetry into scalable analytical structures. Incorporating a privacy-first tracking approaches




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.

What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued

So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Title: Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
Description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth
Partner with business functions to gather, challenge, and refine reporting requirements, proposing better KPIs and smarter ways to analyze the data
Act as a BI business partner, running working sessions with stakeholders across functions to understand their priorities and translate them into analytical solutions
Define, standardize, and monitor core business KPIs (sales, margin, corporate finance, and beyond), ensuring consistency and a shared definition across reporting
Turn business questions into executive-ready dashboards and self-service analytics that drive decision making
Perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis, identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights
Promote data literacy and the adoption of self-service analytics across the organization


Qualifications


Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query (M), dataset and data model design, and report/dashboard development
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, interpret, and communicate complex data
Solid understanding of core business KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance
Strong business acumen, with the ability to engage, challenge, and advise stakeholders across different functions — this is a hybrid business-and-technical role, not a pure IT developer position
Proven experience in a similar BI / analytics role (~3 years)
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and lead requirement-gathering discussions
Proficiency in Excel
Experience in data modeling, data analysis, and data visualization
Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona


You will be joining a highly motivated and skilled team, providing a great environment to learn and grow. If you love working with data, building insights, and partnering with the business to drive better decisions, this is the position for you. We value a proactive approach and encourage continuous learning and development, ensuring that you will have ample opportunities to enhance your skills and contribute to our success.

Arxada has world class offerings in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
  • Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth
  • Partner with business functions to gather, challenge, and refine reporting requirements, proposing better KPIs and smarter ways to analyze the data
  • Act as a BI business partner, running working sessions with stakeholders across functions to understand their priorities and translate them into analytical solutions
  • Define, standardize, and monitor core business KPIs (sales, margin, corporate finance, and beyond), ensuring consistency and a shared definition across reporting
  • Turn business questions into executive-ready dashboards and self-service analytics that drive decision making
  • Perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis, identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights
  • Promote data literacy and the adoption of self-service analytics across the organization

Qualifications

  • Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query (M), dataset and data model design, and report/dashboard development
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, interpret, and communicate complex data
  • Solid understanding of core business KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance
  • Strong business acumen, with the ability to engage, challenge, and advise stakeholders across different functions — this is a hybrid business-and-technical role, not a pure IT developer position
  • Proven experience in a similar BI / analytics role (~3 years)
  • Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and lead requirement-gathering discussions
  • Proficiency in Excel
  • Experience in data modeling, data analysis, and data visualization
  • Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
  • Strong attention to detail and accuracy
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
  • Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona

You will be joining a highly motivated and skilled team, providing a great environment to learn and grow. If you love working with data, building insights, and partnering with the business to drive better decisions, this is the position for you. We value a proactive approach and encourage continuous learning and development, ensuring that you will have ample opportunities to enhance your skills and contribute to our success.

Arxada has world class offerings in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.
