Title: Senior Data Analyst - Operations Analytics
Description:
Who we are:
At Rover, pets and their people are at the heart of everything we do. We connect pet parents with trusted pet care across the U.S., Canada, Europe, and Australia.

Headquartered in Seattle and Barcelona, we’re a values driven, fast-growing tech company focused on building safe and personalized experiences tailored to the needs of each unique pet. We’re investing in AI as a business accelerator and provide every team member access to AI tools in service of creating better experiences for our community.

We are proud to be recognized as a great place to work, having been named among the 100 Best Companies to Work For in Seattle Business Magazine and Washington’s Best Workplaces in the Puget Sound Business Journal. At Rover we’re committed to creating an accessible, inclusive, and welcoming community, which starts with our employees.

Want to make an impact? Join our pack and come work (and play!) with us.

About The Role
We are seeking a Senior Data Analyst to join our Operations Analytics team in Barcelona. You will partner closely with Rover’s Operations org, driving initiatives and supporting analytics towards furthering Rover’s customer experience. This is a high-visibility role involving direct collaboration with a diverse set of stakeholders to define, measure, test and improve the success of customer experience programs and product developments. A key component of this position will be providing product analytics support for our Bookings Confidence team, which aims to tackle customer service improvements through product developments.

The ideal candidate is a passionate problem-solver who comfortably translates ambiguous business challenges into clear questions, deep analysis, and strategic recommendations that drive action.

You’ll be joining an international team, reporting to a Barcelona based Analytics manager, with colleagues and stakeholders split between Barcelona and Seattle. This is a hybrid role: we're in our Poblenou office two days a week (Mondays and Thursdays), so you'll need to be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

This is a hybrid position that has the minimum expectation to work out of our Barcelona Office in the Poblenou neighborhood two days per week on Mondays and Thursdays. For this reason, candidates must be based in Barcelona or willing to relocate.

Your Responsibilities:


Thought Partnership: Serve as a strategic partner and advisor to product managers and business leaders, making data-driven recommendations on optimization strategies within customer experience
Experimentation: Partner with Product Managers, designers and engineers to design and conduct rigorous experiments in support of product developments.
Strategic Planning & Measurement: Partner with Ops Program leadership to define the strategy for measuring program health and operational performance, including establishing comprehensive metrics, developing crisp reporting, and setting up monitoring rhythms.
Performance Analysis: Conduct in-depth analysis of key CX (Customer Experience) operational metrics to identify emerging trends and opportunities, which will inform deeper research and analytical efforts.
Executive Communication: Develop and present crisp narratives resulting from analytics findings and investigations to senior Operations leaders, focusing on both identified problems and proposed solutions.
Data Infrastructure Support: Support the construction and maintenance of our core reporting abstractions (built in dbt), BI reporting and AI semantic layers




What we're looking for (must-haves):


At least 4 years experience working cross-functionally with complex datasets to support organizational decision making.
Hands-on experience running A/B tests and experiment design.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, you know how to narrate analysis and results to business partners in a useful, concise, and meaningful way.
You are extremely comfortable with receiving stakeholder questions and independently translating them into clear, actionable analytical problems to solve, all with relative autonomy.
You have hands-on experience building out data abstractions using tools such as DBT or Airflow as well as a variety of data visualization tools (e.g., Mode, Looker, Periscope, Tableau, etc.)
Strong proficiency with SQL. You would feel confident reviewing code produced by other analysts and data scientists




Nice to Have:


Master’s degree in a quantitative field OR on the job experience with applied statistics.
Ability to code in Python/R
Hands on experience leveraging AI tools for analytics
Hands-on experience working with customer service tool data sets (e.g., Zendesk)
Hands-on experience in workforce forecasting




Compensation:


In the greater Barcelona area the first-year salary range is €47,124 - €60,319. Additionally, Rover offers a long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout and benefits to full-time employees
The cash compensation offered for this role will be dependent on the candidate's experience, qualifications, skills, and abilities as demonstrated in the interview and hiring process




Benefits of Working at Rover.com:


Long-term incentive plan with a company performance-based cash payout
Pension plan
Private medical insurance
25 days PTO
Meal allowance and flexible compensation plan (transport and nursery)
Gym membership
€450 to cover the costs associated with the adoption of a pet
Annual €150 wellness reimbursement
Flexible work hours, sometimes you'll need to be in at certain times, but on the whole, we're pretty flexible when it comes to managing workload and time
Grab snacks, fresh fruit, in our kitchen to keep yourself going
Regular team activities, events, game nights, and more
Dog-friendly office




Rover is an equal-opportunity employer committed to promoting a diverse, inclusive, and inventive environment with the best employees. We’re driven by seeing our people succeed and grow, and we work to ensure everyone contributes to their fullest potential. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to age, race, color, ancestry, national origin, religion, disability, protected veteran status, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, or any other protected status in accordance with applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

Title: Junior Data Analyst - Automation & Reporting
Description:
Everything you are looking for and more 📦

Join our Customer Care team at InPost Iberia as a Junior Data Analyst and become the bridge between raw data and business impact. Your mission: unlock the power of our data through automations that free up time for the team, dashboards that drive decisions, and a genuine curiosity to understand not just the "what" but the "why" behind every request.

What responsibilities and objectives will you have?


Design, build and maintain automations that reduce manual work for the Customer Care team and its agents, continuously improving them to maximize efficiency.
Automate the processing of recurring, business-critical files such as claims files, preparing them ready for review and minimizing human error.
Handle ad-hoc data requests: pulling lists, cross-referencing sources, running validations and delivering insights that support day-to-day decision-making.
Design, develop and maintain internal dashboards in Power BI that track KPIs and make data accessible across the team.
Contribute to Customer Care data tables and models, ensuring alignment with the standards set by the international data team.
Represent Customer Care Iberia in cross-functional company projects, bringing the data and operational perspective of the area to broader business initiatives.


Well, what will the requirements be?

Mandatory


Solid SQL and Python (PySpark) — you can write and debug queries and scripts independently.
Proficiency in the Microsoft environment, particularly Excel, SharePoint and Power Automate.
Experience building dashboards and reports in Power BI.
Autonomy and problem-solving mindset: the ability to take a loosely defined brief, find a way forward and propose solutions without constant guidance.
Genuine interest in the business context, not just the data — you ask why something is being requested and what it will be used for before diving into execution.
Working level of English for day-to-day collaboration within an international team.
Spanish (working level) for collaborating directly with the local Customer Care team.


Nice to Have:


Experience with workflow automation tools such as n8n or similar platforms.


What do we offer?


Language platform
Wellbeing programme
Flexible working hours
Online platform for lifelong learning
Competitive salary
Flexible remuneration services can be contracted


Why join us?

At InPost, you will play a key role in shaping how millions of customers interact with last-mile delivery solutions. You will work in a fast-growing, innovative environment where your contributions directly support the company’s expansion and market presence. Our culture is built around five key behaviours, driven by a strong “Go Go Go” mindset focused on speed and determination.


CHAMPION THE CUSTOMER: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and strive to exceed expectations.
OWN IT: We take responsibility, act with initiative, and proactively drive solutions.
DARE TO DISRUPT: We embrace innovation, ambition, and continuous learning to grow and improve together.
MAKE IT HAPPEN: We adapt quickly, learn constantly, and move forward with Smart execution.
WIN TOGETHER: We achieve great results through collaboration, recognition, and a shared winning mindset.


Inclusive Culture

At InPost, we are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We welcome applications from all backgrounds and believe that different perspectives strengthen our teams and drive better results.

InPost has an Equal Opportunities Plan that promotes equality at all levels. We aim for equality in the company's workplaces, as it is focused on promotion, within and outside the company, as well as gender equality, diversity, equity and inclusion of people regardless of their abilities and conditions.

Title: Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Barcelona
Description:
Location: We are flexible! Come and join us either in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona.

Freenow empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our product squads, using data to build a flawless product experience. You will join the Product Data Team and work closely with PMs, designers, UX researchers, developers, and other data functions to discover new product opportunities, validate hypotheses, and launch valuable features to our users.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Providing expertise and collaborating with stakeholders to generate new product feature ideas and improvements, and also estimating the potential impact of planned projects.
Continuously engaging with the product squads to gain an understanding of the problems that need to be solved, gathering requirements, and defining the best deliverables to match the business needs.
Having full ownership of your analysis, from ideation to communication of results and making recommendations to all levels of the company including senior management and prioritization committees.
Developing and evaluating A/B test experiments or other analyses to measure and report the performance of released features, ensuring that we are launching the correct changes and features in our apps.
Working closely with our developers and data engineers to create and capture data that is aligned with the business logic and allows modeling and analysis.
Being involved throughout the complete product lifecycle in order to guarantee a data-driven process.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
You will have the opportunity to steer our products, which kind of features should be developed, and which changes should be made to solve hundreds of thousands of users' daily needs.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other fields with a strong mathematical-statistical background
3+ years experience in working as a Data Analyst in a data-driven analytics environment, preferably within tech product organizations, having direct contact with stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills, lateral thinking, and proven experience in solving highly challenging problems.
Very good knowledge of SQL, databases, and statistical programming tools (e.g. Python, R) so that exploratory analyses can be performed, reports created and ETLs maintained
Good understanding and hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting A/B test results, backed by statistical knowledge.
Experience in working with data visualisation tools (e.g.Tableau, Qlikview) and event tracking (e.g. Mixpanel, GA, Firebase)
You are able to communicate findings in a concise and clear manner to a wide variety of stakeholders to support data-driven decision making by using data visualisation and storytelling and have excellent English communication skills.


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning
Sabbatical & special leave policies
WeRoad partnership
Birthday, 24th + 31st December off
Short term EU work policy
Mobility Credit
Health Insurance
Employee assistance program


Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION:

FREE NOW is an equal opportunity employer and we consider qualified applicants regardless of race, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability or age.

We want you to grow and evolve, bring your true self to work.

Trabajarás en un entorno internacional.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst
Description:
Level Up Your Career with Zynga!

At Zynga, we bring people together through the power of play. As a global leader in interactive entertainment and a proud label of Take-Two Interactive, our games have been downloaded over 6 billion times—connecting players in 175+ countries through fun, strategy, and a little friendly competition.

From thrilling casino spins to epic strategy battles, mind-bending puzzles, and social word challenges, our diverse game portfolio has something for everyone. Fan-favorites and latest hits include FarmVille™, Words With Friends™, Zynga Poker™, Game of Thrones Slots Casino™, Wizard of Oz Slots™, Hit it Rich! Slots™, Wonka Slots™, Top Eleven™, Toon Blast™, Empires & Puzzles™, Merge Dragons!™, CSR Racing™, Harry Potter: Puzzles & Spells™, Match Factory™, and Color Block Jam™—plus many more!

Founded in 2007 and headquartered in California, our teams span North America, Europe, and Asia, working together to craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Whether you're spinning, strategizing, matching, or competing, Zynga is where fun meets innovation—and where you can take your career to the next level.

Join us and be part of the play!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.
Ability to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences.
Demonstrated experience working with visualization tools like Tableau, Looker, or similar.
Experience mentoring or leading other analysts is a big plus.
Fast learner, highly meticulous, proactive, and pragmatic.


What's in it for you as a Socialpointer?


Hybrid working model: we ask you to come to our Barcelona office at least 2 days per week
A generous 25 days of annual leave, plus public holidays
Private medical insurance for you and your family to keep your health bar full
Disability and life insurance
Choose from the latest iOS or Android device when you join (phone or tablet)
Free language lessons in English, Spanish and Catalan
Spotify Premium to add the perfect soundtrack to your adventure
Legendary social events and parties to let off some steam
Take-Two Interactive employee stock purchase plan (eligibility criteria applies)
Professional development budget for skills training


Onsite Perks Include


State of the art gym facilities
Free breakfast, lunch, and specialty coffee
Onsite physiotherapist and hairdresser (no wallet needed!)


The list goes on and on… so get your game on and apply now! Click “Apply” to level up and submit your application in English.

Title: Product Analyst, Payments (100% Remote within Spain)
Description:
Welcome to the good side of tech 👋

You might have heard about us, but with a different name: Doctoralia. It all started 12 years ago when we asked ourselves: is anyone in healthcare thinking about patients? We jumped in and we empowered patients by giving them access to leave and read reviews about their visit. We then provided doctors with the technology to manage bookings easily and save time, so they could devote themselves to what they always wanted: treating patients. And today is the day in which we ask you: wanna join us in the next step of making the healthcare experience more human?

Docplanner at scale

We are leaders in 13 countries so far, and more than 90 million patients trust us every month. 300k+ specialists believe in us and our product, and so do leading venture capital funds such as Point Nine Capital, Goldman Sachs Asset Management and One Peak Partners. And yet, employing over 2.500 people all over the globe, we managed to keep the startup-mindset we started with over 10 years ago.

At Docplanner we are a diverse group of over 300 people working in Engineering, Data, and Product teams. We are responsible for building the product for all locations. Many of us have been here for over 5 years, yet we still welcome each new person with great joy and excitement.

We could tell you about us, but we will let our reviews on Glassdoor speak for themselves. In case you’d like to see how it feels to be 100% yourself at work, here’s a video of us.

And why should you join us?

Because it feels good to tell your family and your friends how you made the world a little bit better. You go to bed knowing that what you do matters, and that your talents align with your beliefs.

We want to make the healthcare experience more human, and that starts with you being you. We believe that taking the diversity of human experience into account makes a better healthcare experience for all . We’re not just different: we embrace diversity. We will encourage you to come to work your whole self, and that includes not coming to the office at all if you prefer not to, as we're 100% remote friendly.

In this role as a Product Analyst at Docplanner you'll own the metrics and analytical direction for your product area, working directly with Product Directors to influence strategy and roadmap priorities. Your insights will drive real decisions: what we build, what we kill, and where we invest next.

This means the autonomy to dig into the problems that matter, challenge conventional thinking, and push for change when the data tells a different story. You'll define what success looks like, build the frameworks to measure it, and make sure every major decision is backed by solid analysis.

You'll work with a talented team of analysts, researchers, product managers, designers, and engineers who are obsessed with building the best product. Your analyses will directly shape Product strategy and influence how millions of patients and healthcare professionals experience Docplanner.

About The Payments Team

DP Payments is a sub-unit of two fully autonomous product teams, PMs, engineers and a designer — with the mandate and capability to work across virtually any app or repository in the Docplanner ecosystem. We're building a new revenue stream for the company, which means combining the maturity of a scale-up with the agility of a startup.

The challenge

Payments has to live inside almost every app and view Docplanner has. We don't get the comfort of a greenfield or a clean separation, but we're held to the expectations of one. The challenge is to keep iterating fast inside a complex ecosystem of mature processes and products.

Key Responsibilities Include


Help product areas to strategically build the product: bring ideas for new growth opportunities based on your expertise, estimate the potential impact of such ideas and guide our strategy through metric frameworks and insights.
Work with higher management, business stakeholders and researchers to create and validate hypotheses from both a qualitative and quantitative perspective.
Create and maintain dashboards, analysis and forecasts related to our team’s main metrics.
Manipulate and transform large data-sets to bring new insights and perform root-cause analysis.
Collaborate with the Product team to test new features and validate hypotheses through experimentation and AB Testing.
Perform segmentation analysis to understand who our customers are and what are their main drivers to engage with our products.
Build, maintain and continuously evolve the analytics stack for a complex set of processes spread across many apps and technologies — centred on accepting and processing patient payments to doctors and clinics for their appointments.


Who are you?


You are curious by nature, and you love to ask and answer questions and dig into data.
You like finding patterns in data and proactively suggesting stakeholders how to improve the product.
You have an excellent understanding of statistics.
You enjoy constant learning and high autonomy.
You enjoy being part of a diverse analytics team.
You enjoy training and coaching others.
You are familiar with complex Product organizations in the SaaS market.
You enjoy using cutting-edge tools, frameworks and incorporating AI to automate and improve your work.


What skills and experiences do we want you to have?


3+ years of relevant experience in analytics, working with business KPIs and metrics, of which 2+ working closely with product managers and user research teams.
You are familiar with the tools that we use:
Proficiency in SQL (essential) and experienced with DBT.
Data visualization tools such as Tableau, PowerBI or similar (essential)
Event-tracking tools such as Google Analytics, Amplitude or similar (essential)
Python and its ecosystem of Data Science libraries
Experienced in working with Claude Code or similar AI IDEs.
Great communication skills and stakeholder management. You translate complex analyses into clear insights that executives and stakeholders actually act on.
Fluent in manipulating, transforming, and reshaping data, preferably from multiple data sources.
Doing root-cause analysis, applying statistical concepts like regressions, and proving correlations and causation.
Contributing to data warehouses, creating aggregated data sets, general understanding of data pipelines and flows.
Experience designing, implementing and measuring A/B Tests and interpreting the results.
Experience enabling others by training stakeholders on tools and helping teams become more data-literate and autonomous.

Let’s talk money


A salary adequate to your experience: ranging from €46,000 to €56,000 per year.
Flexible remuneration and benefits system via Flexoh, which includes: restaurant card, transportation card, kindergarten, and training tax savings.


True flexibility and work-life balance


Remote or hybrid work model with our hub in Barcelona.
Flexible working hours (fully flexible, as in most cases you only have to be on a couple of meetings weekly).
Summer intensive schedule during July and August (work 7 hours, finish earlier).
23 paid holidays, with exchangeable local bank holidays.
Additional paid holiday on your birthday or work anniversary (you choose what you want to celebrate).


Health comes first


Private healthcare plan with Adeslas for you and subsidized for your family (medical and dental).
Access to hundreds of gyms for a symbolic fee in partnership for you and your family with Wellhub.
Access to iFeel, a technological platform for mental wellness offering online psychological support and counseling.


Keep growing with us


Free English and Spanish classes.


We promote and embrace equal opportunities in our hiring process, and also every day at work. When you apply for our roles you receive equal treatment regardless of age, disabilities, gender reassignment, marital or civil partner status, pregnancy or parental status, race, colour, nationality, ethnic or national origin, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation or any other dimension of human difference. If you require additional support in your recruitment process, we kindly encourage you to let us know. Behind those words you’re reading, there’s a person (hi!) who already helped a candidate by adapting the interviews, and now we’re lucky to have this person with us. So, even if you’ve never asked for it before, may this serve as a sign that, now, you can do so. We can only truly be equal if we adapt to each other.

“We believe all humans, in all their beautiful diversity, should have equal rights, dignity and respect. Period.” Mariusz Gralewski, CEO

Title: Data Analyst / Data Engineer (Commercial Insurance)
Description:
We Are Waiting for You

Hi there!

I am Laura, the recruiter for this position. Nice to meet you!

First, a little bit about what I like the most about working at TDC: The environment here is incredibly collaborative and innovative. Our tech-driven mindset fosters continuous learning and growth, creating an atmosphere where everyone can thrive. Now, I can't wait to share this exciting journey with you at the Zurich!

First off all, THANK YOU for considering our company. We understand that finding the right opportunity can be tough, but I’ll try to make it easier.

Who Are We?

Let me introduce us. You’re reading about Zurich Insurance Group, a global leader in insurance, but this role specifically pertains to ServiZurich. Established in Barcelona in 2006, ServiZurich operates as an integral part of Zurich Insurance Group, providing cutting-edge technological solutions and support to Zurich's local and global business units.

In addition to our technological solutions, we excel in investment, administration, and accounting, ensuring comprehensive support for Zurich's diverse operations.

What Can You Expect

Are you a motivated, hands-on, and innovative thinker, interested in shaping the future of one of the world’s largest insurers? Do you have a passion for uncovering insights from data and transforming them into actionable business solutions? If so, this opportunity could be the perfect fit for you.

We are looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our global Commercial Insurance team.

And you might be thinking: This is great, what will my day-to-day be like, at Zurich? I’m glad you asked.

As a Data Analyst / Data Engineer you will have the opportunity to:


Work closely with stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data-driven solutions.
Analyse complex datasets to identify trends, patterns, and opportunities that drive business performance.
Develop clear reports, dashboards, and visualizations to communicate findings and support decision-making.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to implement improvements based on your analysis.

Title: Junior Data Analyst & AI Automation Specialist
Description:
En Rubió llevamos más de 55 años trabajando para que todas las personas tengan acceso a nuestros medicamentos, independientemente de la prevalencia de su patología, contribuyendo así a mejorar su calidad de vida.




Actualmente buscamos incorporar un/a Data Analyst & Automation Specialist para Nutribrain, una compañía especializada en la fabricación y comercialización de suplementos alimenticios naturales, orientados al bienestar mental y físico, la nutrición y la mejora de la calidad de vida, con una fuerte apuesta por la innovación, la investigación y la calidad en el ámbito de la salud.




La posición estará ubicada en Barcelona y se integrará en un equipo pequeño y ágil, donde los datos tienen un papel clave en la toma de decisiones. La persona seleccionada trabajará directamente con el CEO, con autonomía y margen para proponer y desarrollar soluciones.




¿Cuál será tu rol?




La persona seleccionada tendrá un rol dinámico y transversal, combinando análisis de datos, desarrollo de herramientas y automatización de procesos.




Será responsable de transformar datos en información útil para el negocio y de desarrollar soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y automatizar procesos, trabajando con datos de ventas, previsiones, stock y diferentes plataformas y marketplaces.




Además del análisis técnico, la persona será capaz de interpretar los datos desde una perspectiva de negocio, entendiendo el impacto de variables como ventas, márgenes, rentabilidad, stock, rotación de producto y previsiones, para aportar recomendaciones que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas.




Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con tecnologías de inteligencia artificial aplicadas a diferentes áreas del negocio, participando en el desarrollo de soluciones y herramientas propias.




Funciones principales




Análisis de datos y automatización

Analizar datos de negocio, incluyendo ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales, identificando tendencias, estacionalidades e inconsistencias.
Desarrollar dashboards y herramientas de visualización que faciliten la toma de decisiones.
Diseñar y desarrollar automatizaciones e integraciones entre plataformas, APIs y bases de datos.
Crear flujos de datos automatizados y herramientas propias para obtener información de fuentes sin API oficial, mediante web scraping y automatización de navegadores.
Desarrollar aplicaciones y soluciones internas adaptadas a las necesidades del negocio.
Interpretar indicadores de negocio relacionados con ventas, rentabilidad, stock y catálogo de producto, identificando oportunidades de mejora y apoyando la toma de decisiones desde una perspectiva financiera y comercial.




IA y desarrollo de nuevas soluciones

Aplicar herramientas de inteligencia artificial a procesos y necesidades reales del negocio.
Integrar modelos de lenguaje y herramientas de IA en flujos de trabajo y automatizaciones.
Participar en el desarrollo de soluciones de IA audiovisual para generación de vídeo, voz e imagen.
Identificar nuevas oportunidades de automatización y proponer soluciones que permitan mejorar la eficiencia y aportar valor al negocio.




¿Qué requisitos buscamos?




Formación y experiencia: 2-4 años de experiencia en análisis de datos aplicado a negocio, con capacidad para trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos y entornos dinámicos.
Análisis de datos: sólida capacidad analítica y pensamiento crítico, con experiencia en análisis de ventas, previsiones, stock y series temporales.
Programación y datos: buen dominio de SQL y Python (pandas), experiencia con datasets reales, Git/GitHub y APIs REST.
Automatización: experiencia con web scraping, automatización de navegadores y herramientas de integración y automatización de procesos.
Herramientas y tecnología: nivel avanzado de Excel/Google Sheets y, valorable, experiencia con herramientas de BI, bases de datos, n8n, Make, Zapier o tecnologías similares.
IA y nuevas tecnologías: Dominio de asistentes de programación y desarrollo basados en IA, como Codex, Claude Code, Cursor o herramientas similares, utilizándolos de forma habitual para acelerar el desarrollo y la automatización, curiosidad por mantenerse al día de la evolución de los modelos de IA, nuevas capacidades y herramientas emergentes, evaluando su aplicación práctica en el entorno empresarial.
Perfil personal: persona resolutiva, autónoma, organizada y con capacidad para gestionar proyectos propios y encontrar soluciones ante nuevos retos.




¿Qué ofrecemos?

Contratación estable.
Presencial de lunes, miércoles y jueves en oficinas de Barcelona.
Martes y viernes con posibilidad de teletrabajo.
Viernes con jornada intensiva.
Incorporación a un equipo en crecimiento con oportunidades reales de desarrollo profesional.




Si crees que encajas con el perfil y quieres formar parte de un equipo comprometido con la innovación y la excelencia, ¡te estamos buscando!




Si quieres saber más sobre nosotros, visita nuestra web:




www.laboratoriosrubio.com

Title: Especialista en Business Intelligence & Analítica de Datos
Description:
Somos Banco Sabadell




Somos el cuarto grupo bancario español. Pero, sobre todo, somos un equipo genuino de personas colaborando para ofrecer las mejores soluciones a nuestros clientes. En Banco Sabadell, #QueremosQueSeasTú, porque sabemos que el talento único de cada persona es lo que nos hace #SerSabadell.




¿Qué estamos buscando?




Nos encontramos en búsqueda de nuestro/nuestra futuro/futura Especialista en Business Intelligence & Analítica de Datos cuya misión es diseñar, construir y evolucionar la infraestructura de datos y analítica del negocio, garantizando una visión única, fiable y accionable de la información. Responsable de automatizar los procesos de cálculo de rentabilidad, desarrollar modelos analíticos y proporcionar información estratégica que facilite la toma de decisiones basada en datos, optimizando la rentabilidad de clientes, productos, partners y canales de venta.




Hablemos del proyecto...




Como Especialista en Business Intelligence & Analítica de Datos, tus funciones serán:




Gestionar y consolidar el modelo de datos, asegurando la calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información procedente de diferentes fuentes y canales.
Automatizar el cálculo de rentabilidad, desarrollando modelos que permitan medir ingresos, costes y márgenes por cliente, producto, partner y segmento.
Desarrollar soluciones de Business Intelligence, creando dashboards e informes que faciliten el seguimiento del negocio y la toma de decisiones.
Monitorizar el rendimiento y los acuerdos con partners, garantizando el control de los modelos de revenue share y su correcta rentabilidad.
Definir y gestionar KPIs clave, proporcionando métricas fiables sobre rentabilidad, crecimiento, captación, retención y churn.
Generar insights de negocio, identificando oportunidades de optimización comercial, mejora de márgenes y crecimiento.




¿Qué valoramos de tu candidatura?




Posees Grado en Matemáticas, Estadística, Economía, Actuariales o disciplinas afines. Valorable formación de posgrado en Analítica de Datos, Business Intelligence, Big Data o áreas relacionadas.
Tienes experiencia de 3 a 5 años en Business Intelligence, Data Analytics o áreas de análisis de negocio. Cuentas con experiencia en entornos de pagos, fintech, banca, servicios financieros o sectores con elevado volumen transaccional será altamente valorada.
Además, experiencia demostrable en construcción de modelos de rentabilidad, reporting ejecutivo y explotación de datos.
SQL avanzado.
Python o R para análisis y tratamiento de datos.
Herramientas de visualización como Power BI o Tableau.
Diseño y explotación de Data Warehouses y modelos de datos.
Procesos ETL/ELT e integración de datos.
Modelado analítico y definición de KPIs.

Title: Lead Data Analyst
Description:
We are looking for a Lead Data Analyst, someone who is strong on in defining what healthy looks like, challenging investment decisions with data and setting the standard.


Your responsibilities:

Elevate the bar for the team, set methodology standards, challenge analytical approaches, and mentor analysts on quality, rigor.

Own the A/B test framework end to end: design, evaluation methodology, and standards for how results are interpreted and acted on

Translate business questions into data model requirements and coordinate with the Data Core team to build the layers that power analytical work across the game

Proactively surface insights for the product team, not just answering questions, but identifying what questions should be asked

Set and own the standards for how analytical findings reach designers, PMs, and Live Ops: format, cadence, and whether it actually influenced decisions

Experience in mobile gaming analytics, worked on live games across the full release cycle, with direct experience in retention and monetization mechanics influencing outcomes

Strong statistical foundations: designed and evaluated A/B tests end to end, and knows what to do when conditions aren't clean

Track record of building KPI frameworks from first principles, defining what matters for the specific game and context rather than defaulting to industry convention

Evidence-first: forms strong positions from data, defends them under pressure, but stays open to changing course when the evidence calls for it, the goal is to be correct, not just right.

Able to translate complex data into clear, actionable insights for both technical and non-technical audiences

Expert proficiency in SQL and either R or Python for data exploration and analysis

High autonomy, low maintenance: figures things out quickly, meticulous about what matters, moves with pragmatism and proactivity






Based Paris or Barcelona along with a hybrid working model

Title: ACES Analyst, ADAT
Description:
Description

We are looking for a Business Analyst to join the ACES Data Analytics Team (ADAT) , supporting operational excellence through data-driven dashboarding solutions. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and maintaining dashboards and underlying data pipelines that provide actionable insights to operations teams. You will work closely with stakeholders across the support function to translate business needs into analytics solutions that drive decision-making and continuous improvement.

Key job responsibilities

i) Design, build, and maintain dashboards and reporting solutions that support operational performance tracking and decision-making

ii) Write and optimize SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze data from multiple sources

iii) Develop Python scripts for data manipulation, automation, and advanced analytics

iv) Partner with operations stakeholders to understand business requirements and translate them into clear technical specifications

v) Perform root cause analysis on operational metrics, identifying trends, anomalies, and opportunities for improvement

vi) Ensure data accuracy and integrity across all reporting and dashboarding deliverables

vii) Proactively communicate progress, blockers, and risks to stakeholders and leadership

viii) Support KTLO (Keep The Lights On) activities for existing dashboards, including troubleshooting, bug fixes, and enhancements

A day in the life

In particular, Business Analysts will support the team with different types of analyses (from estimating the savings of a new project to calculating the drivers behind the Team’s performance) and work with various stakeholders in Amazon’s Operations. We are looking for profiles with analytics and communication skills, business sense and an excellent knowledge of Excel and the Microsoft Office package.

As a Business Analyst on our team, you own the full cycle from raw data to actionable insight. You write SQL queries to pull operational data from multiple sources, validate it, and transform it into something meaningful. When something looks off in the numbers, you investigate — tracing it back through the pipeline until you find the root cause and flag it to stakeholders before it becomes a problem.

You build and maintain dashboards in QuickSuite that operations teams rely on daily. That means designing layouts, connecting calculated fields, setting up filters, and making sure the right people see the right data at the right level of detail. You iterate on these based on feedback, always looking for ways to make the information clearer and more useful.

You also write Python scripts that automate repetitive work — data validations, scheduled extractions, report generation — things that used to take hours manually and now run in minutes. When a quick ad-hoc analysis comes in from a manager, you use Excel to pivot the data and deliver a clean summary without overengineering it.

Throughout all of this, you share what you find. You communicate insights clearly to stakeholders, walk them through what the data is telling us, and help them make decisions based on evidence rather than assumptions.

About The Team

Our team sits within the ACES organization and provides analytics and dashboarding solutions that support operational functions. We are a medium size, high-impact team focused on delivering clean, scalable, and well-documented analytics that enable data-driven decision-making across operations. We value seamless development practices, proactive communication, and a strong sense of ownership.

Basic Qualifications


Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related field
Experience in a business analyst, data analyst or equivalent role
Experience in scripting for automation (e.g. Python) and advanced SQL skills.
Knowledge of data visualization tools such as Quick Sight, Tableau, Power BI or other BI packages
iii) Proficiency in SQL for data extraction and analysis across large datasets
vi) Proficiency in Excel for ad-hoc analysis and reporting
vii) Strong communication skills with the ability to present insights to technical and non-technical audiences


Preferred Qualifications


Experience in a logistics/operations environment
Experience with Lean or Six Sigma analytical techniques
Knowledge of SQL/ETL
Experience working in a fast-paced and ambiguous environment
Experience in process design and documentation
Familiarity with Amazon's data ecosystem (Redshift, Andes, S3)

Title: Business Intelligence Analyst
Description:
About Thunes

Thunes is the Smart Superhighway for money movement around the world. Thunes’ proprietary Direct Global Network allows Members to make payments in real-time in over 140 countries and more than 90 currencies. Thunes’ Network connects directly to over 12 billion mobile wallets and bank accounts worldwide, via more than 350 different payment methods, such as GCash, M-Pesa, Airtel, MTN, Orange, JazzCash, Easypaisa, AliPay, WeChat Pay and many more.

Thunes’ Direct Global Network differentiates itself through its worldwide reach, in-house Smart Treasury Management Platform and Fortress Compliance Infrastructure, ensuring Members of the Network receive unrivalled speed, control, visibility, protection, and cost efficiencies when making real-time payments globally. Members of Thunes’ Direct Global Network include gig economy giants like Uber and Deliveroo, super-apps like Grab and WeChat, MTOs, fintechs, PSPs and banks.

Headquartered in Singapore, Thunes has offices in 15 locations, including Barcelona, Beijing, Dubai, London, Manila, Nairobi, Paris, Shanghai, Hong Kong, Miami, Johannesburg, Riyadh, San Francisco and Atlanta For more information, visit: https://www.thunes.com/

Context of the 12-months role

We are looking for a driven and product-minded BI Analyst who combines strong analytical skills with a genuine interest in solving real business problems through data.

In this role, you will turn complex data into clear, actionable insights that support better decision-making across the business. You will help identify product and operational pain points, improve day-to-day insight consumption for internal teams, and contribute to a strong data informed culture across the company.

You will work closely with data engineers to design, build, and maintain analytical solutions for key internal stakeholders across different functions, that improves our productivity, business performance, and customer experience.

Key Responsibilities


Partner with stakeholders across the business to understand reporting, analysis, and insight needs, and translate them into effective analytical solutions.
Build a strong understanding of key business processes, product flows, operational challenges, and performance metrics.
Design, develop, and maintain production-grade dashboards, reports, and analytical assets using Tableau and other relevant tools.
Write production-level SQL and Python to support analytics, reporting, data transformation, and scalable insight delivery.
Work closely with data engineering teams to ensure data sources are reliable, well-structured, and fit for analytical use.
Contribute to improving reporting standards, data definitions, and analytical best practices within the team.
Manage priorities effectively across requests, aligned with team direction and company priorities.



Professional Experience And Qualifications


Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Economics, or another quantitative field.
2-5 years of experience in a data, BI, analytics, or related role.
Strong hands-on experience writing production-level SQL.
Strong hands-on experience using Python for analysis, data processing, and analytical solution development.
Strong expertise in Tableau, including dashboard development, data source design, performance optimisation, and Tableau Online administration and management.
Proven ability to work with complex datasets and turn business questions into structured, actionable analysis.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to move from stakeholder requests to practical data solutions.
Good understanding of reporting design, data visualisation best practices, and how to present insights clearly for business users.
Strong attention to detail and commitment to data quality, accuracy, and reliability.
Able to communicate clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.



Preferred Qualifications


Experience in fintech, payments, financial services, or another fast-paced, data-rich environment.
Experience supporting multiple business functions and balancing different stakeholder needs in a structured way.
Strong stakeholder management skills, with the ability to gather requirements, align expectations, and communicate clearly throughout delivery.
Demonstrated business curiosity and a proactive approach to understanding how the business works beyond the data itself.
Strong sense of ownership, with the ability to work independently and follow through from problem understanding to solution delivery.

Title: Senior Business Analyst - CS Analytics

Kiwi.com is a leading global travel-tech company headquartered in the Czech Republic. Our innovative algorithm enables users to find better route options and prices other search engines can’t see, daily performing billions of price checks across 95% of global flight content. Are you bold, bright and curious? Join a global business that’s still got a start-up heart.

About Customer Support Analytics Team

We support our Customer Support department to turn complex operational data into thoughtful, high-impact decisions that enhance customer satisfaction and strengthen daily operations. Partnering closely across Product, Finance, and Operations, we build intuitive dashboards and data models to bring real-time visibility to friction points, tracking airline recovery and ensuring accurate, timely refunds. In our AI-native team, you will collaborate directly with key decision-makers, seeing firsthand how your shared insights make the customer journey measurably better.

What You Will Do


Support the analytical side of our refunds operation by building reliable data structures, tracking process flows, and partnering with Finance, Product, and Engineering to optimize airline recovery performance.

Identify inefficiencies across CS Operations and Refunds by acting as a collaborative process expert, leveraging AI tools to support and streamline daily team workflows.
Collaborate closely with Workforce Management and vendor partners to ensure they have accurate, trusted data for volume forecasting, productivity tracking, and headcount modeling.
Co-create automation processes alongside Engineering by evaluating expected efficiency gains and supporting smooth post-implementation transitions.

Connect with senior leadership by developing clear, empathetic, and data-backed narratives that articulate operational challenges while offering thoughtful solutions.

A proven track record in a business analytics role, with experience translating complex operational data into supportive business decisions—ideally within a Customer Support environment.
Strong proficiency in SQL, with confidence writing and managing your own queries, understanding underlying data structures, and supporting peers through code reviews.
Demonstrated experience with Data Visualization tools (such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI) to build, refine, and maintain accessible, insight-rich dashboards.

Title: Controller Data Analyst – Global Operations Controlling
Place: El Prat de Llobregat, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
G+D es un grupo tecnológico internacional de origen alemán, con más de 160 años de historia y presencia global. Nuestras soluciones hacen más seguros los pagos, las comunicaciones y las interacciones digitales que millones de personas utilizan cada día.




Buscamos incorporar un/a Controller a nuestro equipo de Global Operations Controlling en El Prat de Llobregat.




Si te interesa combinar Controlling, análisis de negocio y tecnología, y quieres utilizar los datos para mejorar la toma de decisiones y transformar la forma de trabajar de Finance, este puede ser tu próximo reto.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Darás soporte al Head of Global OPS Controlling, proporcionando análisis e información financiera de valor para la toma de decisiones y contribuyendo a desarrollar una función de Controlling cada vez más digital, automatizada y data-driven.




En tu día a día:

Participarás en cierres, presupuesto y forecast, realizando análisis de desviaciones entre actuals y planificación.
Analizarás costes, márgenes, rentabilidad y KPIs financieros y operativos, identificando riesgos y oportunidades.
Consolidarás el reporting financiero y análisis para management y stakeholders internacionales.
Diseñarás y desarrollarás dashboards en Power BI, automatizando procesos de reporting.
Trabajarás con diferentes fuentes de información utilizando Power Query, DAX y SQL.
Desarrollarás y mantendrás modelos de datos, asegurando su calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad.
Participarás en proyectos de automatización, digitalización y mejora continua dentro de Finance & Operations.




¿Qué buscamos?

Formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Finanzas, Matemáticas, Estadística o similar.
2-5 años de experiencia en Controlling, análisis financiero o reporting.
Experiencia avanzada con Power BI, DAX y Power Query.
Conocimientos de SQL y modelado de datos.
Nivel avanzado de Excel, incluyendo macros.
Experiencia trabajando con SAP u otros ERP.
Buen nivel de inglés para trabajar en un entorno internacional.

Y, sobre todo, buscamos una persona analítica, proactiva y orientada a resultados, capaz de convertir datos complejos en conclusiones claras y propuestas de mejora.




Será un plus si tienes...

Experiencia en multinacionales o proyectos de automatización financiera, certificaciones Power BI o conocimientos de Microsoft Fabric, Python, Power Automate, ETL o Data Warehouse.




¿Qué te ofrecemos?

Contrato indefinido y plan de formación anual.
Modelo híbrido con 2 días de home office. Jornada intensiva de verano.
Flexibilidad horaria: L-J 8:30-17:30 h y V 8:30-15:30 h, con una hora de flexibilidad de entrada y salida.
Retribución flexible: seguro médico, transporte, guardería y formación.
Parking y comedor de empresa subvencionado.
Un entorno internacional donde podrás trabajar en la intersección entre Finance, Operations y Data Analytics.

Title: Senior Digital Data Analyst (Marketing Intelligence)
Description:
Desde Timup, consultora de selección, estamos colaborando con una agencia creativa en la búsqueda de un/a Senior Marketing Analytics Specialist, una posición con recorrido hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Buscamos una persona que combine una sólida capacidad analítica con una visión estratégica del marketing y la comunicación. Alguien capaz de transformar datos en recomendaciones de negocio, ayudar a medir el impacto real de las campañas y convertirse en un partner de referencia tanto para clientes como para los equipos internos.

La persona incorporada tendrá un papel clave impulsando una cultura data-driven dentro de la organización, liderando proyectos de medición y contribuyendo a maximizar la efectividad de las estrategias de comunicación.




¿Cuál será tu misión?

Serás responsable de analizar el rendimiento de campañas y acciones de comunicación, tanto digitales como offline, convirtiendo los datos en insights que permitan tomar mejores decisiones de negocio. Además, liderarás la interlocución con clientes en todo lo relacionado con analítica y medición, participando activamente en la evolución del área.




Responsabilidades

Analizar el rendimiento de campañas de comunicación y marketing, evaluando su impacto sobre la marca y el negocio.

Diseñar, desarrollar e interpretar dashboards e informes ejecutivos para clientes y equipos internos.

Liderar la relación con clientes en materia de analítica, reporting y medición de resultados.

Integrar información procedente de diferentes fuentes para obtener una visión global del rendimiento de las acciones de marketing.

Colaborar estrechamente con equipos multidisciplinares para identificar oportunidades de optimización.

Impulsar el uso del análisis de datos como herramienta para mejorar la efectividad de las campañas y la toma de decisiones.

Participar en la evolución de metodologías y procesos de medición dentro de la compañía.




¿Qué buscamos?

Entre 3 y 5 años de experiencia en posiciones de Marketing Analytics, Data Analytics o Performance Analytics.

Experiencia previa en agencia o en entornos digitales de ritmo dinámico.

Dominio de herramientas de visualización de datos como Tableau (muy valorable), Power BI, Looker o Qlik.

Conocimientos sólidos de marketing digital, comunicación y medición de campañas.

Experiencia trabajando con SQL, análisis de datos y estadística aplicada.

Capacidad para sintetizar grandes volúmenes de información y convertirlos en recomendaciones accionables.

Excelentes habilidades de comunicación y presentación de resultados.

Nivel alto de inglés (C1).




Se valorará especialmente

Conocimientos de Python.

Experiencia con herramientas como Adverity, Supermetrics o Datorama.

Conocimientos de Social Listening (Brandwatch, Lumen/Talkwalker, Pulsar, entre otras).

Uso de herramientas de IA como Claude, Gemini o NotebookLM aplicadas al análisis de datos y automatización de procesos.




¿Qué ofrece la compañía?

Incorporación a una agencia creativa reconocida, con un entorno altamente colaborativo e innovador.

Posición con recorrido profesional y posibilidad de evolucionar hacia la coordinación del área de Analytics.

Horario flexible y jornada intensiva durante el verano.

Acceso a formación continua y desarrollo profesional.

Programas de bienestar y beneficios sociales.

Title: Senior Business Intelligence & Data Analyst
Description:
Bring more to life.

Are you ready to accelerate your potential and make a real difference within life sciences, diagnostics and biotechnology?

At Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, one of Danaher’s 15+ operating companies, our work saves lives—and we’re all united by a shared commitment to innovate for tangible impact.

You’ll thrive in a culture of belonging where you and your unique viewpoint matter. And by harnessing Danaher’s system of continuous improvement, you help turn ideas into impact – innovating at the speed of life.

As a global leader in clinical diagnostics, Beckman Coulter Diagnostics has challenged convention to elevate the diagnostic laboratory’s role in improving patient health for more than 90 years. Our diagnostic solutions are used in routine and complex clinical testing, and are used in hospitals, reference and research laboratories, and physician offices around the world. Every hour around the world, more than one million tests are run on Beckman Coulter Diagnostics systems, impacting 1.2 billion patients and more than three million clinicians per year. From uncovering the next clinical breakthrough, to rapid and reliable sample analysis, to more rigorous decision making—we are enabling clinicians to deliver the best possible care to their patients with improved efficiency, clinical confidence, adaptive collaboration, and accelerated intelligence.

Learn about the Danaher Business System which makes everything possible.

The Sr Business Intelligence and Data Analyst is responsible for designing, developing, and governing scalable business intelligence solutions and data architectures. The role enables data-driven decision-making across the EMEA commercial organization by transforming complex, multi-source data into actionable insights through robust data models, optimized pipelines, and Power BI reporting.

This position reports to the Head of Commercial Excellence and Business Analytics (EMEA) and is part of the EMEA Sales Operation and Enablement team and will be in Barcelona (Spain) or Prague (Czech Republic) and will be an on-site role.

In This Role, You Will Have The Opportunity To


Design and deliver end-to-end Power BI solutions, including robust data models, interactive dashboards, and scalable semantic layers (e.g., star schemas and data marts).
Build and optimize high-performance data architectures by integrating multiple enterprise sources (ERP, CRM, CPQ) and developing efficient SQL queries.
Establish and govern KPI frameworks to ensure consistency, reliability, and alignment across business reporting.
Drive data quality, governance, and best practices in data transformation, normalization, documentation, and access control.
Perform advanced analytics, including exploratory data analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling to support sales and performance tracking.


The Essential Requirements Of The Job Include


B.Sc./M.Sc. in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, Economics or related field.
Strong experience with Power BI (data modeling, DAX, Power Query, dashboard design).
Solid knowledge of data architecture principles (data modeling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing).
Proficiency in SQL and working with relational databases.
Experience integrating data from CRM systems (e.g., Salesforce), ERP, and other enterprise systems.


Travel, Motor Vehicle Record & Physical/Environment Requirements


Ability to travel 10%


It would be a plus if you also possess previous experience in:


Sales Operations, preferably in Sanitary/Pharmaceutical Sector is a plus
Lean Change Management Models, data-driven transformation and continuous improvement methodologies in fast-paced, evolving environments with shifting priorities
Experience with Lean or data-driven transformation methodologies is a plus.


Beckman Coulter Diagnostics, a Danaher operating company, offers a broad array of comprehensive, competitive benefits that add value to our lives. Whether it’s a health care program or paid time off, our programmes contribute to life beyond the job.

For more information, visit www.danaher.com.

Title: Senior Data Analyst (Growth)
Description:
⭐ Who we are

Lodgify is a fast-growing scale-up company leading the vacation rental industry. Backed by $30M in funding, our platform empowers property owners and managers worldwide to efficiently manage and grow their business through technology.

Headquartered in sunny Barcelona, we're now a team of 380+ people representing over 60 nationalities, united by a passion for transforming the future of short-term rentals.




⭐ Role Overview




The Growth Enablement Team is the connective tissue of our Growth organization: we don't optimize a single funnel stage, we build the foundations that let every Growth squad (Acquisition, Activation & Retention, Sales, and Partnerships) move faster, measure better, and experiment with confidence.

As a Senior Growth Data Analyst, you'll sit at the intersection of marketing technology, data engineering, and growth analytics, spearheading Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM), advanced data modeling, and campaign performance insights that directly shape multi-channel marketing investment and revenue growth.




You'll own advanced analytics frameworks end-to-end, mentor peers, and set the standard for data quality across the growth org.




⭐ How will you make an impact?

Marketing Mix Modelling (MMM): You design, calibrate, and maintain Marketing Mix Models to quantify cross-channel marketing performance and guide long-term media spend allocation.
Growth data modelling: You architect scalable data models and analytical schemas that integrate multi-channel marketing, web, and product telemetry into unified growth datasets. You have expertise in the technological stack with BigQuery as the warehouse, DBT for production-grade modelling, RudderStack for event streaming, and Omni as the self-serve BI layer.
Campaign performance & insight generation: You conduct deep-dive exploratory analytics across acquisition channels (paid search, paid social, organic) to surface high-leverage growth opportunities.
AI-enabled analytics and agentic automation: You actively use AI tools to accelerate analysis, automate recurring reporting workflows, and improve insight generation speed across the growth org. You contribute to Lodgify's AI Enablement programme by identifying and deploying analytics automation opportunities.
CRM and lifecycle analytics: You design and implement measurement and incrementality frameworks for event-driven lifecycle workflows, evaluating their short-, mid-, and long-term impact on customer activation, retention, and lifetime value.
GEO and AI search measurement: You ****design measurement frameworks for AI search visibility, tracking share of voice in LLM answer engines and attributing traffic contribution from GEO channels where traditional UTM attribution is structurally insufficient.
Data storytelling & executive presentations: You synthesise complex quantitative findings into clear visual artefacts and strategic narratives for marketing leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
Attribution and measurement: You own Lodgify's full measurement stack, spanning MMM as the strategic budget allocation layer, incrementally and geo-lift testing to validate true channel impact, and privacy-first server-side event tracking as the data collection standard. You design measurement approaches for AI search and GEO channels where UTM-based attribution is structurally insufficient
Strategic cross-functional alignment: You partner closely with Marketing, Product, and Finance teams to align growth analytics with core unit economics like CAC and LTV.
Data governance & analytics standards: You establish data documentation, reporting standards, and visualisation guidelines to raise overall analytical quality across the growth organisation.




⭐ What makes you a great fit:

Presentation and Influencing: Crafts compelling presentations that connect technical or functional insights to business outcomes, ensuring clarity and resonance across departments. Uses storytelling and analogies to align diverse stakeholders and drive consensus without formal authority. Persuades through evidence-backed recommendations while addressing potential concerns upfront. Shapes direction by influencing decisions in cross-functional initiatives through clear, confident communication.
Data-Driven Mindset: Synthesises complex datasets into concise insights that guide decision makers, e.g., highlighting trends, anomalies, and risks. Uses multiple data sources (quantitative & qualitative) to tell a coherent story, and distinguishes between correlation and causation. Applies strong judgment in interpreting incomplete or noisy data, and articulates limitations. Coaches others in data visualization and storytelling, raising the team’s overall data literacy.
Business Acumen: Translates strategic goals into operational decisions and trade-offs for own work. Anticipates business challenges by integrating customer insights, market trends, and internal data. Builds a solid understanding of how different departments contribute to commercial success. Advocates for initiatives with clearly articulated business impact.
Problem Solving: Anticipates problems before they escalate and proactively mitigates risks. Develops creative, workable solutions to complex, cross-functional challenges. Balances trade-offs between resource constraints, stakeholder needs, and long-term business goals. Critically analyses multiple sources of information, validating credibility before making decisions. Guides colleagues on structured problem-solving techniques and decision-making frameworks.
Stakeholder Management: Anticipates stakeholder concerns and proactively addresses them in planning and delivery. Navigates complex or conflicting stakeholder priorities by facilitating compromise grounded in data and shared outcomes. Builds long-term stakeholder trust through consistent, transparent communication and follow-through. Educates stakeholders on technical or operational constraints to manage expectations and build mutual understanding.
Analytics Expertise Direct hands-on experience with at least one of MMM or incrementality testing. Proven experience with marketing analytics, deep knowledge of CAC, LTV, ROAS, and multi-touch attribution to evaluate and optimise growth campaigns.
Growth Data Modelling - Ability to write advanced, production-grade code and build robust data models to transform raw marketing telemetry into scalable analytical structures. Incorporating a privacy-first tracking approaches




Why you’ll love us:

You’ll be part of a growing, dynamic company with a truly international team. At Lodgify, we are full of contagious energy, hard work, and passion for what we do. We celebrate diversity and are proud to acknowledge a variety of backgrounds, perspectives and skills in our team; committed to creating a workplace where everyone is heard and feels a sense of belonging.

What's in it for you?*

🏠 Remote Flexibility: The freedom to work from home any day that works for you.

🌴 Time to Recharge: 25 working days of paid vacation and Jornada Intensiva in August..

💊 Alan Health Insurance: Premium health, dental, and mental health support via Alan. Pre-existing conditions are covered.

😋 Meal Perk: €150/month allowance on your Alan card + 50% off Ametller Origen prepared dishes at the office.

💸 Tax-Free Savings: Increase your take-home pay by using Flexible Remuneration for extra meal costs (up to €70/mo) and public transport (up to €136/mo).

🖥️ Home Office Gear: We provide a table, ergonomic chair, and monitor for your home setup.

🇪🇸 Language Learning: Free Spanish classes.

🤑 Referrals: Cash rewards for bringing in new talent.

🌟 Social Life: Daily office breakfast and monthly team events

🎯 Dynamic Hub: A high-energy, inclusive environment designed for collaboration and connection with a team that represents over 60 countries.

*Benefits offered may differ based on the type of contract that is issued

So, what are you waiting for? Apply now!

All applications and CVs must be submitted in English 😉

Analizar, transformar y visualizar datos para generar insights accionables y mejorar la toma de decisiones de negocio dentro del sector bancario, trabajando de forma transversal con diferentes equipos y stakeholders.

Title: Senior Game Data Analyst
Description:
Who We Are

Let's have fun shaping your future!

We are Socialpoint, a world-renowned mobile game studio proudly part of the Zynga & Take-Two Interactive family. We’re the creators of hits like Dragon City, Two Dots, Top Troops, and Monster Legends, loved by hundreds of millions of players around the globe.We craft the best social games, bringing joy from Barcelona to the world. Now, we want to bring the world to Barcelona! At Socialpoint, work and play intertwine seamlessly, and we celebrate the diversity that makes us stronger. No matter who you are or where you’re from, you’re welcome here. Join us for a future where making games is as thrilling as playing them!

Position Overview

We’re looking for a Principal Data Analyst to join our Analytics team. In this senior role, you’ll be a key partner to our game teams, shaping product strategy and driving impactful data-driven decisions that improve our games, boost player engagement, and fuel business growth.

You’ll combine deep quantitative analysis, business acumen, and technical expertise to uncover insights that matter. As a Principal, you’ll also help elevate analytics standards across the company, mentor analysts, and champion a culture of data-informed decision-making.

What You'll Do


Help Shape the Game Strategy: Be a part of the development of data-driven strategies for top games, influencing product roadmaps, features, and monetization.
Player & Product Insights: Partner with cross-functional teams to analyze player behavior, economy trends, and product performance.
Experimentation & Modeling: Design A/B tests and build predictive models (e.g., churn, LTV, segmentation) to assess and forecast outcomes.
Leadership & Communication: Mentor analysts and present insights clearly to senior leadership through compelling storytelling and dashboards.
Data Culture & Infrastructure: Collaborate on improving data tools and pipelines while promoting data literacy and experimentation best practices.


What You Bring


Experience in analytics or data science roles, ideally in gaming, mobile apps, or digital products.
Strong business sense and product intuition; you understand how to prioritize what matters most.
Solid experience with A/B testing, causal inference, and experimentation design.
Strong background in applied statistics; experience with Bayesian methods is a plus.
Expert proficiency in SQL and Python for data exploration and analysis.
Excellent communication skills, with experience influencing senior stakeholders.

Description:
¡En K-LAGAN te estamos esperando para continuar creciendo juntos! Somos una empresa estratégica internacional de servicios tecnológicos, comprometida esencialmente con su equipo y con la sociedad. 🚀 Misión del puesto Como Data Analyst dentro del equipo central de plataforma de Datos e IA (Analytics Team), tu misión principal será transformar datos complejos en insights accionables que apoyen la toma de decisiones estratégicas. Serás una pieza clave dentro de la red de analistas de datos, actuando como referente en Power BI y Modelos Tabulares, impulsando la estandarización, la calidad del dato y el diseño de soluciones analíticas avanzadas a escala global.




📌 Responsabilidades principales

Desarrollo y Mejores Prácticas: Diseñar, implementar y mantener reportes/dashboards en Power BI, definiendo guías y estándares para modelado dimensional (Kimball, star schema), data marts y tecnologías asociadas (DAX, MDX, Azure Analysis Services, Azure Log Analytics/KQL).
Referente Técnico y Mentoring: Capacitar y dar soporte a los equipos de datos en el uso avanzado de Power BI, capacidades Premium/Embedded y Microsoft Fabric, actuando como experto ad-hoc para resolver flujos de datos y optimizar el rendimiento.
Evolución de la Plataforma BI: Contribuir al desarrollo e implantación del modelo de BI corporativo descentralizado y a la creación de sistemas analíticos avanzados en producción.
Comunidad de Datos (Guild): Participar activamente en la comunidad de analistas, fomentando la transferencia de conocimiento, la colaboración internacional y el crecimiento del ecosistema analítico.
Monitoreo y BAU: Supervisar actividades operativas, realizar tareas de mantenimiento/soporte (BAU) y generar informes sobre el rendimiento de la plataforma y la calidad de los datos.
Metodología Ágil: Trabajar en un entorno Agile (Scrum/Kanban) dentro de un equipo multicultural, traduciendo requisitos de negocio en soluciones técnicas claras (prototipos/mock-ups).




🎯 Requisitos

Experiencia: Mínimo 4 años de experiencia en entornos Big Data (Build & Run) y analítica de datos, preferiblemente en organizaciones multinacionales.
Power BI & Visualización: Experiencia avanzada y sólida demostrable en Power BI, modelos tabulares, DAX, MDX y Azure Analysis Services. Valorable conocimiento en Power BI Premium/Embedded capacity y Microsoft Fabric.
SQL & Programación: Dominio experto de SQL. Valorable conocimientos en Python y PowerShell.
Data Warehousing & Cloud: Conocimiento sólido en principios de Business Intelligence, modelado dimensional (Kimball, esquemas en estrella), Data Warehouses y Data Marts. Valorable experiencia o familiaridad con Azure Cloud Datalake, Databricks, Spark o NoSQL.
Herramientas y Metodologías: Deseable conocimiento del ciclo de vida del software (Git, CI/CD con Azure DevOps) y metodologías Agile/Scrum.
Idiomas: Inglés fluido obligatorio (C1) para entorno de trabajo internacional diario. Francés muy valorable (o disposición a aprenderlo).
Perfil: Mentalidad proactiva, orientada al cliente, espíritu colaborativo y habilidades pedagógicas/mentoras. Valorable experiencia previa en el sector asegurador, financiero o de asistencia.

Contrato indefinido y proyecto estable a largo plazo.
Modelo de trabajo híbrido en Barcelona.
Salario anual: 44.000 euros/aprox.
Horario flexible y conciliación.
Formación continua y plan de carrera personalizado.
Programa de reconocimiento 3 C’s (Compromiso, Comunicación y Orientación al Cliente).
