Title: Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst
Description:
Arxada is a global leader in innovative solutions that protect our world. Our groundbreaking technologies, in-depth regulatory know-how, manufacturing and process development help our customers to safeguard nutrition, health and infrastructure efficiently through chemistry and biotechnology that enhance sustainability. We offer a broad portfolio of ingredients and services for multiple end-markets that include Human Health & Nutrition, Home & Personal Care, Professional Hygiene, Paints & Coatings and Wood Protection.

With customers in more than 100 countries, the company achieved sales of CHF 2 billion in 2024. Headquartered in Basel (Switzerland), Arxada employs 3,200 associates across 24 production sites and 14 R&D centers, all committed to our customers’ success.

We are seeking a skilled and business-minded Global Business Intelligence Senior Analyst to join our Business Intelligence team in Barcelona. This is a business-facing role, not a pure IT development position, that combines strong technical Power BI expertise with commercial acumen and the ability to act as a true BI business partner. The Power BI Developer designs, builds, and maintains datasets, data models, and dashboards while working directly with functions across the business to understand their needs, challenge their requirements, and propose better ways to analyze data and measure performance. The role requires a solid understanding of the company’s core KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance, but not limited to these; and the ability to translate business questions into clear, decision-oriented analytics. This position partners with stakeholders across Finance, Commercial, Operations, and other functions, turning data into actionable insight.

Key Responsibilities


Design, build, and maintain Power BI datasets, semantic data models, reports, and dashboards using DAX and Power Query (M)
Develop, optimize, and document robust data models, ensuring performance, scalability, and a reliable single source of truth
Partner with business functions to gather, challenge, and refine reporting requirements, proposing better KPIs and smarter ways to analyze the data
Act as a BI business partner, running working sessions with stakeholders across functions to understand their priorities and translate them into analytical solutions
Define, standardize, and monitor core business KPIs (sales, margin, corporate finance, and beyond), ensuring consistency and a shared definition across reporting
Turn business questions into executive-ready dashboards and self-service analytics that drive decision making
Perform ad-hoc and deep-dive analysis, identifying trends, root causes, and opportunities, and surfacing actionable insights
Promote data literacy and the adoption of self-service analytics across the organization


Qualifications


Strong hands-on expertise in Power BI, including DAX, Power Query (M), dataset and data model design, and report/dashboard development
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure, interpret, and communicate complex data
Solid understanding of core business KPIs, particularly sales, margin, and corporate finance
Strong business acumen, with the ability to engage, challenge, and advise stakeholders across different functions — this is a hybrid business-and-technical role, not a pure IT developer position
Proven experience in a similar BI / analytics role (~3 years)
Strong communication skills, with the ability to explain complex data insights to non-technical stakeholders and lead requirement-gathering discussions
Proficiency in Excel
Experience in data modeling, data analysis, and data visualization
Fluency in English is a must (written and spoken)
Strong attention to detail and accuracy
Ability to work independently and manage multiple stakeholders and priorities simultaneously
Based in, or willing to relocate to, Barcelona


You will be joining a highly motivated and skilled team, providing a great environment to learn and grow. If you love working with data, building insights, and partnering with the business to drive better decisions, this is the position for you. We value a proactive approach and encourage continuous learning and development, ensuring that you will have ample opportunities to enhance your skills and contribute to our success.

Arxada has world class offerings in two distinct areas:

Microbial Control Solutions (MCS) focuses on threats posed by microorganisms to people and planet through five distinct business lines including Professional Hygiene, Home & Personal Care, Wood Protection, Paints & Coatings and Material Protection.

Nutrition, Care & Environmental (NCE), meanwhile, provides materials used to manufacture composites for electronics, aerospace and other markets, as well as vitamins and nutritional ingredients, chemicals and performance intermediates, and raw materials for a wide range of high-performance applications.

Arxada is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, status as a qualified individual with disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

Title: Data Analyst (CRM)
Description:
We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance


Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs


Experimentation Design & Governance


Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations


Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights


Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns


Data Integrity & Targeting Validation


Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch


What We’re Looking For


4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.


Technical Skills


SQL (required)
Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)
Basic understanding of data pipelines and data quality checks


About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. We are looking for Data Analyst (CRM), to join our team in Barcelona.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.

What Will You Do

The CRM Analyst is the measurement and intelligence engine of the central CRM organization. Operating across all game titles, this person pulls, verifies, and reports on campaign performance; tracks trends; and ensures experimentation is structured to produce reliable, actionable results. Critically, they look beyond individual game performance to surface portfolio-wide segment insights - understanding how key player cohorts like VIPs, regular customers, new players, and conversion targets perform across the full game catalog.

Campaign Reporting & Performance

  • Pull and verify campaign data from the CRM platform and downstream analytics systems, reconciling any discrepancies
  • Produce regular campaign performance reports for each game team and portfolio-level summaries for the Director of CRM
  • Track trends over time — open rates, click rates, conversion, retention impact — and flag anomalies or degradation
  • Create and maintain dashboards that give CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs visibility into the performance of their communication programs

Experimentation Design & Governance

  • Support CRM/Lifecycle Lead PMs in designing A/B and multivariate tests, ensuring appropriate sample sizes, holdout groups, and clean control conditions
  • Maintain an experimentation log across all games to prevent conflicting tests and ensure results can be interpreted confidently
  • Review proposed experiments for methodological soundness before launch
  • Analyze and present experiment results with clear, actionable recommendations

Cross-Portfolio Segment Insights

  • Define and maintain segment definitions across the portfolio (e.g., VIP, Regular Customer, New Player, Lapsed, Conversion Candidate)
  • Track how these segments behave and respond to CRM across multiple titles, identifying patterns and outliers
  • Produce regular cross-game segment reports that help the Director of CRM and game teams understand what works universally versus what is title-specific
  • Identify high-value segment opportunities that are underserved by current campaigns

Data Integrity & Targeting Validation

  • Validate that targeting attributes used in campaigns are correctly populated and reliably representing the intended audience
  • Partner with Data Engineering to surface data quality issues and advocate for fixes
  • Verify that audience sizes match expectations prior to campaign launch

What We’re Looking For

  • 4+ years in marketing analytics, CRM analytics, or a related data role - ideally in a behavior-based vs transactional environment - like gaming or live services.
  • Proficiency with SQL and at least one BI or reporting tool (e.g., Looker, Tableau, Mode, or equivalent)
  • Experience working with CRM or marketing automation platforms to extract and interpret campaign data
  • Experience with both performance data and attribution data and able to ensure appropriate tracking is in place.
  • Ability to represent data needs to engineers if necessary data options are not available.
  • Understanding of A/Bn testing methodology, statistical significance, and experiment design across a complex set of overlapping campaigns.
  • Ability to communicate data findings clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience in games, apps, or a retention-driven consumer product is a strong plus
  • Comfortable managing multiple reporting workstreams simultaneously across different game teams
  • Experience in gaming as a player or operations manager preferred.

Technical Skills

  • SQL (required)
  • Excel / Google Sheets (advanced functions, pivot tables)
  • BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Amplitude, etc.)
  • Familiarity with event tracking tools (Segment, Snowflake, BigQuery, etc.)

Title: Developer & Data Analyst
Description:
Con más de 50 años de trayectoria y un equipo de más de 500 profesionales comprometidos, el Grupo CHG / Oliva Nova es un referente empresarial que integra compañías líderes en los sectores inmobiliario, turístico, de restauración y de eventos deportivos en un entorno privilegiado entre Denia y Gandía. Desde 1972, el grupo se enfoca en desarrollar un proyecto en constante crecimiento que combina excelencia residencial, servicios turísticos de primer nivel y una amplia oferta de ocio y deporte.

Para reforzar nuestro equipo de IT, buscamos un/a Developer & Data Analyst con perfil técnico, analítico y orientado a la mejora continua de nuestros procesos y sistemas de datos.




MISIÓN DEL PUESTO

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener las soluciones de datos e integración del Grupo, garantizando la calidad, disponibilidad y explotación eficiente de la información para la toma de decisiones del negocio.




RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES

Mantener y evolucionar los desarrollos existentes sobre el ERP corporativo, resolviendo incidencias y dando soporte al equipo de IT.

Integrar el ERP con sistemas verticales y aplicaciones de terceros mediante Web Services y APIs.

* Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT) con SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) para la consolidación e integración de información entre plataformas.

* Desarrollar dashboards interactivos y cuadros de mando ejecutivos en Power BI para distintas áreas del negocio.

* Automatizar procesos de reporting mediante T-SQL avanzado y procedimientos almacenados.

* Mantener actualizada la documentación técnica de arquitecturas, flujos y soluciones implementadas.




REQUISITOS DEL PUESTO

Formación:

* Grado o Ingeniería en Informática, Ingeniería de Software, Sistemas de Información o similar.




Conocimientos sólidos en:

Desarrollo en C# / .NET con Visual Studio.

T-SQL avanzado: consultas complejas, procedimientos almacenados y optimización de rendimiento.

* SQL Server: Integration Services (SSIS / paquetes DTSX) y Reporting Services (SSRS).

* Power BI: modelado de datos, DAX, publicación y administración de workspaces.

* Azure Database Services.

* Integración de sistemas mediante Web Services / REST APIs.




Valorable experiencia o conocimientos en:

Certificación o experiencia en SAP S/4HANA.

Otras bases de datos relacionales o NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).

* Azure Data Factory u otros servicios cloud de datos.




Experiencia mínima:

* Preferiblemente entre 2 y 4 años en un puesto similar.




OFRECEMOS

Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.

Incorporación a un grupo empresarial sólido y en crecimiento.

* Oportunidades de formación continua en nuevas tecnologías.

* Entorno profesional colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.

* Desarrollo profesional real dentro del área de IT.




¿Tienes visión analítica, pasión por los datos y disfrutas convirtiendo información en decisiones? Únete a Grupo CHG y forma parte de la transformación digital de un grupo con proyección internacional.

Title: Business Intelligence
Description:
En Rankia creemos que una buena salud financiera contribuye a mejorar el bienestar físico y mental de las personas. Desde nuestros inicios en 2003 ayudamos a las personas a alcanzar la mejor salud financiera en cada etapa de sus vidas: desde la primera cuenta nómina, pasando por el ahorro y la inversión y la compra de una vivienda, hasta la planificación de la jubilación.




Nuestro compromiso con la comunidad —información financiera transparente, objetiva, independiente y accesible— nos ha llevado a ser el portal de referencia del sector. Contamos con una plataforma multicanal (web, eventos y contenido audiovisual) presente en 20 países, además de Rankia Pro, nuestro portal para profesionales del mundo inversor.


El equipo


Formarás parte del equipo de AI & Data, un grupo cercano y colaborativo que da soporte al resto de departamentos e implementa soluciones propias.


Tu misión


Poseer el ciclo completo del dato económico y de audiencia del grupo:





Extraerlo de fuentes heterogéneas: el ERP (Odoo), la base de datos de producto, las plataformas publicitarias, GA4, Search Console y hojas de cálculo puente donde el negocio vuelca información manual.


Modelarlo en dbt sobre BigQuery, normalizando lógicas de negocio que hoy son inconsistentes entre departamentos, países y webs.


Traducirlo: convertir la contabilidad analítica al lenguaje del negocio (departamento, área, país, partner, canal) para que la dirección de la empresa pueda leerlo.


Automatizarlo: servicios en Cloud Run / Cloud Functions y scripts que generan los reportes recurrentes sin intervención manual.


Gobernarlo: decidir quién ve qué, con permisos y filtros por rol, país y segmento.


Documentarlo como artefactos trazables, para que el conocimiento no viva solo en una cabeza.





Todo bajo una regla innegociable: nada se entrega si no cuadra al dígito con la fuente oficial, y los reportes son completos pero honestos sobre su fiabilidad.


Cómo será tu día a día


El día a día de este puesto se centra en la ingeniería analítica de principio a fin: diseñar y evolucionar la arquitectura de datos financieros para alimentar reportes clave, realizar el modelado y gobierno de datos mediante dbt, y gestionar el ciclo de vida completo de los cuadros de mando. Además, implica una labor crítica de auditoría forense para resolver discrepancias en los datos, actuando en un papel de interlocución estratégica con la dirección para proponer mejoras de procesos y automatizaciones que transformen la información en decisiones de negocio fiables.




En tu día a día darás soporte a los equipos de negocio en cuanto a medición y visualización de datos vitales para ellos. Aquí tendrás que demostrar que conoces todo el proceso de extracción y depuración de cada dato.


¿Qué necesitas para que hagamos match?


Ingeniería de datos





Vibe coding: usar IA como multiplicador real en el día a día —modelos dbt, scripts de reporte, consultas— con criterio para auditar lo que genera antes de que llegue a un reporte de dirección.


SQL avanzado y experiencia real optimizando sobre un warehouse columnar (BigQuery preferentemente): particionado, clustering y control del coste por escaneo.


Modelado analítico con dbt: diseño en capas, estrategias de incrementalidad, tests y documentación.


Autonomía end-to-end: montar tus propias ingestas (ETL/ELT tipo Airbyte, integraciones directas con APIs REST) sin esperar a que alguien te prepare el dato.


Cloud sobre GCP: desplegar y mantener servicios (Cloud Run, Cloud Functions), gestionar service accounts, credenciales y scopes.


Python aplicado a automatización y generación de reportes (pandas, openpyxl).





Negocio y medición





Analítica web y de marketing digital: atribución, arquitecturas de UTM, tracking, cálculo de ROI/ROAS — y criterio propio para definir esas reglas, no solo para aplicarlas.


Entender cómo miden Google Ads y Meta Ads, y por qué su dato nunca cuadra con el contable.


Soltura con Looker / Data Studio como capa de salida, incluyendo permisos y filtros de seguridad por rol.





Forma de trabajar





Rigor con la calidad del dato y honestidad sobre la fiabilidad de cada número.


Capacidad de explicar de dónde sale un número a un perfil no técnico sin perder precisión, y paciencia para hacerlo las veces que haga falta.


Nivel intermedio de inglés.



Y estaría genial si además tuvieras...



Experiencia trabajando contra un ERP (Odoo especialmente).


Google Apps Script y sincronización bidireccional entre hojas de cálculo y el warehouse.


Diseño de acceso al dato: permisos a nivel de tabla o row-level según rol, país o departamento.


Haber trabajado con datos de monetización de tráfico o afiliación (CPC, CPL, CPA, FTD) y con detección de tráfico no humano.


Interés por el mundo de la inversión y las finanzas.



¿Qué ofrecemos?


Flexibilidad horaria: organiza tu jornada según tus necesidades ( ¡viernes por la tarde libre!)




Modelo híbrido (3+2): puesto de trabajo en Valencia, 3 días en la oficina y 2 desde casa.




Un merecido descanso: 22 días de vacaciones, 14 festivos, 4 festivos de empresa y tiempo libre en Nochebuena y Nochevieja.




Crecimiento profesional: acceso a nuestro Plan de Formación interno y externo.




Plan de compensación flexible: seguro médico, ticket restaurante, ticket guardería y tarjeta de transporte.




Celebra tu cumpleaños: viernes libre en la semana de tu cumpleaños.




Crea vínculos: varias actividades de team-building al año.


Proceso de selección


Además de la entrevista técnica, el proceso incluye un caso práctico corto sobre un problema real (un cuadre que no cuadra) para que veas cómo es el trabajo antes de decidir, y para que nosotros veamos cómo razonas cuando el dato no encaja.




¡Esperamos contar contigo para formar parte del equipo de Rankia!

Title: Data Analyst II - Treasury
Description:
Ebury helps ambitious businesses unlock global growth, and we take the same approach with our people. We encourage innovation and movement, collaboration and problem-solving, and foster an environment where everyone can feel they belong, are valued, supported and empowered to succeed.

If you’re a collaborator who wants to help transform how businesses operate globally, get in touch - we’d love to discuss how Ebury can accelerate your career so you can shape the future.

Data Analyst - Treasury

Location: Málaga or Madrid (Spain) - Hybrid: 4 days in the office, 1 day working from home per week

Ebury’s strategic growth plan would not be possible without our Data Analytics & Reporting team and we are seeking a Data Analyst to join our Treasury domain!

Our data mission is to develop and maintain Ebury’s Data Platform and serve it to the whole company. This platform is the backbone of Ebury: it supports internal decision making, allows us to monitor our Treasury positions and risks, comply with regulatory reporting obligations and enables commercial opportunities globally.

The Data team works closely with Treasury, Product and Tech teams to coordinate and implement data analysis initiatives helping the Cash management, ALM and Treasury Reporting teams. Some of the projects we are currently working on include: MtM valuations reconciliation with our Treasury reporting system to ensure completeness and accuracy in our Financial statements, cash operational charges data analysis to reduce Treasury costs, liquidity data analysis to help ALM team manage daily liquidity obligations, and building AI agentic workflows to automate routine data operations and decision support, and many many more!

As part of the team you will


Work closely with the rest of the Data Analysts, Analytics Engineers, Data Engineering, Treasury and Product teams
Be responsible for modelling data in our collaborative data platform to perform critical Treasury data analysis and build reports and reconciliations for the Treasury domain
Manage end-to-end treasury solutions across all jurisdictions of the company from requirements gathering, building optimised data models and delivering the reports to our treasury stakeholders and auditors
Maintain and build dashboards and visualisations on the data platform using our BI tools for Treasury teams to monitor reporting and controls


What we’re looking for


2+ years of experience in Data/Business Analytics - applied to Treasury or Finance is a plus!
Advanced SQL skills - must be able to read and write complex SQL queries
Experience with our modern data stack tools (a plus!) We use dbt, Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, DataStudio), Sigma
Strong problem solving and analytical skills with excellent attention to detail
The ability to manage, organise and present data in a clear, concise and actionable format
Experience working with Python is a plus
Comfortable working in a fast-paced and demanding work environment
Track record of working autonomously with time management skills
Fluency in English
Financial Services and Capital Markets Experience (FX, Payments, Money Markets, Treasury Management, etc) is a good plus!


What Ebury offers you


Competitive salary conditions

HTML:
Data analisten…Wij maken graag tijd voor jullie vrij. Voor diverse organisaties zoeken wij met regelmaat de beste data analisten die er zijn. Dit betreffen zowel vaste functies als interim opdrachten.

Ben jij als data analist op zoek naar een nieuwe uitdaging en herken je jezelf in onderstaand profiel? Wij komen graag in contact met jou!

data analist

  • Het definiëren en meten van de KPI’s t.b.v. websites, campagnes en andere online initiatieven;
  • Het waarborgen van de inrichting van het webanalyse pakket;
  • Het opzetten en uitvoeren van analyses van online marketing acties en dit vertalen naar actionable data;
  • Het ontwikkelen en onderhouden van dashboards en standaard rapportages, op basis van de behoeften van de verschillende afdelingen;
  • Het verzorgen van analyses en rapportages bij ad-hoc acties;
  • Pijnpunten opsporen in de verschillende customer journeys t.b.v. conversieoptimalisatie;
  • In overleg met de conversieoptimalisatie expert analyseren van online gebruikers onderzoeken, MVT en A/B testing;
  • Het correct meten bij de implementatie van nieuwe functionaliteiten en/of nieuwe websites;
  • Het testen van nieuwe versies van de websites op het gebied van webanalyse;
  • Samenwerking met de afdeling online marketing en marketing intelligence voor optimalisering van campagnes en product propositie.

wie ben jij?

Als data analist beschik je over een afgeronde HBO/WO opleiding en heb je minimaal 2 jaar relevante werkervaring op het gebied van data analyse, bij voorkeur in een grote E-Commerce omgeving.

Je bent een zelfstarter, analytisch sterk, oplossingsgericht, proactief en vernieuwend. Ervaring met de inrichting van een webanalysepakket (bij voorkeur Omniture) is gewenst. Andere sleutelwoorden zijn: gemotiveerd, enthousiast, verantwoordelijkheid en communicatief.

Title: Analista de Datos
Description:
¡En Neural buscamos un/a Analista de Datos! 🌟

¿Quiénes somos? 🏢

Nuestra misión es clara: mejorar la calidad de vida de las personas a través de la neurorrehabilitación, el acompañamiento en salud mental y la atención a la infancia con trastornos del neurodesarrollo.

¿Qué buscamos? 🔍

Para seguir creciendo, necesitamos incorporar a una persona que comparta nuestra visión, buscamos un Analista de Datos que transforme datos operativos y de negocio en información accionable. Trabajará junto a equipos de tecnología y negocio para diseñar métricas, construir cuadros de mando y dar soporte a la toma de decisiones.

¿Cuáles serán tus funciones? 📝


Recopilar, depurar y modelar datos procedentes de múltiples fuentes y plataformas.
Diseñar y mantener cuadros de mando e informes (Power BI / equivalente) para las unidades de negocio.
Analizar tendencias, incidencias y patrones de uso para anticipar problemas de forma proactiva.
Definir y calcular KPIs de servicio (SLA, capacidad, utilización) y de negocio.
Automatizar consultas y procesos repetitivos de reporting mediante SQL y scripting.
Documentar especificaciones de datos y garantizar la calidad e integridad de la información.
Colaborar con Business Analysts, arquitectos y equipos de proyecto para alinear objetivos y entregables.


¿Qué ofrecemos? 📃


Contrato indefinido
Jornada laboral completa y flexible, distribuida de lunes a viernes
Jornada intensiva en julio y agosto
Plan de carrera, formación y desarrollo profesional
Salario a convenir


¿Dónde?📍

Nuestras oficinas centrales se encuentran en Valencia (Polígono Vara de Quart).

¿Te apetece formar parte de nuestro equipo? 🚀

¿Te interesa participar en este proyecto? Si es así y cumples con los requisitos indicados, no dudes en inscribirte a esta oferta de empleo.

Requisitos mínimos


Grado profesional/universitario con 4-6 años de experiencia en analítica de datos o roles equivalentes.
Dominio de SQL y de al menos una herramienta de visualización (Power BI, Tableau o similar).
Experiencia en modelado de datos, ETL y tratamiento de grandes volúmenes de información.
Conocimiento de estadística descriptiva y capacidad de análisis de tendencias.
Buenas habilidades de comunicación para traducir datos en recomendaciones de negocio.


Competencias deseables:


Python o R para análisis avanzado y automatización.
Experiencia con plataformas cloud (AWS, Azure o GCP) y servicios de datos gestionados.
Conocimiento de gobierno del dato y buenas prácticas de seguridad de la información.

English level B2.

Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones de análisis y visualización de datos con Power BI.

Documentar los desarrollos y colaborar con usuarios y equipos técnicos.

Capacidad para entender necesidades de negocio y trasladarlas a modelos y soluciones de datos.
Persona autónoma, analítica y con ganas de seguir desarrollándose técnicamente.

Buscamos una persona con buenas bases técnicas, capacidad analítica y orientación a negocio, capaz de transformar datos en soluciones que ayuden a tomar mejores decisiones.


¿Qué haras?


  • Diseñar y desarrollar soluciones de análisis y visualización de datos con Power BI.
  • Crear y mantener modelos de datos y KPIs.
  • Trabajar con SQL para extracción, transformación y análisis de información.
  • Diseñar y mantener procesos ETL/ELT e integraciones entre diferentes fuentes de datos.
  • Participar en la evolución de nuestra plataforma de datos dentro del ecosistema Microsoft / Azure.
  • Analizar necesidades de negocio y convertirlas en soluciones de datos.
  • Garantizar la calidad, consistencia y trazabilidad de la información.
  • Documentar los desarrollos y colaborar con usuarios y equipos técnicos.


¿Qué buscamos?


  • Aproximadamente 3–5 años de experiencia trabajando en proyectos de Data Analytics, BI o Data Engineering.
  • Buen nivel de SQL.
  • Experiencia trabajando con Power BI, incluyendo modelado de datos, Power Query y DAX.
  • Conocimientos de procesos ETL/ELT y transformación de datos.
  • Experiencia trabajando dentro del ecosistema de datos de Microsoft.
  • Capacidad para entender necesidades de negocio y trasladarlas a modelos y soluciones de datos.
  • Persona autónoma, analítica y con ganas de seguir desarrollándose técnicamente.


Valoraremos especialmente


No es necesario dominar todas estas tecnologías. Valoraremos experiencia o conocimientos en alguna de ellas:


  • Microsoft Fabric
  • Azure Data Factory
  • Azure Synapse Analytics
  • Azure Databricks
  • Python / PySpark
  • Arquitecturas Lakehouse
  • Azure DevOps / Git
  • Certificaciones oficiales de Microsoft relacionadas con Data & Analytics

  • Incorporación a proyectos donde el dato tiene un impacto directo en el negocio.
  • Posibilidad de trabajar tanto en la capa de Analytics como en Data Engineering.
  • Desarrollo profesional dentro del ecosistema Microsoft Data & AI.
  • Formación y posibilidad de evolucionar hacia tecnologías como Microsoft Fabric y Azure.

Title: Developer & Data Analyst
Description:
Con más de 50 años de trayectoria y un equipo de más de 500 profesionales comprometidos, el Grupo CHG / Oliva Nova es un referente empresarial que integra compañías líderes en los sectores inmobiliario, turístico, de restauración y de eventos deportivos en un entorno privilegiado entre Denia y Gandía. Desde 1972, el grupo se enfoca en desarrollar un proyecto en constante crecimiento que combina excelencia residencial, servicios turísticos de primer nivel y una amplia oferta de ocio y deporte.




Para reforzar nuestro equipo de IT, buscamos un/a Developer & Data Analyst con perfil técnico, analítico y orientado a la mejora continua de nuestros procesos y sistemas de datos.




MISIÓN DEL PUESTO

Diseñar, desarrollar y mantener las soluciones de datos e integración del Grupo, garantizando la calidad, disponibilidad y explotación eficiente de la información para la toma de decisiones del negocio.




RESPONSABILIDADES PRINCIPALES




Mantener y evolucionar los desarrollos existentes sobre el ERP corporativo, resolviendo incidencias y dando soporte al equipo de IT.
Integrar el ERP con sistemas verticales y aplicaciones de terceros mediante Web Services y APIs.

* Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos (ETL/ELT) con SQL Server Integration Services (SSIS) para la consolidación e integración de información entre plataformas.

* Desarrollar dashboards interactivos y cuadros de mando ejecutivos en Power BI para distintas áreas del negocio.

* Automatizar procesos de reporting mediante T-SQL avanzado y procedimientos almacenados.

* Mantener actualizada la documentación técnica de arquitecturas, flujos y soluciones implementadas.




REQUISITOS DEL PUESTO

Formación:




* Grado o Ingeniería en Informática, Ingeniería de Software, Sistemas de Información o similar.




Conocimientos sólidos en:




Desarrollo en C# / .NET con Visual Studio.
T-SQL avanzado: consultas complejas, procedimientos almacenados y optimización de rendimiento.

* SQL Server: Integration Services (SSIS / paquetes DTSX) y Reporting Services (SSRS).

* Power BI: modelado de datos, DAX, publicación y administración de workspaces.

* Azure Database Services.

* Integración de sistemas mediante Web Services / REST APIs.




Valorable experiencia o conocimientos en:




Certificación o experiencia en SAP S/4HANA.
Otras bases de datos relacionales o NoSQL (PostgreSQL, MongoDB, etc.).

* Azure Data Factory u otros servicios cloud de datos.




Experiencia mínima:




* Preferiblemente entre 2 y 4 años en un puesto similar.




OFRECEMOS




Contrato indefinido a jornada completa.
Incorporación a un grupo empresarial sólido y en crecimiento.

* Oportunidades de formación continua en nuevas tecnologías.

* Entorno profesional colaborativo y orientado a la innovación.

* Desarrollo profesional real dentro del área de IT.




¿Tienes visión analítica, pasión por los datos y disfrutas convirtiendo información en decisiones? Únete a Grupo CHG y forma parte de la transformación digital de un grupo con proyección internacional.

Title: Senior Web Data Analyst (all genders)
Description:
BESTSECRET is the leading European online destination for premium and luxury off-price fashion. The Group offers its members in 28 countries across Europe a superior brand portfolio complemented by a high-end shopping experience. At the same time, BESTSECRET enables its brand partners to clear overstock at scale with minimum visibility and maximum brand equity protection. The unique business model is based on its closed character with an invitation-only customer membership, longstanding brand partner and customer relationships, combined with a tech-focused mindset. BESTSECRET has a strong track record of profitable growth over many years. It generated revenues of EUR 1,533.7 million in 2025 and employs around 2,200 people from over 90 nations. The Group draws on a heritage of 100 years in the textile and fashion industry and today is owned by Permira Funds and the founding families Schustermann and Borenstein.

Join our growing tech hub in Málaga and become part of an international team driving data-informed decision-making across BESTSECRET. As a Senior Web Data Analyst, you will be a core member of the Onsite Analytics team, working alongside the Director and 3 Senior peers to deliver critical insights that shape our business strategy. You'll own complex data projects from conception to delivery, translating raw data into actionable intelligence that empowers stakeholders across buying, product, and commercial teams.

In this role, you'll bridge the gap between technical data engineering and strategic business impact, ensuring that our premium fashion platform leverages data as a competitive advantage. Your work will directly influence purchasing decisions, optimize member experiences, and support the scaling of our profitable growth model.

Your Responsibilities


Design, build, and optimize data models and pipelines using SQL and Python to support analytics workflows at scale.
Develop and maintain Business Intelligence visualizations and dashboards that enable data-driven decision-making across the organization.
Plan and execute A/B testing frameworks to validate hypotheses and measure impact across product and commercial initiatives.
Coordinate analytics projects with cross-functional stakeholders, translating complex technical concepts into clear insights for non-technical audiences.
Manage Big Data workflows and ensure data quality, reliability, and performance across our platform.
Take ownership of analytical challenges, demonstrating initiative in problem-solving and continuous improvement.
Contribute to team culture through knowledge sharing, code reviews, and mentoring of junior team members.


Your Qualifications


3–5 years of professional experience with SQL and Python in a data analytics or data engineering role.
Proven expertise in data modelling and the ability to design scalable data structures.
Strong hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools and creating impactful visualizations.
Demonstrated proficiency with A/B testing, including experimental design and statistical validation.
Experience with Git version control and collaborative development practices.
Solid background with Big Data workflows and distributed data processing.
Excellent project coordination and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to communicate complex ideas clearly to non-technical partners.
Self-directed learner with a proactive, critical mindset and strong agile working mentality.
Fluent English skills (written and spoken).
Experience with data orchestration tools (Cron, Apache Airflow) is a plus.
Knowledge of dbt or similar data transformation frameworks is a plus.
Familiarity with tools like Power BI, Growthbook, Jira, or Confluence is a plus.
Background in statistics or quantitative research is a strong plus.
Experience implementing AI agents or modern AI tools in analytical workflows is a plus.


Our Benefits


Employee discount on our platform
Access to a corporate benefits platform with discounts on travel, hotels, electronics, and more
Private healthcare (tax-free), with the option to include your family
30 days of paid vacation per year plus local bank holidays
Hybrid work model (1–2 days per week in the office in Málaga)
Flexible working hours with core collaboration time (10:00 – 16:00)
Tailored development opportunities, including “TechFriday” – a monthly day dedicated to learning and innovation
Reduced working hours in August (summer schedule)
Choice of equipment: MacBook or Windows laptop
;


At BESTSECRET, diversity isn't just a trend – it's our professional philosophy. We are dedicated to cultivating an inclusive workplace where everyone's unique talents and backgrounds are celebrated. Applicants from all backgrounds, experiences and perspectives are welcome to join us in our mission towards a more vibrant and inclusive future.

Title: Revenue Analyst
Description:
¿Quiénes somos? 🌊⚓

En el Grupo Baleària somos más de 4.000 profesionales que trabajamos para conectar territorios y personas a través del transporte marítimo de pasajeros, vehículos y mercancías y de soluciones logísticas terrestres y marítimas.

Somos un grupo en constante crecimiento, comprometido con la innovación, la sostenibilidad y la excelencia operativa, que desarrolla su actividad en diferentes territorios y mercados.

Pero nuestro verdadero motor son las personas. Por eso, apostamos por el desarrollo profesional, el aprendizaje y el bienestar de nuestros equipos, creando oportunidades para crecer y evolucionar dentro de la compañía.

Este compromiso con las personas nos ha permitido obtener la certificación Top Employer 2026, revalidando por tercer año consecutivo nuestro reconocimiento como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar.

#WeAreBalearia #TopEmployer

🔎¡Abrimos vacante estable como Revenue Analyst para nuestro centro de trabajo en Valencia y queremos que tú seas parte de nuestro equipo!

Si te apasiona el análisis de datos, la optimización de ingresos y el sector turístico, esta puede ser una gran oportunidad para desarrollar tu carrera profesional en una de las compañías más innovadoras del sector marítimo.

¿Cómo será tu día a día?

La Persona Seleccionada Se Responsabilizará De Las Siguientes Funciones


Realizar el seguimiento y análisis de los precios medios por línea, acomodación, tipo de vehículo y temporada.
Monitorizar los precios y estrategias comerciales de otras compañías del sector transporte para identificar oportunidades y mantener una posición competitiva.
Gestionar la apertura, limitación y seguimiento de plazas promocionales y descuentos en función de la demanda y los objetivos comerciales.
Analizar la ocupación de las diferentes acomodaciones y apoyar la planificación de la oferta disponible.
Elaborar informes, análisis y reporting que permitan realizar un seguimiento eficiente de los principales indicadores de negocio (KPIs).
Analizar la venta de productos complementarios y proponer acciones orientadas a incrementar el ingreso medio por pasajero.


¿Qué te ofrecemos?

En Baleària valoramos y cuidamos a nuestro equipo. Esto es lo que te espera al unirte a nosotros:


💶 Condiciones económicas: Remuneración acorde a tus expectativas y experiencia profesional
📚 Formación continua, a través de nuestra Escuela de Empresa Baleària (EdEB), con foco en liderazgo, seguridad, operaciones y desarrollo profesional.
💼 Retribución flexible, con beneficios sociales (salud, comida, transporte, guardería, etc.) y ahorro fiscal
🤝 Ambiente de trabajo colaborativo, donde tus ideas y aportaciones cuentan
🎟️ Otros beneficios sociales (plataformas de descuentos, billetes de empleado, etc.)
🚢 Empresa líder en el sector, con cultura y valores consolidados
🏅 Empresa Top Employer, reflejo de nuestro compromiso con un entorno laboral excelente


Requisitos


Residencia en la zona del centro de trabajo o disponibilidad para trabajar de forma presencial.
Formación universitaria en ADE, Economía, Turismo, Estadística, Matemáticas o titulaciones afines.
Experiencia previa de entre 2 y 3 años en posiciones de Revenue, Pricing, Business Analytics o similares, preferiblemente en empresas del sector turístico o transporte.
Capacidad analítica y orientación a la toma de decisiones basada en datos
Nivel avanzado de Excel y facilidad para trabajar con grandes volúmenes de datos.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Job Description

Coches.net, Motos.net and Milanuncios.com are among the leading online marketplaces in Spain, connecting millions of buyers and sellers every month. We're looking for an exceptional Data Analyst to help us understand that audience at scale spotting the trends, opportunities and friction points that shape how we improve our products and services.

You'll work as part of a multidisciplinary team, collaborating closely with Product Owners, cluster teams, data engineers and stakeholders across Marketing, Sales, Product, BizDev and Operations. You'll have real autonomy to define your own analyses, propose new lines of investigation, and see your insights turned into decisions that reach millions of users.

What you'll do


Identify, analyse and interpret KPIs and health metrics related to our users and customers, building dashboards and visualisations to monitor them.
Spot trends, risks and opportunities, and turn them into concrete recommendations to improve the different initiatives across the vertical.
Generate high-impact insights using advanced analytics to deepen our understanding of users and customers.
Actively contribute to the discovery and development of advanced analytical models — such as clustering and predictive models — and their implementation in real business use cases, including customer segmentation and propensity models for upselling, downselling and churn prediction.
Work day-to-day with a modern data stack (including tools like Databricks and Airflow), with room to grow your skills in data engineering and big data as the role evolves.


What we're looking for


3+ years of experience in eCommerce or an online company.
Solid knowledge of SQL and relational databases.
Working knowledge of Python and/or R for data analysis (e.g. pandas, numpy, matplotlib) and analytics (e.g. scikit-learn).
Experience with at least one visualisation tool such as Tableau and/or QlikSense.
Strong analytical skills: comfortable interpreting data, extracting relevant insights, and translating business questions into analytical needs.


Nice to have


Experience working with sales, operations and strategy teams.
Knowledge of basic machine learning algorithms (e.g. clustering, classification, regressions).
Some experience with big data technologies (e.g. Databricks, data lakes).
Some knowledge of data engineering tools (e.g. Airflow, DBT).

Description:
Company Description

Experian is a global data and technology company, powering opportunities for people and businesses around the world. We help to redefine lending practices, uncover and prevent fraud, simplify healthcare, create marketing solutions, and gain deeper insights into the automotive market, all using our unique combination of data, analytics and software. We also assist millions of people to realize their financial goals and help them save time and money.

We operate across a range of markets, from financial services to healthcare, automotive, agribusiness, insurance, and many more industry segments.

We invest in people and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data. As a FTSE 100 Index company listed on the London Stock Exchange (EXPN), we have a team of 22,500 people across 32 countries. Our corporate headquarters are in Dublin, Ireland. Learn more at experianplc.com.

Job Description

You will be part of a very dynamic and fast-growing Analytics team at Experian Spain, and you will develop analytical solutions to the benefit of our clients and their customers. You will collect and analyze large datasets to uncover insights and create solutions that support organizational goals, in the field of credit life cycle, risk management, fraud modelling or marketing. Technical, analytical, and communication skills are needed to interpret data and influence decision-making.

Main Responsibilities


Data Processing: Implementing processes to clean, transform, and organize raw data for analysis
Optimization: Enhancing data delivery and automating manual processes to improve efficiency
Data Analysis: Analyzing large volumes of structured and unstructured data to identify trends and patterns
Data Visualization: Creating visual reports to clarify business pain points.
Big data platforms: Using data/analytical platforms like Databricks, Cloudera, ...
Statistical Techniques: Using statistical techniques to validate findings and ensure accuracy
Machine Learning: Developing machine learning models and predictive algorithms to solve business problems
Programming Skills: Applying programming languages and domain-specific tools for analysis
Communication: Communicate with client and/or other departments/divisions within Experian to help ensure accurate and timely implementation of project work
Solving problems: Identify potential problems in the end to end process and take ownership for the resolution


Qualifications


2–3 years of experience in statistical or analytical project work, and/or experience in the financial services, telecommunications, retail, technology, or consulting sectors.
Degree or equivalent in a related field such as computer science, data science, statistics, mathematics, or information technology, physics.
Highly PC literate with thorough knowledge of statistical:
Strong proficiency in Python for data analysis, advanced analytics and automation: Python with Pandas, Numpy and Machine Learning Packages and IT packages. PySpark, TensorFlow or PyTorch is an a plus
Knowledge of R, SQL, and SQL Server is highly valued as an additional asset
Experience with cloud-based data platforms (e.g., Databricks, Cloudera, and Snowflake)
knowledge of Power BI for creating interactive dashboards
Understanding of statistical techniques which may be used to address client business issues
An innovative and inquisitive mind, focused on addressing and solving data and analysis problems
Fluency in written and spoken English


Good to have


Knowledge or hands-on experience with Generative AI concepts, including LLMs, RAG, prompt engineering, and information retrieval.


Benefits/Perks


Great compensation package and bonus plan
Core benefits including Private Health Care and Experian wellness program
Flexible schedule, hybrid model of teleworking
Flexible time off including volunteer time off, personal leaves and paid holidays

Our uniqueness is that we celebrate yours. Experian's culture and people are important differentiators. Title: Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Barcelona
Description:
Location: We are flexible! Come and join us either in Hamburg, Berlin or Barcelona.

Freenow empowers smarter mobility decisions helping people to move freely and cities to thrive.

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst (m/f/d) to collaborate with our product squads, using data to build a flawless product experience. You will join the Product Data Team and work closely with PMs, designers, UX researchers, developers, and other data functions to discover new product opportunities, validate hypotheses, and launch valuable features to our users.

Be ready to work in a multinational, diverse, highly motivated and collaborative team of passionate analysts who strive for excellence and like to have fun. Are you ready for your next ride?

YOUR DAILY ADVENTURES WILL INCLUDE:


Providing expertise and collaborating with stakeholders to generate new product feature ideas and improvements, and also estimating the potential impact of planned projects.
Continuously engaging with the product squads to gain an understanding of the problems that need to be solved, gathering requirements, and defining the best deliverables to match the business needs.
Having full ownership of your analysis, from ideation to communication of results and making recommendations to all levels of the company including senior management and prioritization committees.
Developing and evaluating A/B test experiments or other analyses to measure and report the performance of released features, ensuring that we are launching the correct changes and features in our apps.
Working closely with our developers and data engineers to create and capture data that is aligned with the business logic and allows modeling and analysis.
Being involved throughout the complete product lifecycle in order to guarantee a data-driven process.
Bringing new insights and championing them using your analyses, dashboards, and good storytelling! We value ideas over hierarchy, and there's always a new path to follow if your idea is convincing and well-backed with data.
You will have the opportunity to steer our products, which kind of features should be developed, and which changes should be made to solve hundreds of thousands of users' daily needs.


TO BE SUCCESSFUL IN THIS ROLE:


You have curiosity in your essence, which motivates you to answer WHY things happened, not only scratching the surface, but aiming for well-founded actionable results
Degree in Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, Computer Science, Engineering, or other fields with a strong mathematical-statistical background
3+ years experience in working as a Data Analyst in a data-driven analytics environment, preferably within tech product organizations, having direct contact with stakeholders.
Exceptional analytical skills, lateral thinking, and proven experience in solving highly challenging problems.
Very good knowledge of SQL, databases, and statistical programming tools (e.g. Python, R) so that exploratory analyses can be performed, reports created and ETLs maintained
Good understanding and hands-on experience in analyzing and interpreting A/B test results, backed by statistical knowledge.
Experience in working with data visualisation tools (e.g.Tableau, Qlikview) and event tracking (e.g. Mixpanel, GA, Firebase)
You are able to communicate findings in a concise and clear manner to a wide variety of stakeholders to support data-driven decision making by using data visualisation and storytelling and have excellent English communication skills.


BENEFITS & PERKS IN A NUTSHELL:


Flexible working arrangements
LinkedIn Learning

Plus more local benefits depending on your work location!

Description:
Glovo is part of the Delivery Hero Group, the world’s pioneering local delivery platform, our mission is to deliver an amazing experience—fast, easy, and to your door. We operate in around 65 countries worldwide. Headquartered in Berlin, Germany. Delivery Hero has been listed on the Frankfurt Stock Exchange since 2017 and is part of the MDAX stock market index.

Job Description

Job Ref ID: JR0082142

Your Work-life Opportunity

Join our team and become an integral part of Glovo's Global Logistics! We provide a dynamic and challenging environment filled with numerous opportunities for growth and development.

In this role, you will be responsible for redesigning, testing, and implementing the payment structures that motivate and reward our riders worldwide. By blending deep data analysis and data modeling with creative problem-solving, your work will ensure our logistics network is efficient, scalable, and fair for our riders. The KPIs you will influence are crucial to operations, as every decision made will directly affect the whole operational investment (biggest company cost).

Be a Part Of a Team Where You Will


Explore and find the most optimal logistics payment structure in order to maximize global riders engagement.
Strategically redesign our courier payment framework to improve key operational metrics, designing models that reward factors like vehicle used, distance, weight, and peak-hour availability.
Dive deep into massive datasets to identify trends, drivers, and opportunities. Your insights will be the foundation for optimizing our entire operational investment.
Own the experimentation process to validate your ideas. You will design, run, and analyze experiments (A/B testing, switchback tests) to precisely measure the impact of payment structure changes before a global rollout.
Continuously monitor the performance of your strategies. You will track KPIs, assess the effectiveness of your changes, and make data-driven adjustments as needed.
Understand and address local and regional needs by stepping into the shoes of the riders and truly understanding their perspective.


Qualifications

YOU HAVE


Degree in Engineering, Maths or another STEM field.
2+ years of experience in a data analytics role where you translated insights into tangible business actions and measured their impact.
Strong technical proficiency
Advanced SQL for complex querying and data extraction.
Proficiency in Python for data analysis and data orchestration.
Experience with data visualization tools such as Looker, Tableau, or PowerBI.
Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills. You are comfortable breaking down ambiguous, complex problems into manageable steps and driving towards a clear solution.
Nice to have experience with experimentation. Designing and/or analyzing A/B tests or other statistical testing methodologies to measure impact.
Comfortable working in a high-growth and high-performance environment, dealing with ambiguity while maintaining a positive mindset.
You can clearly and concisely explain complex analytical findings to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Fluent English is a must.
You are organized, take ownership of your work, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

Additional Information

Individuals representing diverse profiles, and abilities, encompassing various genders, ethnicities, and backgrounds, are less likely to apply for this role if they do not possess solid experience in 100% of these areas. Even if it seems you don't meet our musts don't let it stop you, we are all about finding the best talent out there! Skills can be learned, and embracing diversity is invaluable.

We Believe Driven Talent Deserves


💪 Top-notch private health insurance to keep you at your peak.
🍔 Monthly Glovo credit to satisfy your cravings!
💳 Discounts on transportation, food, and even kindergarten expenses.
🏊 Discounted gym memberships to keep you energized.
🏖️ Extra time off, the freedom to work from home two days a week, and the opportunity to work from anywhere for up to three weeks a year!

Title: Clinical Data Analyst
Description:
About Analog Devices

Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24,000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible™. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).

Clinical Data Analyst

Essential Duties And Responsibilities


Analyze and manage large datasets from diverse sources—including deployed products, clinical studies, patients EMR/EHR, and internal R&D—to support the development of chronic disease management solutions.
Design and perform rigorous statistical analyses to generate solid insights to support clinical efficacy and benefits of the product
Produce product quality insights that support quality assurance activities in accordance with medical quality management system procedures.
Construct data pipelines and engage data cleaning and organization by integrating multiple data streams in collaboration with cross-functional teams to enable efficient analysis at scale.
Communicate findings effectively to stakeholders through clear, actionable reports and presentations.


Minimum Qualifications


Master’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Electrical Engineering, Computer Science with biomedical application research, Biomedical Engineering or a related field.
Strong foundation in data science, statistical methodologies, and hypothesis test design.
Basic understanding of human systems physiology.
Familiarity with wearable sensor signals, including bio-potential measurements (e.g., ECG) and audio signals.
Proficiency in programming languages, basic engineering tools, and statistical tools (e.g., Python, MATLAB, R, and etc.).
Excellent communication and presentation skills for engaging both external medical professionals and internal multidisciplinary teams.


Additional Desirable Skills, Knowledges And Abilities


Experience in publishing clinical journal articles is a plus
Experience collaborating with medical professionals / clinicians.
Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment.

Title: Fraud Data Analyst
Description:
About Us

Traditional banking has never really given you control over your financial life. Satispay exists to change that: to empower people through finance.

That means making financial services easy and accessible for over 6.5M users. We started with payments, then benefits, investing, cards... and we’re not done. Not even close. We follow the same logic every time: find a real problem, solve it properly, then look for the next one. The destination? To build the most loved financial platform in the world. If you own outcomes rather than tasks, stay close to what users need, and refuse to wait for someone else to fix what's broken — you'll find people here who work exactly in the same way. And together, you'll build something worth being proud of.

What You'll Be Doing

As our Fraud Data Analyst, you'll handle one of the most critical challenges in digital payments: keeping millions of transactions safe in real time.

Here's What That Looks Like In Practice


Architect Real-Time Strategies – You will be responsible for our real-time decisioning engine, designing and deploying logic that combines ML scores with velocity features to make millisecond decisions.
Precision Rule Development – Translate complex fraud patterns into high-performing rules, optimising the balance between False Positive Rates (FPR) and Gross Fraud Loss.
Deconstruct Payment Fraud – Proactively hunt for emerging schemes (ATO, social engineering) and turn these insights into end-to-end mitigation strategies.
Optimise the Decisioning Stack – Partner with Product and Engineering to define analytical requirements for new features and third-party data signals.
Calibrate ML & Heuristics – Work with Data Science to operationalise machine learning models, determining how to best "wrap" model scores with heuristic rules.
Champion Frictionless UX – Analyse security measures to identify unnecessary hurdles, designing dynamic friction strategies for a seamless user experience.
Strategic Performance Reporting – Monitor rule efficacy and portfolio health, presenting data-driven recommendations to senior leadership to evolve our risk appetite.


Who We're Looking For

This role needs someone genuinely curious about how fraud works, and driven enough to stay one step ahead of it.


Experience – You have between 3 and 7 years of professional experience, specifically within the risk, payments, or credit sectors.
Technical Proficiency – You are highly skilled in SQL and Python for data analysis and strategy development.
Domain Expertise – You have a solid understanding of payment fraud dynamics and experience working with real-time decisioning environments.
Communication – You possess excellent communication skills and are fluent in English.
Nice to Have – Experience with Machine Learning, Data Science, PySpark, or GraphQL knowledge is a significant plus.


Don't worry if you don't tick every box. We believe in the power of different viewpoints and strengths. Your unique perspective is important as we build something special: if you're passionate and can make a difference, we truly encourage you to apply.

CareAbout: how we support your impact

About

We move fast, and evolution never stops. It’s a fun ride, but it can be challenging. To make sure our people truly thrive, we’re committed to making their lives easier, both in the office and out in the world. That’s why we created CareAbout:


❤️ Health: private insurance for you and your family, psychological support with Serenis, mental health workshops.
💰 Financial resources: Stock Option Plan, meal vouchers, relocation support if you’re moving countries.
⚙️ Growth and development: professional development programs, internal mobility, language courses with Preply.
🌱 Flexibility: unlimited PTO, hybrid working policy*, flexible working hours.
👨‍👩‍👧 Family: enhanced parental leave, additional leave for child sickness.
We embrace three days per week in-office (Tuesday and Thursday + 1 of your choice), with the option to request extra remote time.


Equal opportunity employer

At Satispay, we're proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and inclusion, welcoming individuals of all backgrounds. This opportunity is open to everyone, regardless - for instance - of race, colour, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, and national origin.

Join us in a workplace where everyone belongs!

Title: Analytics Engineer
Description:
Scopely is seeking a highly motivated Analytics Engineer to join our Playgami team in Barcelona on a hybrid basis!

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing, and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people worldwide daily.

Playgami is building the best SaaS gaming platform ever! The team strives to create the world’s best products for game production, operation, and insights. Powering many award-winning, loved-by-millions franchise games over mobile, web, and PC.

What You’ll Do


We collaborate with engineers, product teams, and analysts to create self-serve insight products that are fast, accurate, and elastic at a petabyte-scale
We work across the full data product lifecycle: designing new tracking plans, developing data models, ELT pipelines, and self-serve insight products like Looker explores and dashboards
We are stewards of data quality, ensuring that metrics are consistently reported across the catalog of data products
We work with cutting-edge tech (BigQuery, dbt, Looker)
We look forward and back, applying tools like BQML to predict player behavior
We empathize with our game product teams and departments to make their daily work more enjoyable and their products more successful
We often specialize in some part of the data stack and lifecycle but always aim to contribute across the full spectrum


What We’re Looking For


You love solving puzzles
You can translate needs into analytics tech
You have experience with the modern data stack (tools like BigQuery, Snowflake, dbt, Looker, Airflow, GitHub, and command line-based workflows) or hunger to work in that domain
You have first-class SQL skills and 3+ years of experience in a relevant role
You understand the importance of data modeling, like knowing your Kimballs, your star schemas
You value business context and improvement as much as you do first-class technical solutions
You love collaboration and take pride in working in high-functioning teams
You enjoy working in rapidly evolving, hyper-growth environments where every change presents an opportunity for us to grow
You love having fun at work. Ping Pong/Mario Kart skills are a plus!


At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

About Scopely

Scopely is a leading video game and global interactive entertainment company, home to many of the world’s most beloved and enduring experiences, including two of the most successful mobile games of all-time “MONOPOLY GO!” and “Pokémon GO,” along with “Stumble Guys,” “Star Trek™ Fleet Command,” “MARVEL Strike Force,” “WWE Champions,” the Scrabble® franchise, “Yahtzee® With Buddies,” and many others. Across mobile, web, PC, and console, Scopely creates, develops, publishes, and live-operates one of the most diversified and award-winning portfolios in the games industry — bringing hundreds of millions of players together through a shared love of play.

Founded in 2011, Scopely is powered by its exceptional team — including thousands of world-class gamemakers around the globe, a distinctive tenet-driven culture, and its proprietary technology platform, Playgami. Together, these strengths have fueled Scopely’s position as the #1 mobile games company in the U.S. and #2 globally, generating more than $10 billion in lifetime revenue. Whether building global sensations like “MONOPOLY GO!” from the ground up, or expanding through strategic acquisitions, including the FoxNext, GSN, and Scopely Explore games businesses — Scopely consistently delivers experiences players love today and return to for years to come.

Recognized multiple times as one of the "100 Most Influential Companies in the World" by TIME magazine and one of Fast Company's "World's Most Innovative Companies" and “Best Workplaces for Innovators,” Scopely believes that video games can be a force for good — creating meaningful connections, vibrant communities, and making life better through play.

Scopely has global operations and partners across four continents in more than a dozen countries worldwide. For more information, visit: https://www.scopely.com/.

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Smadex is a leading advertising technology company founded in Barcelona in 2011 and sold to American-based and stock-listed Entravision in 2018 (NYSE::EVC). We are a fully transparent platform built with top technology, countless programmatic management features and powerful machine learning algorithms to help advertisers grow their business at scale. We are currently considered one of the top mobile ad-tech companies in the world.




We are looking for a Data Scientist to work closely with the ML and Product teams. The candidate should be communicative and analytical, in order to answer the complex questions that Product and Campaign performance are facing. For this purpose we use tons of data available to get powerful insights to resolve them, creating effective strategies to help improve the Smadex platform!




This is a full-time position based in Barcelona.




Your tasks and responsibilities:

Analyze large, complex data sets containing the behaviour of millions of mobile users and Apps worldwide to influence Product & ML strategies.
Working cross-functionally with business and technical teams to support product performance.
Develop dashboards and processes to ensure data influences decisions at all levels of the company.




Skills and requirements:

3+ years of experience as a Data Scientist / Data Analyst.
Bachelor's or Master's Degree in a Quantitative Field (Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Data Science).
Strong problem-solving skills, ability to formulate questions, run analysis to articulate a recommendation.
Proven working knowledge of Python, SQL and large data sets, understanding of analytic methodologies for data evaluation.
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present analysis and conclusions.
Strong knowledge and experience of statistical concepts and hypothesis testing.
Knowledge of the ad-tech industry is a plus.




Please note that we do NOT provide VISA sponsorship. Candidates without a legal permit to work in Spain won't be considered.

Integrate a highly motivated, young and dynamic team
Great compensation package

Meal vouchers - Ticket Restaurant monthly allowance
Monthly gym allowance: Choose between DiR and Wellhub
LinkedIn Learning and training opportunities
Monthly TGIF events
Regular team-building events
Fun and friendly work environment with talented marketers and engineers from over 40 countries
And more!

Title: Masterdata & Pricing Specialist
Description:
At Nexans, our people and performance drive our industrial success. Folllowing the acquisition of Cables RCT in 2025, Nexans Iberia is entering an exciting transformation phase, integrating two Spanish entities into Nexans Goup standards, governance and systems.

To support this journey, we are recruiting a Masterdata & Pricing Analyst to join Iberia.

The Masterdata and Pricing Analyst works at the junction between Marketing, Sales and Finance. His/her daily role is to provide data intelligence by gathering, consolidating and analyzing partner/customer and pricing data in order to optimize pricing of Nexans offers and to improve profitability results.

To perform this role, he/she can rely on strong data analytics capabilities and works in cooperation with other functions by providing analysis and insights.

The Masterdata & Pricing Analyst works on the following areas:

Main business expectations:


Consolidate and analyze partner/customer and market data
Ensure the quality of the data in the BU
Identify discrepancy causes and provide insights for pricing strategy
Define solutions to upgrade data management tools and steer its deployment to Sales & Marketing functions



Other business expectations:


Participate to upgrade pricing policy
Measure evaluation and recommend adjustments



Key dependencies for maximizing collaboration and subsidiarity


Collaborate with Sales and Marketing teams
Work hand in hand with Market Intelligence & Pricing Manager
Coordinate with Demand Planner



Required Skills And Qualifications


3+ years experience gathering, consolidating and analyzing partner/customer pricing data.
Industrial company experience strongly preferred.
Fluent English and Spanish.
Ability to operate both strategically and hands-on.
Key competencies: collaboration & teamwork, analytical skills, customer, Product and Pricing data monitoring, analysis.

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst who will share our passion for excellence and continuous challenge.

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Product Data Analyst to join our agile team. This key role will be centered around a specific product and will require an individual who is confident in making data-driven decisions autonomously, with the backing of a knowledgeable and collaborative team. This role will involve a balance of in-depth data analysis, data quality assurance, cross-functional collaboration, and business-oriented approach, all in service of our mission to continuously improve our products.

We seek individuals who are meticulous, capable problem-solvers and possess a strong aptitude for data analysis. If you are excited by the prospect of uncovering trends in large datasets and translating data-driven insights into actionable strategies, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Ready to be part of the challenge?

In this Role, you'll get to

Build dashboards, reports, and visualizations.

Define success metrics, design experiments, and evaluate feature performance.

Translate complex datasets into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

Analyze user behavior and product usage data to identify trends, pain points, and growth opportunities.

Conduct deep-dive analyses to support product launches, A/B tests, and user experience improvements.

Act as a data referent for a designated product within an agile squad, leading all data-related activities and decisions.

Ensure the quality and consistency of product-related datasets within our data ecosystem, identifying areas for continual improvement.

Champion a culture of data-informed decision-making within the squad and the wider organization, educating team members on the benefits of a data-focused approach.

Develop, implement, and manage efficient data pipelines to support data extraction and analysis, enhancing the quality of insights for both product development and customer experience.

Required Skills

Experience with Databricks and BigQuery.

Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow and DBT.

Familiarity with Git for version control and CI/CD operations.

Previous experience in a Cloud environment, preferably Azure.

Knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction and manipulation.

A solid understanding of data structures and data manipulation methodologies.

Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and product analytics frameworks.

Experience building and shipping digital products based on continuous discovery.

Previous experience working in Mobile App products with Firebase as tracking tool.

Practical experience using Jira, Confluence, and other Atlassian tools in agile development.

Familiarity with data management tools and their application to both structured and unstructured data.

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary agile team.

Dashboarding tools: Databricks

SQL for structured data storage and querying.

Visual Studio / PyCharm for code development.

Airflow and DBT for data orchestration and transformation.

Azure DevOps for version control and development operations.

JIRA and Confluence for knowledge management and team collaboration.
