SCRM – LIDL

Digital

Hub

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst who will share our passion for excellence and continuous challenge.

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Product Data Analyst to join our agile team. This key role will be centered around a specific product and will require an individual who is confident in making data-driven decisions autonomously, with the backing of a knowledgeable and collaborative team. This role will involve a balance of in-depth data analysis, data quality assurance, cross-functional collaboration, and business-oriented approach, all in service of our mission to continuously improve our products.

We seek individuals who are meticulous, capable problem-solvers and possess a strong aptitude for data analysis. If you are excited by the prospect of uncovering trends in large datasets and translating data-driven insights into actionable strategies, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Ready to be part of the challenge?

In this Role, you'll get to

Build dashboards, reports, and visualizations.

Define success metrics, design experiments, and evaluate feature performance.

Translate complex datasets into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

Analyze user behavior and product usage data to identify trends, pain points, and growth opportunities.

Conduct deep-dive analyses to support product launches, A/B tests, and user experience improvements.

Act as a data referent for a designated product within an agile squad, leading all data-related activities and decisions.

Ensure the quality and consistency of product-related datasets within our data ecosystem, identifying areas for continual improvement.

Champion a culture of data-informed decision-making within the squad and the wider organization, educating team members on the benefits of a data-focused approach.

Develop, implement, and manage efficient data pipelines to support data extraction and analysis, enhancing the quality of insights for both product development and customer experience.

Required Skills

Experience with Databricks and BigQuery.

Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow and DBT.

Familiarity with Git for version control and CI/CD operations.

Previous experience in a Cloud environment, preferably Azure.

Knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction and manipulation.

A solid understanding of data structures and data manipulation methodologies.

Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and product analytics frameworks.

Experience building and shipping digital products based on continuous discovery.

Previous experience working in Mobile App products with Firebase as tracking tool.

Practical experience using Jira, Confluence, and other Atlassian tools in agile development.

Familiarity with data management tools and their application to both structured and unstructured data.

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary agile team.

Our stack ?

Dashboarding tools: Databricks

SQL for structured data storage and querying.

Visual Studio / PyCharm for code development.

Airflow and DBT for data orchestration and transformation.

Azure DevOps for version control and development operations.

Databricks with PySpark for large-scale data processing and analytics.

JIRA and Confluence for knowledge management and team collaboration.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
Due to continuous growth, our Product team is excited to welcome a highly analytical Product Analyst to help us align data-driven decision-making with business goals across three products at once, each at a different stage.

As Product Analyst, you'll operate on the intersection of product analytics and business analysis: you don't just explain why a funnel underperforms, you translate that into what it means in euros, risk, and compliance terms. You'll work in a fully MCP-equipped, AI-native environment, own the event taxonomy across all three products, automate recurring reporting so you have the time to go genuinely deep on each product, and act as the go-to person for the Growth team on everything A/B testing.

Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Growth, SEM, and Payments, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful, structural impact — not just on individual metrics, but on how the whole team thinks about data.

If you're passionate about solving complex problems, taking full ownership without waiting to be asked, and driving results across multiple products at once, this role is perfect for you!

Key Responsibilities

Product analytics core


Independently run funnel, cohort, and retention analysis in Amplitude across all three products.
Design and interpret experiments (A/B tests), with a clear eye for primary vs. diagnostic metrics.
Go deeper than headline numbers through segmentation (by country, user segment, acquisition channel, etc.).


Go-to person for Growth on A/B testing


Be the single point of contact for the Growth team on everything experiment-related: test design, sample size, choice of primary vs. diagnostic metrics, and interpretation of results.
Be consulted before a test goes live, not only once results come in — safeguarding experiment quality upfront, not just in hindsight.
Recognize and correct common experimentation pitfalls (peeking, dependent variants, poorly chosen success metrics) before they lead to a flawed rollout decision.


Business and risk layer


Translate product metrics into unit economics: what a conversion drop costs in ARPPU, CAC, or margin.
Model scenarios (e.g. the impact of a price change on both conversion and downstream risk indicators).
Produce output that non-product stakeholders (Payments, SEM, Growth, Finance, C-level) can act on directly — not only PMs.


Ownership: taxonomy & reporting


Own the event taxonomy across all products: proactively track which events are live or deprecated, document renames as they happen, and prevent outdated event names (in skills, dashboards, or AI prompts) from silently producing wrong conclusions. This is a recurring responsibility, not a one-off documentation task — every product release can affect the taxonomy.
Automate reporting to free up time for depth: turn recurring analyses (funnel health, KPI reviews, country splits) from manual pulls into self-running dashboards/skills, so stakeholders always have current numbers without needing to ask an analyst — and so the time freed up goes into genuinely deep analysis per product, not more of the same routine work.
Proactively dig into where things "leak": don't wait to be asked — actively look for underperforming segments or funnel steps, and for untapped business opportunities surfacing from the data, then raise them unprompted with PMs or the Project Director.


Take the team by the hand, analytically


This is not a purely individual-contributor role: bring PMs (and other stakeholders) along in how you reach a conclusion, not just what the conclusion is, so they get better themselves at asking the right data question.
Actively spot and correct conclusions that the data doesn't support (e.g. correlation presented as causation, or an underpowered sample treated as significant).
Be the team's analytical conscience: when there's doubt about a number or interpretation, you're the person people turn to — and you take on that responsibility proactively rather than waiting to be asked.


AI leverage


Work in an environment fully set up with MCPs (Amplitude, Databricks, Linear, Google Drive, etc.) — this is the default way of working, not an experiment on the side.
Build and maintain reusable Amplitude skills and analysis tooling.
Use LLMs actively for query generation, first-pass analysis, and reporting.
Critically evaluate and correct AI output: recognize when a model uses an outdated event name, incorrectly sums a non-additive metric, repeats a stale assumption, or draws a conclusion the underlying data doesn't support.
Know when not to trust AI: with ambiguous data, conflicting results, or output that sounds "too clean."


Required Skills

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional analytical depth with genuine ownership and the ability to bring others along. Here's what we're looking for:


Exceptional analytical ability — this isn't a "can write adequate SQL" role; you spot patterns others miss, untangle conflicting signals, and reach the right conclusion under time pressure.
Independent working knowledge of Amplitude or a comparable product-analytics tool (or demonstrable SQL proficiency to pick this up quickly).
Experience designing experiments (A/B testing) — able to explain what makes a good primary metric and why.
Comfortable with unit economics — CAC, LTV, ARPPU, margin — not as buzzwords but as a working model.
An AI-native way of working: daily use of LLMs throughout the analysis workflow, combined with a critical, verifying mindset.
A self-starter: capable of setting up your own tooling and workflow in an MCP-rich environment without needing direction — you don't wait for an instruction to build a skill or dashboard, you spot where automation frees up time and act on it.
Demonstrable proactivity: concrete examples of self-initiated analyses (not requested) that led to a real action or business insight.
An affinity for maintaining documentation and structure over time (taxonomy, tracking plans) — precision work that quietly erodes if no one explicitly owns it.
A demonstrated ability to bring others along — not only reaching the right conclusion yourself, but helping colleagues (PMs, engineering) get better at reading and questioning data themselves.
Comfortable operating across multiple products and product stages at once (stabilization, post-launch scale, early growth) without losing analytical depth on any of them.
Strong collaboration and communication skills for engaging stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Growth, SEM, and Payments.
Advanced English proficiency, spoken and written


Benefits

WHY LEADTECH


Diversified app portfolio with millions of active users in a high-growth non-gaming vertical.
Mature data infrastructure: BigQuery, Looker, AppsFlyer, and a proprietary analytics stack for fast decision-making.
Experimentation culture: real autonomy to propose and ship changes in production.
International team, dynamic environment, and the opportunity for direct P&L impact.
Competitive compensation package + benefits (flexible hours, health insurance, training).


Growth and career development


At Leadtech, we prioritize your growth. Enjoy a flexible career path with personalized internal training and an annual budget for external learning opportunities.


Work-Life balance


Benefit from a flexible schedule with flextime and the option of working full remote or from our Barcelona office. Enjoy free Friday afternoons with a 7-hour workday, plus a 35-hour workweek in July and August so you can savor summer!


Comprehensive benefits


Competitive salary, full-time permanent contract, and top-tier private health insurance (including dental and psychological services).
25 days of vacation plus your birthday off, with flexible vacation options—no blackout days!


Unique Perks


If you wish to come, in our office in Barcelona you’ll find it complete with free coffee, fresh fruit, snacks, a game room, and a rooftop terrace with stunning Mediterranean views.
Additional benefits include ticket restaurant and nursery vouchers, paid directly from your gross salary.
Join us in an environment where you’re free to innovate, learn, and grow alongside passionate professionals. At Leadtech, you’ll tackle exciting challenges and be part of a vibrant team dedicated to delivering exceptional user experiences


Sounds good? Apply now! We’re looking forward to getting to know you.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

Leadtech is an Equal Employment Opportunity (EEO) Employer, which means we encourage applications from people with different backgrounds, interests, and personal circumstances. Our team welcomes applicants regardless of their race, gender, age, religion, nationality, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expressión and/or disabilities. All we need is your high energy, skills, and willingness to be a part of a great project!

Location

You'll have the flexibility to choose whether you'd like to come to the office every day, from time to time, or work fully remote. We want you to find the best combination for you.

If you prefer to be surrounded with amazing people, our exceptional office is in Barcelona’s Blue Building, located right on the city's seafront. Besides our stunning views, you’ll enjoy our office perks such as free fruit, snacks, and coffee and you’ll also be able to take part in our Mario Kart and table tennis competitions.

If you wish, you can exercise your rights of access, rectification or cancellation by writing to our address (Avenida Litoral, 12-14, 5ta planta. Barcelona. 08005) or to the email address privacy@leadtech.com.

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Guesty is the all-in-one platform helping hospitality businesses around the world automate, optimize, and scale their operations. We’re a fast-growing global startup transforming the industry — from enhancing guest experiences to driving business growth.

With a powerful suite of features and integrations with 150+ industry partners, including Airbnb, Vrbo, Booking.com, Expedia, and Google Travel, Guesty empowers property managers to deliver exceptional guest experiences while running efficient, data-driven operations.

Today, we're proud to have 800+ team members across 16 countries, all working together to shape the future of hospitality technology.

We are looking for an experienced Data Analyst to support data-driven decision-making across our Marketing organization. This role will partner closely with Marketing and cross-functional stakeholders to deliver actionable insights, develop scalable reporting, analyze campaign performance, and help optimize marketing strategies through data. The ideal candidate has strong SQL expertise, experience with BI tools, and the ability to translate complex data into clear business recommendations.

Responsibilities:


Serve as the primary analytics partner for the Marketing team.
Write and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, transform, and analyze large datasets.
Build, maintain, and improve dashboards using Looker, Tableau, Power BI, or similar BI tools.
Analyze marketing performance across Google Ads, Facebook Ads, email, paid search, paid social, and organic channels.
Define, monitor, and report on key marketing KPIs, including ROI, ROAS, CAC, LTV, attribution, conversion rate, marketing spend, and campaign performance.
Translate complex analytical findings into clear business recommendations for technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Identify trends, risks, and growth opportunities through data analysis.
Partner with Marketing, Product, and Business teams to support strategic decision-making.
Ensure data quality, consistency, and reporting accuracy across dashboards and reports.
Continuously improve reporting processes through automation and scalable analytics solutions.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience as a Data Analyst, Marketing Data Analyst, Business Analyst, or Analytics Analyst.
Expert-level SQL skills with experience writing complex SQL queries (joins, CTEs, window functions, subqueries, aggregations, query optimization, and data transformation). This is a core requirement.
Strong experience using BI and data visualization tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar platforms.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret large datasets and identify actionable insights.
Excellent communication and presentation skills with the ability to explain technical findings to non-technical stakeholders.
Experience building dashboards, reports, and executive-level presentations.
Experience defining and tracking KPIs and business metrics.
Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, Computer Science, Business Analytics, or a related quantitative field.
Strong English communication skills.


Highly Preferred


Experience as a Marketing Data Analyst within a SaaS, IT, software, or technology company.
Experience with Google Ads, Facebook Ads Manager, Google Analytics, HubSpot, or similar marketing platforms.
Strong understanding of marketing metrics, including: ROI, ROAS, Attribution, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Lifetime Value (LTV), Marketing Spend, Conversion Rate
Experience supporting B2B SaaS marketing teams.
Experience working with cloud data warehouses such as BigQuery, Snowflake, or Redshift.
Experience with Python or R for data analysis is an advantage.
Experience with AI tools or analytics automation is a plus.


Join us and discover a workplace where career growth, collaboration, and enjoyment can all exist together.

Title: Senior Data Analyst - Power BI
Description:
Somos Cívica

Corría el año 2008. El WhatsApp no existía, los datos vivían en Excel y las nubes estaban solo en el cielo.

La idea era sencilla de explicar, pero ambiciosa de ejecutar: crear un espacio donde las personas pudiesen colaborar, una consultora tecnológica donde los datos y el desarrollo se unieran para impulsar soluciones a medida, siempre con el trato cercano de toda la vida.

Hoy seguimos fieles a esa esencia: combinamos el poder de los datos y la ingeniería de software para ayudar a empresas a tomar mejores decisiones, innovar y crecer… sin perder nunca el factor humano que nos hizo nacer. Y sí, lo hacemos para grandes compañías, con presencia nacional e internacional, que confían en nosotros para proyectos de alto impacto.

Así empezamos, y así seguimos: con tecnología, sí, pero con alma. Porque, para nosotros, la innovación no va solo de código y servidores, sino de poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Aquí nadie es un número de ticket ni un “usuario final”: somos personas trabajando con otras personas, con nombres, ideas y muchas ganas de aportar.

La colaboración es nuestro sistema operativo. Porque sabemos que, cuando combinamos talento, compromiso y un poco de sentido del humor, el resultado no es solo un buen producto: es una forma de trabajar que genera impacto real, refuerza comunidades y mejora vidas.

Esto es Cívica: tecnología con propósito, personas que se implican y un equipo que cree que colaborar es mucho más que compartir documentos en la nube. Y si algo tenemos claro, es que el talento es el corazón de todo lo que hacemos. No solo el de quienes se sientan en nuestras oficinas, sino también el de quienes confían en nosotros como clientes y partners. Cuidar, desarrollar y retener ese talento no es una tarea más: es nuestra ventaja competitiva, y por eso hacemos realidad nuestro lema People Beyond Tech, recordando cada día que la tecnología avanza rápido, pero las personas son las que marcan la diferencia.

¿Quieres saber qué hacemos?

En Cívica, usamos la tecnología como una palanca para mejorar realidades.

Acompañamos a Grandes Organizaciones En Su Viaje Hacia La Transformación Digital, Alineando Datos, Diseño y Desarrollo Con Impacto Tangible En El Negocio. Así Es Como Lo Hacemos


Data Analytics: Transformamos datos en decisiones. Creamos informes, dashboards y portales que convierten información cruda en inteligencia estratégica.
Data Engineering: Diseñamos y gestionamos arquitecturas que aseguran flujos de datos fiables, continuos y escalables.
Data Quality & Governance: Creamos ecosistemas de confianza. Establecemos controles y políticas para garantizar que los datos siempre digan la verdad.
Artificial Intelligence: Damos inteligencia al futuro. Modelos predictivos y sistemas automatizados que optimizan procesos y multiplican el valor.
Front & Back Development: Construimos soluciones robustas. Desde aplicaciones web hasta APIs, traducimos necesidades de negocio en tecnología útil y escalable.
Design: Diseñamos experiencias claras. Combinamos funcionalidad y estética para conectar con las personas desde la primera interacción
Business & Management: Hacemos que la tecnología hable el idioma del negocio. Alineamos soluciones con los objetivos específicos de sectores como banca o seguros, asegurando resultados desde el día uno.


¿Por qué enamorarte de nosotros?

Porque no todas las empresas tienen tan claro el papel que quieren jugar en el mundo como lo tenemos en Cívica. Para nosotros, no se trata solo de lo que hacemos, sino de por qué y cómo lo hacemos. No nacimos para seguir tendencias tecnológicas, sino para construir soluciones con propósito, con rigor técnico, transparencia y transformaciones reales para las organizaciones que las utilizan.

El epicentro de nuestro trabajo no está solo en los resultados, sino en el enfoque. Cada proyecto nace de una escucha atenta, una necesidad real y una convicción compartida: la tecnología debe ser comprensible, escalable y transformadora. Desde la ingeniería hasta el análisis, desde el gobierno del dato hasta el diseño, todo lo que hacemos sigue una lógica colaborativa y humana.

Diseñamos plataformas que mejoran servicios, desarrollamos sistemas para tomar decisiones de negocio y acompañamos a organizaciones que entienden que los datos no son solo activos, sino herramientas de cambio. Trabajamos con instituciones, empresas y administraciones públicas que buscan tecnología comprensible, escalable y que genere valor. Lo hacemos con herramientas punteras —Snowflake, dbt, Google Cloud, entre otras—, pero, sobre todo, con una forma de pensar crítica, abierta y honesta.

Hemos crecido paso a paso, consolidando un equipo interdisciplinario que combina pensamiento crítico, excelencia y una visión ética sobre el uso de la tecnología. Nuestra trayectoria no se mide solo en líneas de código, pipelines y dashboards actualizados, sino en vínculos de confianza, valor aportado y transformaciones reales.

En Cívica no se trata de hacer más, sino de hacer mejor. Por eso, para quienes buscan un entorno donde la tecnología se construye con criterio, conciencia y confianza, este es un lugar al que es fácil querer sumarse.

¿Qué buscamos?

Sabemos que esta oferta no es para todo el mundo (ni lo pretendemos).

Buscamos a quienes no se conforman con el “esto siempre se ha hecho así”.

Aquí venimos a mover cosas. A veces demasiado. A veces nos equivocamos. No somos perfectos, pero lo que sí tenemos son ganas. De hacer cosas que molen, que importen, que dejen huella. Y de crecer.

De currar con gente con criterio, con energía positiva, con ganas de dar opinión y de trabajar en equipo. Y sí, también de disfrutar. Porque, como dice nuestro CEO, Josep: “Aunque estemos trabajando, no hace falta estar todo el día con un palo en el c…”.

Bueno, mejor esta parte te la contará cuando os conozcáis.

¿Cuáles serán tus responsabilidades en este rol?

Esta no es una oferta puntual ni para cubrir un proyecto concreto.

Buscamos un compañero de viaje que quiera crecer con nosotros y sumar al largo plazo en el equipo de Cívica.

El rol a incorporar es el de Data Analyst con foco en Power BI , para:

🖥️ Diseñar, construir y mantener modelos semánticos en Power BI.

📊 Desarrollar cuadros de mando, informes y visualizaciones avanzadas en Power BI.

🧠 Identificar KPIs y métricas relevantes para el negocio y traducirlos a soluciones analíticas.

🛠️ Modelar los metadatos necesarios para dar soporte a las visualizaciones.

✅ Validar la calidad y coherencia de los datos, así como analizar y optimizar el rendimiento de los cuadros de mando.

🔍 Configurar filtros, segmentaciones e interfaces que faciliten la navegación y análisis de los datos.

🔗 Generar y enviar reportes mediante Report Builder.

Que la comunidad te acompañe...

Dale al play y descúbrelo....⏯️

¿Qué necesitamos por tu parte?

Estos Son Nuestros ☝🏻 NO Negociables


Experiencia sólida en Data y BI, con más de 3 años trabajando con Power BI en proyectos empresariales, especialmente aportando experiencia en modelado y capa semántica
Conocimiento avanzado de DAX y experiencia en desarrollo de soluciones Power BI
Conocimientos sólidos de SQL
Experiencia en implementación de visualizaciones avanzadas


Y además...

🤩 Sería ideal que tuvieses capacidad para interpretar resultados y proponer mejoras en visualización y análisis de datos

😻Nos encantaría que tuvieses experiencia trabajando con Fabric Semantic Models

😍Estaría genial que tuvieses experiencia en modernización de plataformas de datos y en modelos semánticas de Power BI en entornos Fabric

¿Cómo será nuestro proceso de selección?

📞 Primera llamada — ¡Hola, hola!

Si tu perfil nos hace ojitos, te llamaremos para una charla breve y romper el hielo. Queremos conocerte un poco y contarte por qué creemos que podrías encajar con nosotros.

💬 Videollamada con Talento — Nos ponemos cara

Si seguimos conectando, agendamos una videollamada para hablar de tú a tú. Te contaremos más sobre Cívica, cómo trabajamos y cómo vivimos nuestra cultura de equipo... Y, por supuesto, también queremos escucharte.

💻 Charla techie — Hora de hablar en tu idioma

Si hay match, llega el momento de sumergirnos en lo que más te gusta: herramientas, tecnologías, proyectos, retos... Una charla con nuestro equipo técnico para evaluar tu nivel.

😏 ¿Ya está? ¿Así de fácil?

Pues sí. Ni gymkanas imposibles ni entrevistas eternas. Queremos que el proceso sea tan fluido como tomarte un café con alguien que te cae bien (aunque sea por videollamada).

¿Qué ocurrirá en tu primera semana?

Tu incorporación empieza en nuestra oficina de Granada, pero lo más importante no será el lugar: será cómo te vas a sentir.

Desde el primer minuto, todo estará preparado para ti.

Uno de nosotros te recibirá, te enseñará la oficina y te presentará al equipo. A partir de ahí, solo tendrás que centrarte en disfrutar y empezar a vivir la experiencia Cívica.

Tendrás una primera reunión con el equipo de People Care, donde te contarán todo lo que necesitas saber: tu contrato, beneficios, dinámicas internas, eventos y cómo cuidamos de quienes trabajan aquí.

Somos Cívica

Corría el año 2008. El WhatsApp no existía, los datos vivían en Excel y las nubes estaban solo en el cielo.

La idea era sencilla de explicar, pero ambiciosa de ejecutar: crear un espacio donde las personas pudiesen colaborar, una consultora tecnológica donde los datos y el desarrollo se unieran para impulsar soluciones a medida, siempre con el trato cercano de toda la vida.

Hoy seguimos fieles a esa esencia: combinamos el poder de los datos y la ingeniería de software para ayudar a empresas a tomar mejores decisiones, innovar y crecer… sin perder nunca el factor humano que nos hizo nacer. Y sí, lo hacemos para grandes compañías, con presencia nacional e internacional, que confían en nosotros para proyectos de alto impacto.

Así empezamos, y así seguimos: con tecnología, sí, pero con alma. Porque, para nosotros, la innovación no va solo de código y servidores, sino de poner la tecnología al servicio de las personas. Aquí nadie es un número de ticket ni un “usuario final”: somos personas trabajando con otras personas, con nombres, ideas y muchas ganas de aportar.

La colaboración es nuestro sistema operativo. Porque sabemos que, cuando combinamos talento, compromiso y un poco de sentido del humor, el resultado no es solo un buen producto: es una forma de trabajar que genera impacto real, refuerza comunidades y mejora vidas.

Esto es Cívica: tecnología con propósito, personas que se implican y un equipo que cree que colaborar es mucho más que compartir documentos en la nube. Y si algo tenemos claro, es que el talento es el corazón de todo lo que hacemos. No solo el de quienes se sientan en nuestras oficinas, sino también el de quienes confían en nosotros como clientes y partners. Cuidar, desarrollar y retener ese talento no es una tarea más: es nuestra ventaja competitiva, y por eso hacemos realidad nuestro lema People Beyond Tech, recordando cada día que la tecnología avanza rápido, pero las personas son las que marcan la diferencia.

¿Quieres saber qué hacemos?

En Cívica, usamos la tecnología como una palanca para mejorar realidades.

Acompañamos a Grandes Organizaciones En Su Viaje Hacia La Transformación Digital, Alineando Datos, Diseño y Desarrollo Con Impacto Tangible En El Negocio. Así Es Como Lo Hacemos

  • Artificial Intelligence: Damos inteligencia al futuro. Modelos predictivos y sistemas automatizados que optimizan procesos y multiplican el valor.
  • Front & Back Development: Construimos soluciones robustas. Desde aplicaciones web hasta APIs, traducimos necesidades de negocio en tecnología útil y escalable.
  • Design: Diseñamos experiencias claras. Combinamos funcionalidad y estética para conectar con las personas desde la primera interacción
  • Business & Management: Hacemos que la tecnología hable el idioma del negocio. Alineamos soluciones con los objetivos específicos de sectores como banca o seguros, asegurando resultados desde el día uno.

¿Por qué enamorarte de nosotros?

Porque no todas las empresas tienen tan claro el papel que quieren jugar en el mundo como lo tenemos en Cívica. Para nosotros, no se trata solo de lo que hacemos, sino de por qué y cómo lo hacemos. No nacimos para seguir tendencias tecnológicas, sino para construir soluciones con propósito, con rigor técnico, transparencia y transformaciones reales para las organizaciones que las utilizan.

El epicentro de nuestro trabajo no está solo en los resultados, sino en el enfoque. Cada proyecto nace de una escucha atenta, una necesidad real y una convicción compartida: la tecnología debe ser comprensible, escalable y transformadora. Desde la ingeniería hasta el análisis, desde el gobierno del dato hasta el diseño, todo lo que hacemos sigue una lógica colaborativa y humana.

Diseñamos plataformas que mejoran servicios, desarrollamos sistemas para tomar decisiones de negocio y acompañamos a organizaciones que entienden que los datos no son solo activos, sino herramientas de cambio. Trabajamos con instituciones, empresas y administraciones públicas que buscan tecnología comprensible, escalable y que genere valor. Lo hacemos con herramientas punteras —Snowflake, dbt, Google Cloud, entre otras—, pero, sobre todo, con una forma de pensar crítica, abierta y honesta.

Hemos crecido paso a paso, consolidando un equipo interdisciplinario que combina pensamiento crítico, excelencia y una visión ética sobre el uso de la tecnología. Nuestra trayectoria no se mide solo en líneas de código, pipelines y dashboards actualizados, sino en vínculos de confianza, valor aportado y transformaciones reales.

En Cívica no se trata de hacer más, sino de hacer mejor. Por eso, para quienes buscan un entorno donde la tecnología se construye con criterio, conciencia y confianza, este es un lugar al que es fácil querer sumarse.

Title: DATA ANALYTICS & REPORTING ANALYST
Place: Sant Cugat del Vallès, Catalonia, Spain
Description:
Would you like to join an international team working to improve the future of healthcare? Do you want to enhance the lives of millions of people? Grifols is a global healthcare company that since 1909 has been working to improve the health and well-being of people around the world. We are leaders in plasma-derived medicines and transfusion medicine and develop, produce and market innovative medicines, solutions and services in more than 110 countries and regions.

We believe that diversity adds value to our business, our teams, and our culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, fostering an inclusive environment where diversity makes us outstanding.

Mission

Your mission will be twofold: to ensure the reliable and efficient operation of existing analytics and reporting solutions, and to support the design and implementation of new data projects that transform information into actionable insights for informed decision-making. This role acts as a technical and analytical reference, working closely with IT and business stakeholders to support Compliance needs through high-quality data solutions.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be


Analytics & Reporting Operations
Maintain, optimize, and evolve data systems and Business Intelligence platforms that support Compliance activities.
Administer, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting models, primarily in Power BI, ensuring accuracy, usefulness, and consistency of information.
Guarantee data integrity, availability, and consistency across reporting flows, ensuring day-to-day operational continuity of critical systems and on-time delivery of internal and regulatory reports.
Technical Implementation of Data Projects
Support end-to-end technical implementation of data initiatives, including the design of pipelines and ETL/ELT processes (data extraction, transformation, and loading).
Design, document, and maintain automated data ingestion and transformation processes to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
Work closely with IT and business teams to integrate new data sources, ensure compatibility with existing architecture, and implement technical improvements.
Manage and resolve data- and reporting-related incidents promptly to minimize operational impact and ensure system quality and resilience.
Reporting & Communication
Prepare and present periodic reports on Compliance performance, including program KPIs, Risk Profiling status, training metrics, and operational indicators, providing executive-level summaries and detailed operational views.
Publish and maintain reports in Power BI (apps, subscriptions, alerts), implementing appropriate access controls and row-level security.
Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating technical outputs into understandable insights.
Maintain data catalogs, technical documentation, and operational manuals, supporting Data Governance practices and user training on Analytics & Reporting tools and processes.

Who You Are

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, education, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions).


University degree (second-cycle studies / licenciatura or equivalent).
2 to 5 years of proven experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting-related roles.
Advanced English level, enabling effective communication in an international environment.
Proven knowledge and practical experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, and SharePoint.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage incidents and drive continuous improvement.
High degree of autonomy and proactivity, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high standards.
Effective communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts into business-relevant information.
Strong orientation to results, quality, and timely delivery, particularly in regulatory and compliance-related reporting contexts.



What We Offer

It is a brilliant opportunity for you, Grifols is fully aware that its employees are one of its major assets. We are committed to maintaining an atmosphere that encourages all our employees to develop their professional careers in an excellent working environment.

Information about Grifols is available at www.grifols.com. If you are interested in joining our company and you have what it takes for such an exciting position, then don’t hesitate to apply!

We look forward to receiving your application!

We believe in diverse talent and want to remove any barriers that may hinder your participation. If you require any adjustments in our selection process, please do not hesitate to inform us when applying. We are here to help.

Grifols is an equal opportunity employer.

We believe that diversity adds value to our business, our teams, and our culture. We are committed to equal employment opportunities, fostering an inclusive environment where diversity makes us outstanding.

Mission

Your mission will be twofold: to ensure the reliable and efficient operation of existing analytics and reporting solutions, and to support the design and implementation of new data projects that transform information into actionable insights for informed decision-making. This role acts as a technical and analytical reference, working closely with IT and business stakeholders to support Compliance needs through high-quality data solutions.

What Your Responsibilities Will Be

  • Analytics & Reporting Operations
    • Maintain, optimize, and evolve data systems and Business Intelligence platforms that support Compliance activities.
    • Administer, update, and maintain dashboards and reporting models, primarily in Power BI, ensuring accuracy, usefulness, and consistency of information.
    • Guarantee data integrity, availability, and consistency across reporting flows, ensuring day-to-day operational continuity of critical systems and on-time delivery of internal and regulatory reports.
  • Technical Implementation of Data Projects
    • Support end-to-end technical implementation of data initiatives, including the design of pipelines and ETL/ELT processes (data extraction, transformation, and loading).
    • Design, document, and maintain automated data ingestion and transformation processes to improve efficiency and reduce operational risk.
    • Work closely with IT and business teams to integrate new data sources, ensure compatibility with existing architecture, and implement technical improvements.
    • Manage and resolve data- and reporting-related incidents promptly to minimize operational impact and ensure system quality and resilience.
  • Reporting & Communication
    • Prepare and present periodic reports on Compliance performance, including program KPIs, Risk Profiling status, training metrics, and operational indicators, providing executive-level summaries and detailed operational views.
    • Publish and maintain reports in Power BI (apps, subscriptions, alerts), implementing appropriate access controls and row-level security.
    • Collaborate with technical and non-technical stakeholders, translating technical outputs into understandable insights.
    • Maintain data catalogs, technical documentation, and operational manuals, supporting Data Governance practices and user training on Analytics & Reporting tools and processes.
Who You Are

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, education, and/or ability required. Reasonable accommodation may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions).

  • University degree (second-cycle studies / licenciatura or equivalent).
  • 2 to 5 years of proven experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or reporting-related roles.
  • Advanced English level, enabling effective communication in an international environment.
  • Proven knowledge and practical experience with Microsoft Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate, Power Apps, and SharePoint.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage incidents and drive continuous improvement.
  • High degree of autonomy and proactivity, with the ability to work independently while maintaining high standards.
  • Effective communication and collaboration skills, including the ability to translate technical concepts into business-relevant information.
  • Strong orientation to results, quality, and timely delivery, particularly in regulatory and compliance-related reporting contexts.

Title: BI Analyst
Description:
Is this you?

Titan Operating System S.L. (Titan OS), the Barcelona-based technology, entertainment, and advertising company, is looking for you!

Our platform combines content discovery and advertising technology in one solution, helping leading TV brands unlock greater value. Titan OS powers devices from major brands including Philips, AOC and JVC, reaching millions of viewers across Europe and LATAM. Titan OS is also powering free premium FAST Channels on selected SONY Android TVs.

Over the last two years, Titan OS has grown revenue 10x and attracted leading investors, including Highland Europe and Mangrove.

At TitanOS, we live by three core values:


Make things happen - We take ownership, move fast, and deliver impact
No ego - We collaborate with respect and humility to reach shared goals
Show genuine passion - We love what we do and never stop learning


Culture and environment are at the heart of our ethos. If the above resonates with you, keep reading because we believe you could be a perfect addition to our incredible team!

Role overview:

We are looking for a BI Analyst with a wide cross-section of skills, ability and experience. In this role, you will bring data to life through engaging visualizations and compelling insights that help business teams make confident decisions. You will partner with teams across the business to understand their strategic goals and translate them into actionable KPIs and data requirements. Working closely with Data Engineering, you will help define and deliver the data needed to track these metrics effectively.

You will apply your numerical and statistical expertise to identify meaningful patterns, trends, and opportunities within the data, turning your findings into clear recommendations for business teams and Senior Management. You will also help shape how data is used across the organization, driving a more data-driven and data-democratic culture.

Key responsibilities:


Building engaging and intuitive BI dashboards and data visualizations
Accurately capture the data requirements that support the delivery of business objectives
Translate these requirements to the Data Engineering / Science teams and be responsible for their delivery
Proactively bring insights to the attention of the business teams with a high degree of focus on driving revenue and growth opportunities
Become a trusted partner to the business teams you work with. You should be seen as a knowledge peer, with subject-matter expertise in data
Bring new and interesting ideas on how to build data storytelling capabilities
KPI development and tracking - we own the measurement of the business


Requirements

What makes you a great fit:


At least 6 years of professional experience as a Business Intelligence Analyst, Data Product Owner or Data Scientist
A strong numerical background with an MS/BS in Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a science-related discipline
High proficiency in Python and Dbt-SQLMesh
Ability to create tables and develop schemas that function efficiently, are optimized and scalable
Experience with statistical methodologies and A/B (hypothesis) testing is a huge plus
Hands-on experience using BI data visualization tools (Tableau, Looker, Power BI, Open Source, etc)
A data storytelle, that can present data in a compelling and intuitive way
Fantastic communication and interpersonal skills


Benefits

Reasons to apply:


Centrally located office in the heart of Barcelona, with public transportation nearby
Competitive compensation
Private health insurance
Friendly, diverse, and international work environment
Opportunity to work outside of your comfort zone and develop professionally in an exciting and fast-growing CTV industry
Change the future of TV! A unique opportunity to join a well-funded, high-growth company in the early stages to help shape a product/business that will impact millions


If you're excited about this position, don't hesitate to apply. We're waiting for you to join us! And if you want to know more about us, follow us on LinkedIn!

Title: Data Engineering & Analytics Associate
Description:
Metyis is growing! We are looking for a Data Engineering & Analytics Associate with +3 years of experience to join our international Data and Analytics team, based in Barcelona.

Who we are:

Metyis is a global and forward-thinking firm operating across a wide range of industries, developing and delivering Big Data, Digital Commerce, Marketing & Design solutions and Advisory services. At Metyis, our long-term partnership model brings long-lasting impact and growth to our business partners and clients through extensive execution capabilities.

With our team, you can experience a collaborative environment with highly skilled multidisciplinary experts, where everyone has room to build bigger and bolder ideas. Being part of Metyis means you can speak your mind and be creative with your knowledge. Imagine the things you can achieve with a team that encourages you to be the best version of yourself.

We are Metyis. Partners for Impact.

What we offer:


Interact with senior stakeholders at our clients on regular basis to drive their business towards impactful change
Become the go-to person for end-to-end data handling, management, and analytics processes
Working with Data Scientists to take data throughout its lifecycle - acquisition, exploration, data cleaning, integration, analysis, interpretation and visualization
Become part of a fast-growing international and diverse team



What you will do:


Translate business problems into structured analytical approaches and data solutions
Analyse structured and unstructured data to identify insights and opportunities
Build and maintain ETL/ELT pipelines, datasets, and scalable data-processing solutions
Develop automation and analytical solutions using SQL, Python, Scala, or similar tools
Perform data-quality checks, validation, and performance optimisation
Support reporting, advanced analytics, and machine learning use cases
Collaborate with data science, engineering, reporting, product, and business teams
Communicate findings clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders
Manage deliverables across multiple projects and clients



What you´ll bring:


3–6 years of experience in data engineering, analytics, data science, or a hybrid data role
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, Economics, or a related field
Strong SQL skills and good programming knowledge in Python, Scala, or another scripting language
Experience with ETL/ELT pipelines, databases, data warehouses, and data modelling
Ability to analyse data and translate findings into business recommendations
Working knowledge of statistics and machine learning
Experience with Azure, AWS, or GCP
Familiarity with Git and CI/CD is desirable
Strong problem-solving, business understanding, and stakeholder-management skills
Fluency in English, Spanish and Catalan.

Formación Universitaria: Ade, Economía, Marketing, Ingeniería, Matemáticas o similares.

Experiencia previa de mínimo 2 años como Data Analyst. Preferiblemente en una compañía multinacional en el sector de Mass Distribution/Retail/Farmacéutico.
Nivel alto de Excel.
Conocimientos de Qlik Sense, Power BI, Pacvue.
Capacidad para transformar datos en conclusiones relevantes para el negocio
Nivel alto de inglés: B2.2/C1.

Teletrabajo dos días a la semana.
Horario flexible (jornada completa): de lunes a jueves de 8h o 9h a 17:35h o 18:35h con 1h para comer; viernes de 8h o 9h a 14h o 15h.
Jornada intensiva desde el 22 de junio hasta el 6 de septiembre de 8h a 15h.
Salario: salario base + variable + ticket restaurante + ayuda teletrabajo
Beneficios sociales: tarjeta Cobee, seguro médico, plan de pensiones, día de cumpleaños libre, descuento en nuestros productos y en otras firmas, office con víveres, fruta en la oficina,...

Title: Data Scientist
Description:
Como uno de nuestros Data Scientists de Juegos

Serás una de las personas clave que ayuda a transformar preguntas de negocio en insights accionables. Investigarás y analizarás el comportamiento de los jugadores para generar recomendaciones basadas en datos. Para ello, escucharás a los distintos miembros del equipo, comprenderás el contexto y cuestionarás ideas de negocio cuando sea necesario.

Nuestros Data Scientists utilizan una amplia variedad de técnicas, como estadística frecuentista y bayesiana, machine learning, análisis exploratorio y explicativo de datos, inferencia causal, visualización de datos, modelización Monte Carlo, análisis econométrico, entre otras. La amplitud de estas responsabilidades requiere una gran capacidad de aprendizaje, eficiencia en el trabajo colaborativo y habilidad para comunicar datos e insights de forma clara y efectiva.

Los Data Scientists de Juegos son profesionales que impulsan la toma de decisiones de negocio mediante el uso de datos y análisis profundos.

Tendrás la oportunidad de trabajar con conjuntos de datos grandes y complejos, disfrutando de la autonomía necesaria para generar un impacto significativo en el éxito de nuestros juegos. Además, formarás parte de un equipo experimentado y altamente cualificado de aproximadamente 20 profesionales, con múltiples oportunidades de aprendizaje y desarrollo.

Qué harás
Colaborar con los stakeholders para entender y definir los requisitos de análisis.
Realizar análisis exploratorios de datos y convertir los hallazgos en preguntas que puedan responderse mediante técnicas analíticas.
Utilizar analítica avanzada, métodos estadísticos, inferencia causal, machine learning u otras técnicas para responder preguntas y resolver problemas de negocio.
Comunicar los resultados de forma clara y efectiva.
Gestionar requisitos poco definidos o ambiguos.
Explicar análisis complejos e ideas técnicas de manera sencilla y comprensible.
Trabajar de forma autónoma en proyectos complejos.
Mantener una actitud de aprendizaje continuo, adquiriendo nuevas habilidades y metodologías relacionadas con la ciencia de datos, la comunicación o la gestión de stakeholders.
Utilizar una amplia variedad de herramientas y enfoques de ciencia de datos.


Qué buscamos
Titulación universitaria o experiencia equivalente en un área orientada a los datos.
Capacidad para utilizar técnicas de visualización de datos con el fin de comunicar análisis e insights de manera efectiva.
Experiencia utilizando alguna de las siguientes disciplinas para responder preguntas de negocio o científicas: estadística, matemáticas, machine learning, econometría, inferencia causal, modelización Monte Carlo, entre otras.
Experiencia trabajando con R y/o Python.
Conocimientos y experiencia en SQL.


¿Por qué Aristocrat?

Aristocrat es una empresa líder a nivel mundial en contenido y tecnología de juegos, y una editorial de referencia en juegos móviles gratuitos. Ofrecemos un alto rendimiento a nuestros clientes B2B y hacemos participes a millones de personas que disfrutan con nuestros juegos de casino y para móviles. Y aunque nos centramos en la diversión, no olvidamos nunca nuestras responsabilidades. Nos esforzamos para ser referentes en juego responsable y elevar los estándares en gobernanza corporativa, bienestar de los empleados y sostenibilidad. Somos una empresa diversa, unida por valores comunes y una misión inspiradora: llenar de alegría la vida gracias al poder del juego.

Nuestro compromiso es crear un entorno en el que se valoren las diferencias individuales y donde todos los empleados tengan la oportunidad de desarrollar su potencial. Damos la bienvenida y animamos a presentar su candidatura a personas de todas las edades, géneros, razas, etnias, orígenes culturales, condición de discapacidad o que se identifiquen como parte del colectivo LGBTQ+. Description:

Desde Eurostars Hotel Company, compañía líder en el sector turístico y hotelero, buscamos un/a Data Scientist con foco en infraestructura y soluciones de datos para incorporarse a nuestro equipo de Data.




La persona seleccionada trabajará junto a Data Scientists, Data Analysts, Data Engineers, equipos de IT y áreas de negocio para desarrollar soluciones de datos robustas, escalables y orientadas a la toma de decisiones.




Buscamos un perfil técnico, con al menos 2 años de experiencia, acostumbrado a trabajar con entornos cloud, automatización de procesos, integración de sistemas y puesta en producción de soluciones analíticas.







El rol de Data Scientist – Data Infrastructure




Entender necesidades de negocio y traducirlas en soluciones técnicas sólidas y mantenibles.
Participar en el diseño, desarrollo y mantenimiento de infraestructura para soluciones de datos y analítica.
Trabajar en la integración de datos procedentes de APIs, bases de datos, sistemas corporativos y servicios cloud.
Desarrollar procesos automatizados de extracción, transformación, validación y carga de datos.
Diseñar y mantener pipelines, scripts, jobs y procesos que den soporte al equipo de Data.
Asegurar la calidad, trazabilidad, monitorización y mantenimiento de los procesos desarrollados.
Colaborar con perfiles de Data, IT y negocio para poner en producción soluciones estables y escalables.
Proponer mejoras en automatización, rendimiento, fiabilidad y control de errores.







Requisitos mínimos




Experiencia previa de al menos 2 años como Data Scientist, Data Engineer, Analytics Engineer, Machine Learning Engineer o perfil similar.
Experiencia trabajando con infraestructura de datos, entornos cloud o despliegue de soluciones analíticas.
Conocimientos sólidos de Python y/o R.
Conocimientos avanzados de SQL y bases de datos relacionales.
Experiencia desarrollando pipelines, procesos automatizados o integraciones entre sistemas.
Conocimientos de APIs, procesos batch, jobs programados o servicios de datos.
Buenas prácticas de desarrollo: documentación, modularización, control de versiones, validación y mantenimiento.
Capacidad para entender necesidades de negocio y convertirlas en soluciones técnicas.
Buena comunicación con perfiles técnicos y no técnicos.







Valoraremos también




Experiencia previa en el sector hotelero, turístico, retail, revenue management, pricing o entornos con alta orientación comercial.
Conocimiento de métricas hoteleras.
Conocimientos de AWS y Microsoft Fabric.
Experiencia en Azure, Synapse, Databricks o entornos cloud similares.
Experiencia con data warehouses, data lakes, lakehouses o plataformas corporativas de datos.
Conocimientos de orquestación, monitorización, alertas, logs y control de errores.
Experiencia con procesos near real time o integraciones entre aplicaciones corporativas.
Conocimientos de Docker, Git, CI/CD o despliegue de servicios internos.







Lo que buscamos




Personas con visión técnica, orientación a negocio y capacidad para construir soluciones que funcionen en producción.
Autonomía, responsabilidad y criterio técnico.
Capacidad para estructurar problemas y proponer soluciones mantenibles y escalables.
Buena comunicación y capacidad para explicar conceptos técnicos de forma sencilla.
Interés por entender el negocio hotelero y cómo los datos pueden ayudar a mejorarlo.
Mentalidad colaborativa para trabajar con perfiles de Data, IT y negocio.







Además, al formar parte de Grupo Hotusa podrás disfrutar de los siguientes beneficios:




50% de descuento en nuestros hoteles de alta gama: Podrás beneficiarte de descuentos de hasta el 50% en todos nuestros magníficos hoteles 4*/5* alrededor del mundo y hasta un 20% para tus familiares.




Formación The Power Business School: Acceso 100% gratuito e ilimitado a todas las formaciones (MBA, digital, ofimática, Skills etc) de la mano de nuestro partner The Power Business School, la escuela de negocios online nº 1 del mercado e impartida por los mejores profesionales en activo del sector.

Acceso a nuestro Club del Empleado: donde podrás beneficiarte de diferentes tipos de descuentos y ventajas de todo tipo (ocio, tecnología, deporte, moda etc)

Title: Data Analyst
Description:
Groupe SEB, reconocida como una de las mejores empresas para trabajar en España - GREAT PLACE TO WORK 2022 & 2024 - es la compañía líder mundial en su sector.




Rowenta, Tefal, Moulinex, Krups, Lagostina, WMF, Emsa... son algunas de las 30 marcas que pertenecen a Groupe SEB y que son parte de la vida diaria de millones de consumidores en más de 150 países. Con 34.000 empleados y 8.000 M€ de ventas anuales, Groupe SEB es el fabricante líder mundial de pequeños electrodomésticos y utensilios de cocina gracias a la fortaleza de sus marcas, su apuesta por la innovación, su crecimiento internacional y su visión de futuro.




Buscamos un/a Data Analyst formando parte del equipo de ventas online en el departamento Comercial. La persona estará ubicada en nuestras oficinas centrales en Poblenou (Barcelona) y reportará al E-Commerce Activation y al equipo online de Key Accounts.




Funciones




Tu misión será extraer datos, crear dashboards y transformar estos datos en insights accionables, contribuyendo a optimizar el rendimiento de nuestras principales cuentas online.




Dashboards, Análisis y seguimiento de KPIs: Preparación, análisis y seguimiento de indicadores cualitativos y cuantitativos relacionados con la actividad online.
Creación y mantenimiento del Dashboard comercial de Amazon.
Compartir con los equipos EU5 la evolución de la cuenta de Amazon.
Configuración y elaboración de informes mediante herramientas destinadas a monitorizar contenidos.
Manejo de otras herramientas relacionadas con las ventas online.




¿Qué te ayudará a ser el mejor candidato/a?

Formación Universitaria: Ade, Economía, Marketing, Ingeniería, Matemáticas o similares.
Se valorará una titulación adicional relacionada con el eCommerce.
Experiencia previa de mínimo 2 años como Data Analyst. Preferiblemente en una compañía multinacional en el sector de Mass Distribution/Retail/Farmacéutico.
Nivel alto de Excel.
Conocimientos de Qlik Sense, Power BI, Pacvue.
Capacidad para transformar datos en conclusiones relevantes para el negocio
Nivel alto de inglés: B2.2/C1.




Qué ofrecemos?




Teletrabajo dos días a la semana.
Horario flexible (jornada completa): de lunes a jueves de 8h o 9h a 17:35h o 18:35h con 1h para comer; viernes de 8h o 9h a 14h o 15h.
Jornada intensiva desde el 22 de junio hasta el 6 de septiembre de 8h a 15h.
Salario: salario base + variable + ticket restaurante + ayuda teletrabajo
Beneficios sociales: tarjeta Cobee, seguro médico, plan de pensiones, día de cumpleaños libre, descuento en nuestros productos y en otras firmas, office con víveres, fruta en la oficina,...




En Groupe SEB apostamos por la diversidad generacional, cultural, de género y la integración de personas con capacidades diferentes. Tenemos una cultura "Employee Centric", donde se potencia la generación de ideas, la comunicación abierta, la participación en la toma de decisiones y donde las personas puedan formarse y desarrollarse como profesionales conciliando sus responsabilidades personales.




El 88% de nuestros empleados afirman que Groupe SEB es una gran empresa para trabajar.

Title: Product Data Analyst
Description:
Product Data Analyst – Job Description

SCRM – LIDL

Digital

Hub

About The Role

We are looking for a Product Data Analyst who will share our passion for excellence and continuous challenge.

We are seeking a driven and detail-oriented Product Data Analyst to join our agile team. This key role will be centered around a specific product and will require an individual who is confident in making data-driven decisions autonomously, with the backing of a knowledgeable and collaborative team. This role will involve a balance of in-depth data analysis, data quality assurance, cross-functional collaboration, and business-oriented approach, all in service of our mission to continuously improve our products.

We seek individuals who are meticulous, capable problem-solvers and possess a strong aptitude for data analysis. If you are excited by the prospect of uncovering trends in large datasets and translating data-driven insights into actionable strategies, we would be delighted to hear from you.

Ready to be part of the challenge?

In this Role, you'll get to

Build dashboards, reports, and visualizations.

Define success metrics, design experiments, and evaluate feature performance.

Translate complex datasets into actionable insights and strategic recommendations.

Analyze user behavior and product usage data to identify trends, pain points, and growth opportunities.

Conduct deep-dive analyses to support product launches, A/B tests, and user experience improvements.

Act as a data referent for a designated product within an agile squad, leading all data-related activities and decisions.

Ensure the quality and consistency of product-related datasets within our data ecosystem, identifying areas for continual improvement.

Champion a culture of data-informed decision-making within the squad and the wider organization, educating team members on the benefits of a data-focused approach.

Develop, implement, and manage efficient data pipelines to support data extraction and analysis, enhancing the quality of insights for both product development and customer experience.

Required Skills

Experience with Databricks and BigQuery.

Experience with orchestration tools such as Airflow and DBT.

Familiarity with Git for version control and CI/CD operations.

Previous experience in a Cloud environment, preferably Azure.

Knowledge of SQL and Python for data extraction and manipulation.

A solid understanding of data structures and data manipulation methodologies.

Experience with A/B testing, experimentation, and product analytics frameworks.

Experience building and shipping digital products based on continuous discovery.

Previous experience working in Mobile App products with Firebase as tracking tool.

Practical experience using Jira, Confluence, and other Atlassian tools in agile development.

Familiarity with data management tools and their application to both structured and unstructured data.

Excellent collaboration and communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to work effectively in a multidisciplinary agile team.

Our stack ?

Dashboarding tools: Databricks

SQL for structured data storage and querying.

Visual Studio / PyCharm for code development.

Airflow and DBT for data orchestration and transformation.

Azure DevOps for version control and development operations.

Databricks with PySpark for large-scale data processing and analytics.

JIRA and Confluence for knowledge management and team collaboration.

About Us

Who we are

SCRM was created in **** with a vision of the future that foresaw "business and technology forever remaining intertwined", and a steadfast mission to guide traditional businesses towards digital evolution through their clients, data, commercial strategies and omnichannel communication. Specialising in digital strategy, automation and real-time offer and content customisation, SCRM owes its success and efficiency to the use of cloud computing and the development of data platforms which rely on artificial intelligence for automatic decision-making in largescale consumer and retail markets.

SCRM Lidl International Hub - Three years later, Lidl has absorbed the company and turned it into their international hub of digitalisation and customer intelligence. Amongst our missions as Lidl's International Hub, we would highlight the following: The conceptualisation and development of Lidl Plus, a Lidl international relational programme, and its benefit plan, which will offer discounts, exclusive services, agreements with third-party entities and financial services as its fundamental features; The creation of a cloud-based international platform for big data; The development of an international marketing automation platform; The conceptualisation, development and management of business intelligence platforms; The creation of an omnichannel payment platform; The development of advanced analytics and machine learning platforms favouring customer recommendation, foresight and analysis systems; The creation and implementation of an omnichannel, single sign-on strategy to generate business opportunities amongst the group's diverse range of commercial platforms and services.

SCRM is currently part of Schwarz Digits - Schwarz Digits is the IT and digital division of Schwarz Group. It offers compelling digital products and services that meet Germany's high data protection standards. Schwarz Digits thus guarantees the greatest possible digital sovereignty. With this claim, Schwarz Digits provides the IT infrastructure and solutions for the extensive ecosystem of the companies of Schwarz Group and develops it further for the future. Schwarz Digits creates optimal conditions for the development of trend-setting innovations for end customers, companies and public sector organizations.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
Due to continuous growth, our Product team is excited to welcome a highly analytical Product Analyst to help us align data-driven decision-making with business goals across three products at once, each at a different stage.

As Product Analyst, you'll operate on the intersection of product analytics and business analysis: you don't just explain why a funnel underperforms, you translate that into what it means in euros, risk, and compliance terms. You'll work in a fully MCP-equipped, AI-native environment, own the event taxonomy across all three products, automate recurring reporting so you have the time to go genuinely deep on each product, and act as the go-to person for the Growth team on everything A/B testing.

Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Growth, SEM, and Payments, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful, structural impact — not just on individual metrics, but on how the whole team thinks about data.

If you're passionate about solving complex problems, taking full ownership without waiting to be asked, and driving results across multiple products at once, this role is perfect for you!

Key Responsibilities

Product analytics core


Independently run funnel, cohort, and retention analysis in Amplitude across all three products.
Design and interpret experiments (A/B tests), with a clear eye for primary vs. diagnostic metrics.
Go deeper than headline numbers through segmentation (by country, user segment, acquisition channel, etc.).


Go-to person for Growth on A/B testing


Be the single point of contact for the Growth team on everything experiment-related: test design, sample size, choice of primary vs. diagnostic metrics, and interpretation of results.
Be consulted before a test goes live, not only once results come in — safeguarding experiment quality upfront, not just in hindsight.
Recognize and correct common experimentation pitfalls (peeking, dependent variants, poorly chosen success metrics) before they lead to a flawed rollout decision.


Business and risk layer


Translate product metrics into unit economics: what a conversion drop costs in ARPPU, CAC, or margin.
Model scenarios (e.g. the impact of a price change on both conversion and downstream risk indicators).
Produce output that non-product stakeholders (Payments, SEM, Growth, Finance, C-level) can act on directly — not only PMs.


Ownership: taxonomy & reporting


Own the event taxonomy across all products: proactively track which events are live or deprecated, document renames as they happen, and prevent outdated event names (in skills, dashboards, or AI prompts) from silently producing wrong conclusions. This is a recurring responsibility, not a one-off documentation task — every product release can affect the taxonomy.
Automate reporting to free up time for depth: turn recurring analyses (funnel health, KPI reviews, country splits) from manual pulls into self-running dashboards/skills, so stakeholders always have current numbers without needing to ask an analyst — and so the time freed up goes into genuinely deep analysis per product, not more of the same routine work.
Proactively dig into where things "leak": don't wait to be asked — actively look for underperforming segments or funnel steps, and for untapped business opportunities surfacing from the data, then raise them unprompted with PMs or the Project Director.


Take the team by the hand, analytically


This is not a purely individual-contributor role: bring PMs (and other stakeholders) along in how you reach a conclusion, not just what the conclusion is, so they get better themselves at asking the right data question.
Actively spot and correct conclusions that the data doesn't support (e.g. correlation presented as causation, or an underpowered sample treated as significant).
Be the team's analytical conscience: when there's doubt about a number or interpretation, you're the person people turn to — and you take on that responsibility proactively rather than waiting to be asked.


AI leverage


Work in an environment fully set up with MCPs (Amplitude, Databricks, Linear, Google Drive, etc.) — this is the default way of working, not an experiment on the side.
Build and maintain reusable Amplitude skills and analysis tooling.
Use LLMs actively for query generation, first-pass analysis, and reporting.
Critically evaluate and correct AI output: recognize when a model uses an outdated event name, incorrectly sums a non-additive metric, repeats a stale assumption, or draws a conclusion the underlying data doesn't support.
Know when not to trust AI: with ambiguous data, conflicting results, or output that sounds "too clean."


Required Skills

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional analytical depth with genuine ownership and the ability to bring others along. Here's what we're looking for:


Exceptional analytical ability — this isn't a "can write adequate SQL" role; you spot patterns others miss, untangle conflicting signals, and reach the right conclusion under time pressure.

You'll work in a fully MCP-equipped, AI-native environment, own the event taxonomy across all three products, automate recurring reporting so you have the time to go genuinely deep on each product, and act as the go-to person for the Growth team on everything A/B testing.

Working closely with Product Managers, Engineering, Growth, SEM, and Payments, you'll have the opportunity to make a meaningful, structural impact — not just on individual metrics, but on how the whole team thinks about data.

If you're passionate about solving complex problems, taking full ownership without waiting to be asked, and driving results across multiple products at once, this role is perfect for you!

Key Responsibilities

Product analytics core

  • Independently run funnel, cohort, and retention analysis in Amplitude across all three products.
  • Design and interpret experiments (A/B tests), with a clear eye for primary vs. diagnostic metrics.
  • Go deeper than headline numbers through segmentation (by country, user segment, acquisition channel, etc.).

Go-to person for Growth on A/B testing

  • Be the single point of contact for the Growth team on everything experiment-related: test design, sample size, choice of primary vs. diagnostic metrics, and interpretation of results.
  • Be consulted before a test goes live, not only once results come in — safeguarding experiment quality upfront, not just in hindsight.
  • Recognize and correct common experimentation pitfalls (peeking, dependent variants, poorly chosen success metrics) before they lead to a flawed rollout decision.

Business and risk layer

  • Translate product metrics into unit economics: what a conversion drop costs in ARPPU, CAC, or margin.
  • Model scenarios (e.g. the impact of a price change on both conversion and downstream risk indicators).
  • Produce output that non-product stakeholders (Payments, SEM, Growth, Finance, C-level) can act on directly — not only PMs.

Ownership: taxonomy & reporting

  • Own the event taxonomy across all products: proactively track which events are live or deprecated, document renames as they happen, and prevent outdated event names (in skills, dashboards, or AI prompts) from silently producing wrong conclusions. This is a recurring responsibility, not a one-off documentation task — every product release can affect the taxonomy.
  • Automate reporting to free up time for depth: turn recurring analyses (funnel health, KPI reviews, country splits) from manual pulls into self-running dashboards/skills, so stakeholders always have current numbers without needing to ask an analyst — and so the time freed up goes into genuinely deep analysis per product, not more of the same routine work.
  • Proactively dig into where things "leak": don't wait to be asked — actively look for underperforming segments or funnel steps, and for untapped business opportunities surfacing from the data, then raise them unprompted with PMs or the Project Director.

Take the team by the hand, analytically

  • This is not a purely individual-contributor role: bring PMs (and other stakeholders) along in how you reach a conclusion, not just what the conclusion is, so they get better themselves at asking the right data question.

Collaborate with stakeholders to understand data needs.
Develop and maintain data dashboards and reporting tools that provide intuitive access to key metrics and insights, supported by clear documentation and update schedules.

Ensure data accuracy and consistency through the implementation of data quality checks, validation rules, and regular reconciliation processes with source systems.

Ability to analyse datasets, detect trends, and deliver evidence-based insights.
Skill in presenting findings with visuals and storytelling that support decisions.
Commitment to maintaining accuracy, consistency, and integrity in reporting.
Ability to resolve data issues and propose actionable improvements.
Competence in managing tasks and delivering insights on time.
Drive to explore new methods, tools, and data sources proactively.

About Four Seasons

Four Seasons is powered by our people. We are a collective of individuals who crave to become better, to push ourselves to new heights and to treat each other as we wish to be treated in return. Our team members around the world create amazing experiences for our guests, residents, and partners through a commitment to luxury with genuine heart. We know that the best way to enable our people to deliver these exceptional guest experiences is through a world-class employee experience and company culture.

At Four Seasons, we believe in recognizing a familiar face, welcoming a new one and treating everyone we meet the way we would want to be treated ourselves. Whether you work with us, stay with us, live with us or discover with us, we believe our purpose is to create impressions that will stay with you for a lifetime. It comes from our belief that life is richer when we truly connect to the people and the world around us.

About the location:

Four Seasons Resort Mallorca at Formentor, perched on the spectacular Formentor Peninsula and surrounded by panoramic views of the Mediterranean and the stunning landscape, first opened its doors in August 2024 following an extensive restoration and renovation of the historic property, originally inaugurated in 1929 on a vast private estate. After its successful debut, the resort will reopen to guests in March 2025, reaffirming its status as a unique destination of luxury and elegance on the island.

About The Role

The Revenue Analyst will be working with the Director of Revenue to define, design, develop and execute business reports and analyses that establish actionable business insights into the performance of both brand level and property specific revenue trends and opportunities.

What You Will Do


Strategy Support: By assisting the Director of Revenue Management with essential administrative duties and fulfil reporting and analysis tasks, it will ensure that the RM strategies as defined by the team can be executed in an efficient and pro-active manner. Providing contingency along with the Reservations Manager in the event of absence is also an element in the delivery of strategy objectives.
Closely monitor competitive pricing and understand the impact of relative pricing decisions on property performance. Perform competitor checks and report as appropriate.
Assist the DORM in identifying soft periods and developing promotions and strategies.
Support the DORM in effective implementation of Four Seasons Revenue Management Standards, Policies & Procedures. (Rate Plans, Rate Categories, Market Segmentation, Profiles, and all other PMS/ORS related RM functionality.)
Action Rate Solicitations as directed and maintain rate plans.
Ensure the hotel has Best Rate Guarantee compliance, and work with the DORM to minimize/eliminate rate parity claims against the hotel.
Assist the DORM with daily updates of the Revenue Management Reports and ensure all data input into the system is accurate. (Geo Source, Product Quality, Pricing). Opportunity to assist with all aspects of budget preparation.
Assist in the preparation of 30-60-90 day fully updated Forecasts. Work with the DORM to prepare longer term forecasts and achieve hotel forecast accuracy goals.
Participate in the property’s weekly Strategy Meeting and contribute to the Daily Operations Meeting.
Review and analyze data on an ongoing and end of month basis. Provide monthly reports on production, trends, booking and stay patterns as well as channel analysis. Evaluation of the distribution channel performance and potential reasons for this performance.
Analyze competitive reports and formulate appropriate suggestions for strategies through use of STR Reports.
Daily communication with our Reservations and Front Office and Sales team to share best practices.
