Job Description

Title: Technical Analyst, Automation & Reporting

Location: Barcelona, Spain

Reports to: Director, Automation & Reporting

The Role

Dow Jones is seeking a Technical Analyst to join our global Automation & Reporting team, utilizing SQL, Python, and JavaScript to build automation solutions, robust reporting capabilities and manage high volumes of data across Dow Jones products. In this role, you will partner closely with multiple business teams to analyze the databases they own and design innovative technical solutions that automate their core business processes.

As a key technical partner, you will manage a portfolio of deliverables in parallel, bridging the gap between complex business problems and functional technical solutions. You will be responsible for eliciting requirements from stakeholders, translating them into optimized business-centric processes, and effectively communicating progress and blockers to ensure continuous operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities


Solution Design & Development: Design, develop, and maintain optimized solutions to meet reporting and process improvement needs. Write clean, readable code, build highly optimized SQL queries, and develop robust ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) jobs and tools.
Data Visualization & Interface Design : Design and develop interactive, high-impact dashboards and front-end reporting interfaces. Apply UI/UX best practices to translate complex data sets into clear, accessible, and actionable visual layouts, ensuring a seamless user experience for non-technical stakeholders and executive leadership.
Stakeholder & Portfolio Management: Manage a diverse portfolio of solutions while working closely with multiple stakeholders. Identify high-impact business problems, elicit solution requirements, and effectively communicate progress and blockers to both project teams and executive sponsors.
Process Improvement & Ad-Hoc Support: Design and own business-centric reporting processes that actively improve the organization's operational efficiency. Remain flexible and responsive to ad hoc and urgent reporting requests in a fast-paced environment.
Best Practices & Quality Assurance: Adopt and continuously contribute to the improvement of existing technical best practices. Ensure high standards across solution design, development, validation, and documentation.


Qualifications


Essential Experience: Undergraduate degree in a quantitative field (Computer Science, Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics) or equivalent training. Self-starter capable of working independently, coordinating with multiple partners, and driving complex projects from conception to finish.
Technical Proficiency: 3+ years of experience utilizing SQL and Python for data analysis and data processing. Detail-oriented with a strict focus on assuring quality, consistency, and accuracy in data and processes. Proven experience working with version control systems like Git.
Visualization & UI Expertise: Proven hands-on experience with industry-standard BI tools (e.g. Quicksight, Tableau, Power BI, Looker) and front-end UI development (e.g. JavaScript charting libraries, HTML/CSS). Strong understanding of user-centered design principles, wireframing, and building intuitive user interfaces that drive user adoption.
Delivery & Communication: Agile mindset with a track record of successful delivery through agile practices. Exceptional communication skills, with a demonstrated ability to translate technical information clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences. Open to different viewpoints with a strong appreciation for team diversity.
Preferred Skills: Experience in ETL development, data visualization, and building dashboards. Familiarity with managing large datasets in a fluid environment and solving complex, non-routine problems. Experience with cloud services such as AWS (including Glue, Athena, S3) or GCP, Google APIs, and other programming languages like JavaScript. Knowledge of AI tools (Copilot, Claude Code), Data Science, and predictive modeling is highly desired.


Our Benefits


Comprehensive Healthcare Plans for you and your family (paid by Dow Jones)
Extra paid Time Off (30 days of holidays/year)
Possibility to work remotely for 3 months/year (desplazamiento program) or one week of remote work per quarter
Meal benefit with Pluxee (171€/month on top of your salary)
Retirement Plans (Dow Jones will pay 2% of a members Pensionable Salary and match employee contribution up to a maximum of 3 %).
Comprehensive Insurance Plans
Well-being Resources (200 USD allowance per quarter, Classpass, etc.)
Family Care Benefits & Caregiving Support
Subscription Discounts
Employee Referral Program


Hybrid

Title: Data Analytics Consultant
Description:
At Efficio, we're not just a consulting firm; we're a team of dedicated experts committed to transforming procurement and supply chain functions. Our mission is to drive sustainable, measurable value for our clients through innovative solutions and deep industry insights. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and ideas make a real impact.

Efficio is the world’s largest specialist procurement and supply chain consultancy, with offices across Europe, North America, and the Middle East. We’re a diverse team of over 1,000 individuals, representing more than 60 different nationalities and speaking 40+ languages – and we’re continuing to grow rapidly!

We are recruiting for our Lisbon Office where you'll be joining a growing team of nearly 200 people. Consultants based in Lisbon will support clients globally with the opportunity for international travel. Our consultants provide flexible support to clients whether it is a rapid assessment, short term savings realisation or embedding in a long-term partnership to deliver lasting and measurable value to clients.

This role sits within Efficio's Digital Delivery team, working at the intersection of consulting, data and technology.

Rather than building dashboards or maintaining internal reporting, you'll use data to solve real procurement and supply chain challenges for global clients.

You'll work alongside our consulting teams to understand client data, assess its quality, build analytical datasets such as Spend Cubes, and deliver insights that directly influence sourcing decisions and business outcomes.

Every project is different. One week you might be analysing ERP data for a global manufacturer, while the next you're helping consultants understand supplier spend patterns or using Python to automate data preparation for a new client engagement.

This is a hands-on delivery role combining technical problem-solving, analytical thinking and client collaboration.

What You’ll Be Doing


Work alongside consulting teams on global procurement and supply chain transformation projects.
Gather, assess and understand client data from ERP systems and other sources.
Clean, transform and structure complex datasets into analytical models such as Spend Cubes.
Develop data pipelines and automate repetitive data preparation activities using Python, SQL and AI.
Analyse procurement and spend data to uncover sourcing opportunities and support consulting recommendations.
Use AI-enabled tools and internal technologies to improve delivery efficiency.
Collaborate with consultants and client stakeholders to understand business problems and translate them into data solutions.
Present findings clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Continuously identify opportunities to improve delivery processes through knowledge sharing and automation.


What we are looking for:


At least 3 years of professional experience in data analytics, business intelligence, analytics engineering, data consulting, or a related field.
Experience working with SQL.
Experience using Python for data manipulation or automation.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Experience working with and processing varied, disparate datasets.
Familiarity with Excel and data visualisation tools. We are using Sigma, but experience in PowerBI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik or similar will be valued).
Curious and eager to understand how businesses operate.
Comfortable working in across multiple projects.
Strong communication skills.


Nice to have:


Experience working with ERP data (SAP, Oracle, Dynamics, etc.)
Procurement or supply chain exposure
Experience with AI-assisted analytics or automation
Experience in consulting or client-facing delivery


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

Eagerness to learn and develop — you thrive in a fast-moving environment and proactively grow your skills.
Great communication skills — you can translate technical findings into clear narratives for non-technical audiences.
Comfort with ambiguity and complexity — you navigate unstructured problems with ease and bring clarity to chaos.
Ability to work independently and as part of a team — you're self-driven but collaborative when it counts.

The best solutions come from different voices. We're building a culture where inclusion, respect, and equal opportunity aren't policies — they're lived every day. Title: Data Analytics Specialist
HTML:
Join Us

At Vodafone, we’re not just shaping the future of connectivity for our customers – we’re shaping the future for everyone who joins our team. When you work with us, you’re part of a global mission to connect people, solve complex challenges, and create a sustainable and more inclusive world. If you want to grow your career whilst finding the perfect balance between work and life, Vodafone offers the opportunities to help you belong and make a real impact.

Cyber Defence Operations (CDO) is Vodafone Group’s Cyber Defence Centre of Excellence, accountable for protecting Vodafone, its customers and its services against global cyber risk.

The Analytics Specialist is responsible for developing cross-Cyber Defence analytics and insight products that provide a holistic, asset-centric view of Vodafone’s security, operational and risk posture.

The role works across CTU, CSOC, CDIR and Security Testing & Exposure Management to aggregate, model and interpret data from multiple platforms, helping identify systemic patterns, control weaknesses, operational trends and emerging risks.

The role translates complex technical and operational data into trusted, reusable analytics that support incident response, threat-led defence, vulnerability prioritisation, exposure reduction, control improvement and leadership decision-making.

What You’ll Do

  • Define and own cross-Cyber Defence analytics use cases that provide trend-based and asset-centric insight across threat, monitoring, incident response, vulnerability and exposure management domains;
  • Design and maintain end-to-end analytics pipelines, from data sourcing and modelling through to dashboards, insights and executive-ready outputs;
  • Aggregate and normalise data from multiple platforms including Elastic data lakes, Dynatrace, Power BI, cloud platforms and cyber security tooling, ensuring consistency, quality and reusability;
  • Develop asset-centric views that correlate telemetry across infrastructure, applications, services, incidents, vulnerabilities and security controls to support a joined-up understanding of risk and performance;
  • Produce long-term trend analysis, behavioural baselining and forecasting to identify emerging risks, control degradation, systemic issues and opportunities for improvement;
  • Build and maintain dashboards and analytical products that translate complex datasets into clear, actionable insight for technical and non-technical stakeholders;
  • Work across CTU, CSOC, Incident Management, STEM, and wider Technology, Network and Platform teams to shape analytics requirements, define success measures and ensure outputs align to real operational and strategic questions
  • Apply analytical and statistical techniques such as time-series analysis, clustering and regression to extract meaning from large, high-volume datasets;
  • Ensure analytics outputs are explainable, repeatable and trusted, with clear documentation, assumptions and data lineage;
  • Contribute analytical insight to strategic planning, operational reviews, risk discussions, investment decisions and control improvement initiatives across Vodafone;
  • Support the evolution of Cyber Defence analytics capabilities, including improved data models, shared metrics, and more effective use of security, operational and exposure data;
  • Contribute to cyber reporting, dashboards and briefings, ensuring accurate, timely and data-driven insights are shared with the right stakeholders


Who You Are

  • Demonstrable experience (typically 3–5 years) in data analytics, business intelligence, data science or a related analytical role;
  • Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience;
  • Working towards, or willingness to obtain, relevant certifications such as Power BI Data Analyst, Azure Data Fundamentals, or data analytics / data science certifications is desirable;
  • Strong experience in data analytics, business intelligence or data science, ideally within a cyber, technology or risk environment;
  • Strong analytical mindset with the ability to translate broad operational questions into scalable data models, metrics and visualisations;
  • Experience working with enterprise analytics and observability platforms such as Power BI, Elastic, Dynatrace, Splunk or similar;
  • Proven ability to work across large and complex datasets to identify trends, correlations, anomalies and emerging risks;
  • Comfortable engaging with stakeholders across cyber security, technology and leadership to understand problems and frame useful analytical questions;
  • Able to communicate insights clearly through visuals, storytelling and written narrative, tailored to different audiences;
  • Advanced capability in Power BI, including data modelling, DAX, visualisation and dashboard design;

Title: Data Analyst (m/f/d) - Revenue Intelligence
Description:
Engineered in Berlin. Driving the Future of Europe.



At AUTODOC, we are proud to be a homegrown European success story. Founded in Berlin in 2008 and still headquartered in the heart of the continent today, we have evolved from a local specialist into Europe’s leading online platform for the automotive aftermarket. Our strength lies in our unique identity: we are a digital-first, e-commerce powerhouse with strong German roots and an expansive reach across 27 European countries. This continental focus allows us to blend our heritage with high-tech innovation, staying agile and closely connected to the markets we serve.



Today, our team of more than 5,500 professionals from over 50 different countries is redefining mobility through cutting-edge technology. Bring your talent and expertise to a company that is building a sustainable, tech-driven future for drivers everywhere.



Come join us and impact the future of AUTODOC!





Job Description



About the Role



As our business scales across 27 European markets, understanding the mechanics behind our financial performance and identifying new revenue streams is vital. We need an experienced analytical professional who can translate complex datasets into actionable business strategies and take ownership of high-impact initiatives.



To achieve this goal, we are hiring a Data Analyst (m/f/d) to join our Revenue Intelligence team. In this role, you will act as a key strategic partner to our leadership, working closely with our Head of Revenue Intelligence and Chief Revenue Officer, while collaborating cross-functionally with Marketing, Customer Management and other teams.



You will focus on dissecting revenue dynamics, building predictive models and developing automated anomaly detection systems to safeguard and boost performance. You will leverage SQL and Python to run causal inference analyses, evaluate pricing initiatives and uncover performance drivers across our e-commerce ecosystem. Beyond technical execution, a key part of your mission will be data storytelling—translating advanced statistical concepts into clear, compelling insights for non-technical stakeholders.



This is an exciting opportunity for a self-starter who thrives on autonomy, proactive problem-solving and high visibility. You will have the direct space to pitch independent ideas, shape analytical frameworks and immediately influence commercial outcomes in a fast-paced scale-up environment.



What You Will Do



Monitor revenue and profit trends continuously across diverse e-commerce dimensions.



Build automated detection systems and frameworks to identify performance anomalies, early warning signals and degradation drivers.



Conduct deep root-cause analyses and apply causal inference methods to distinguish correlation from causation in business performance changes.



Quantify factor contributions to revenue shifts and evaluate commercial initiatives like pricing strategies or category launches.



Communicate analytical findings effectively to cross-functional partners and present actionable insights to senior leadership.



Utilize advanced tools, data processing models and modern analytics technologies to enhance team productivity and workflow automation.





Qualifications



Proven experience (5-7 years) in economic analysis, revenue management, or financial planning and analysis (FP&A), ideally within e-commerce, retail or tech.



Academic background in Economics, Data Science or a related quantitative field.



Strong technical proficiency in SQL for advanced data extraction and transformation.



Fluency in Python for data analysis, statistical modeling and analytical processing (e.g., pandas, numpy,etc ).



Solid understanding of statistics, econometrics, time series forecasting, regression and segmentation.



Excellent communication and data storytelling skills, with the ability to bridge complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders.



Proactive mindset with a collaborative approach and strong problem-solving drive.



Professional fluency in English.





Additional Information


Competitive salaries based on your professional experience
Fast growing international company with stable employment
Annual vacation of 25 working days and 1 additional day off on your birthday
Day off on Municipality day and Carnaval
Meal Allowance (8 euros per working day)
Fidelidade Healthcare Plan (Comprehensive health coverage with the option to include your partner and children at discounted rates).
Mental Wellbeing Program through the OpenUp platform
AUTODOC corporate discount for purchasing car parts at special rates for personal use
Exclusive retail discounts via our ‘Benefits at Work’ portal
Learning & Development (over 650 courses on soft and hard skills on our e-learning platform)

This job was posted on 31/08/2026 and is considering applications up to 6 weeks from this date.

Title: AI Product Analyst - Voice AI Agents
Description:
MEDvidi is an AI-powered mental healthcare platform setting a new standard for safe, effective, and scalable psychiatric care in the United States. We combine licensed providers with proprietary AI tools to deliver consistent, outcomes-driven treatment for conditions like ADHD, anxiety, depression, and more. MEDvidi's technology automates charting, follow-ups, and treatment planning, freeing providers to focus on patient care while improving efficiency and clinical quality.

At MEDvidi, the AI Receptionist Team builds and improves Voice AI Agents that interact directly with patients and automate critical parts of the patient journey. These systems handle real-world conversations, support operational workflows, and help patients navigate care more efficiently.

As these agents become more autonomous and handle increasingly complex interactions, understanding how they behave in production becomes a critical product and business challenge.

We're hiring an AI Product Analyst to help us evaluate, monitor, and improve Voice AI systems operating at scale. You'll work at the intersection of Product, Engineering, Operations, and AI, helping the team understand how AI behaves in the real world, where it creates value, where it fails, and what should be improved next.

Why this role


Work on one of the most visible AI products inside MEDvidi.
Help shape the future of Voice AI in healthcare.
Influence product decisions using real production evidence.
High ownership in a fast-moving, product-driven medical tech company.


Responsibilities:


Analyze production behavior of Voice AI Agents and conversational AI workflows.
Investigate hallucinations, inconsistencies, silent failures, and quality degradation in AI-driven conversations.
Work directly with call transcripts, logs, generated outputs, and operational datasets to uncover patterns and actionable insights.
Design evaluation frameworks for measuring AI quality, reliability, and business impact.
Build monitoring systems and dashboards for AI performance visibility.
Measure the impact of AI systems on operational efficiency, business outcomes, and patient experience.
Detect quality shifts, anomalies, and emerging failure modes in production environments.
Partner closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Operations teams on AI initiatives.
Support rapid decision-making in fast-changing and ambiguous environments.


This role is not for you if


You prefer working only with structured datasets and predefined metrics.
You are uncomfortable analyzing raw conversations, transcripts, and AI-generated outputs.
You expect clearly defined answers rather than investigating ambiguous problems.
You are not interested in understanding how AI systems fail in production.


Requirements:


3+ years of experience in Product Analytics, Data Analytics, Operational Analytics, or analytics roles within complex production systems.
Strong SQL skills.
Python for analytical investigations and working with large-scale text datasets.
Understanding of LLM limitations, hallucinations, evaluation challenges, prompt sensitivity, and AI failure modes.
Experience building monitoring systems, analytical frameworks, or operational dashboards.
Strong communication skills and ability to translate analysis into product decisions.
Ability to work effectively in ambiguous and fast-changing environments.
Fluent Russian; English level B2 or higher.
Ability to work CET-overlapping hours.


Would be a plus


Experience with conversational AI or AI agents.
Experience evaluating LLM outputs.
Experience with AI quality metrics and evaluation methodologies.
Experience with prompt iteration and AI evaluation frameworks.
Experience working with ML pipelines or AI-powered products.


What we offer:


High-impact environment: A chance to influence how AI is used in real patient interactions.
Growth & compensation: Competitive compensation and clear growth opportunities.
Remote-first: Fully remote, long-term B2B collaboration.
Health & wellness: Health insurance after the probation period, plus sports & wellness compensation.
Career development: Career growth, including personalized English lessons via Preply.
Time off: 19 working days of vacation per year, 3 additional wellness days, and paid sick leave for the first 5 working days.
Culture: Thoughtful gifts for important life events.


Ready to make an impact? Send us your profile, let's build something meaningful together.

MEDvidi is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and contractors. All qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Title: Data Analytics Officer
Description:
About The Job


The Stress Testing Data Analytics (STDA) team belongs to the Produce Pillar of Models and Simulations for You (MS4U) department. The MS4U department focuses on several key missions: developing models (pillar 1 and pillar 2), conducting backtestings and simulation activities, producing regulatory stress testing exercises (European Banking Authority, European Central Bank), supporting Internal Capital Adequacy Assessment Process (ICAAP) and budget exercises, generating IFRS9 Expected Credit Loss (ECL) reports, preparing regulatory reporting, such as climate risk, Non-Performing Loan (NPL), and benchmarking Risk-Weighted Assets (RWA)/IFRS9, and performing local stress tests
The STDA team consists of data engineers and project managers working within the scope of credit risk and securitisation. STDA collects, analyses, reconciles, and builds databases to ensure the success of these exercises
The team works in a Big Data environment. Dataiku V14 streamlines collaborative development (in SQL, Pyspark) by allowing multiple team members to design, test, and deploy data workflows, while Power BI enables sharing actionable insights across departments
The team works in partnership with the IT department on the platform. They support the team on a daily-basis and help with back-end big data engineering support and maintenance
In this role, you will join the team dedicated to credit risk. Your primary responsibility will be to handle big data, perform data quality assessments, analyse risk parameters across multiple dimensions, report relevant insights based on data analysis, and prepare the databases used for the projection of credit risk parameters


Your Main Activities Are


Perform data collection and build/maintain reliable data transformation pipelines
Work on data ingestion, data quality, data preparation, data cleaning, and data analysis
Automate, optimise, and document the data preparation processes
Develop dynamic Dashboards to report on the most relevant and frequent business topics
Work closely with data providers and clients to get technical and business requirements
Specific contributions to regulatory and internal stress testing exercises


Profile and Skills to Success


Master’s Degree in Information Technology and Computer Science or related
Up to 2 years of experience in Data Analysis / Engineering / Visualisation or similar
Advanced level of English, both written and oral
Knowledge in data exploration and data preparation, SQL, Python, and Risk Management
Attention to detail / rigour
Ability to work with tight deadlines and multidisciplinary teams
Ability to collaborate / teamwork
Communication skills, both written and oral
Organisational skills


About The Team


The team named MS4U, which is a cross-functional platform, designed to provide integrated, end-to-end modelling and simulations capability. It unites RISK M&R (Models and Regulatory), STFS (Stress Testing and Financial Simulations), quantitative teams from RISK CPBS, RISK ESG (modelling), and other modelling competence centres, creating a shared, coherent, Group-wide modelling ecosystem
By joining MS4U team, you will be part of a dynamic, talented and expert team with an international reach

Title: RevOps Performance Analyst
Description:
About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:


Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.


What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:


A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment


Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:


You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time


This role is not a good fit for you if:


You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data


How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:


Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership


We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!


💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work


The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:


Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader


Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:


We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.


About Your Application


English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

About Pleo

Messy spend management is tricky business. And tedious processes are a lose-lose situation for all involved, not just finance. At Pleo, we're changing that. We build spend solutions that make managing money seamless, empowering, and surprisingly effective for finance teams and employees alike - with a vision to help all businesses ‘go beyond’.

The word ‘Pleo’ actually means ‘more than you’d expect’, and living by that mantra has been the secret to our success over the last 10 years.

Now, we’re at a pivotal moment in our journey; every move we make has a direct impact on our 40,000+ customers, our business, and our collective success. We need people who take pride in uncovering customer needs, who turn complex problems into simple solutions, challenge the way things are done (respectfully), and always aim high. With great ambitions driving us forward, we can’t say we’ve got this whole thing figured out. And frankly, that’s half the fun! What we can say is that we’re a driven, progressive, and, importantly, a kind bunch of 850+ people from over 100 nationalities, all committed to delivering the future of business spending, together.

About The Role

We're looking for a RevOps Performance Analyst to join our Revenue Operations team at Pleo. In this role, you'll help bridge the gap between raw data and strategic execution and be part of the GTM engine as we scale our automated spend management solutions across Europe. If you're excited about turning ambiguity into actionable insights and are passionate about FinTech and data-driven growth, then this is the opportunity for you!

Who You'll Be Working With And Reporting To

You'll report to our Manager, Revenue Operations and work closely with teams in Marketing, Sales and Customer Success. Our team of RevOps specialists is highly collaborative and dedicated to optimising the entire revenue lifecycle. You'll also have the chance to partner with teams across Data Engineering and Finance to ensure a single source of truth for all company-wide KPIs

What You'll Be Doing

As a RevOps Performance Analyst, you will:

  • Create holistic insights across the entire revenue funnel (Marketing, Sales, and Customer Success) to identify bottlenecks and conversion opportunities. Interpret ambiguous GTM questions and translate them into measurable metrics and analytical approaches.
  • Develop and maintain automated dashboards that act as the "Single Source of Truth" for GTM KPIs, including CAC, LTV, Net Revenue Retention (NRR), and pipeline velocity.
  • Challenge or refine requests when definitions, logic, or business relevance are unclear. Recommend improved metrics or analytical approaches when they better address the underlying business need.
  • Design analytics data models and tables to ensure data integrity across the tech stack (CRM, Billing, BI tools), ensuring all data is stored and transferred securely. Identify the correct system of record and reconcile discrepancies across sources. Partner with Data & Analytics when data engineering or architecture support is required.
  • Support senior management and our C-Level stakeholders with data-driven recommendations on resource allocation and GTM strategy; highlighting risks, trade-offs, and expected impact.
  • Build and continuously improve predictive models for sales forecasting and churn propensity to provide actionable forward-looking insights.
  • Analyse the impact of key variables in the sales process—such as discounting behaviours, lead routing efficiency, and promotion effectiveness—to drive operational excellence.

What You Bring

You'll thrive in this role if you have:

  • A solid understanding of SQL, data modeling and predictive statistical techniques
  • Strong communication skills and the ability to translate messy business questions into clean, measurable metrics
  • A passion for challenging the status quo and refining logic when business relevance is unclear
  • Excellent time management and the ability to prioritise high-impact tasks for senior leadership
  • Experience with SaaS metrics (NRR, Gross Margin, Magic Number)
  • A background in RevOps, Sales Ops or Strategic Finance within a high-growth environment

Why is this role a good fit for you

This role is a good fit for you if:

  • You love the detective work of finding out why a conversion rate dropped and proposing the fix
  • You enjoy being the bridge between technical data engineers and non-technical sales leaders
  • You want to see your analytical models directly influence the company's GTM strategy in real-time

This role is not a good fit for you if:

  • You prefer working on static reports rather than dynamic, evolving business problems
  • You are uncomfortable challenging stakeholders or senior management when the data tells a different story
  • You prefer a siloed environment where you don't have to worry about the upstream or downstream impact of data

How You'll Develop In This Role

In your first 6 months at Pleo, you'll:

  • Lead a full-funnel audit to drive impact in lead-to-close efficiency
  • Collaborate with data engineering to improve our underlying RevOps data architecture and dbt models
  • Grow your skills in executive presence, presenting quarterly performance deep-dives to our GTM leadership

We're committed to helping you develop your career, whether that means taking on larger strategic projects, stepping into a leadership track, or mastering advanced data engineering skills within the RevOps domain

Please note: You will need to be physically based in one of the locations listed on the advert with a valid right to work. We are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this role in any of our locations.

Show me the benefits!

  • 💳 Your own Pleo card (no more out-of-pocket spending!)
  • 🍜 Lunch is on us for your work days - enjoy catered meals or receive a lunch allowance based on your local office
  • 🏥 Comprehensive private healthcare - depending on your location, coverage options include Vitality, Alan or Médis
  • 🌴 We offer 25 days of holiday + your public holidays
  • 🏠 For our Team, we offer both hybrid and fully remote working options
  • 🏖️ Option to purchase 5 additional days of holiday through a salary sacrifice
  • ❤️‍🩹 We use MyndUp to give our employees access to free mental health and well-being support with great success so far
  • 👶 Paid parental leave - we want to make sure that we're supportive of families and help you feel that you don't have to compromise your family due to work

The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

  • Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Acquisition Partner to discuss the role and your background.
  • Hiring Manager Interview: A 45- minutes interview with the Hiring Manager to go deeper on your experience and how your profile can adapt to the role
  • Challenge and Team Interview: We will send you a take home test and invite you to present it during a 60 minute team interview. This is an opportunity to show us how you would handle the day to day of the role
  • Final Interview: Final conversation with a Senior Leader

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success!

Last time we hired for a similar role, we received a vast numbers of applications but only a few were selected for an intro call. With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

  • We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, :2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
  • Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
  • Highlight most important aspects of the role, points that might get misunderstood, any specific industry requirements etc.

About Your Application

  • English first. Since it's our company language, please submit your application in English. You’ll be using it a lot if you join us.
  • A fair look for everyone. Our talent team reads every single application to ensure the process is fair. To keep things running smoothly, we only accept applications through our system—our support team can’t pass on calls or emails.
  • Diversity drives us. We can only reach our goals if our team reflects the world around us. That starts with you hitting apply, even if you don't tick every single box. We encourage people from all backgrounds and experiences to join us.
  • Interview at your best. We want you to feel comfortable throughout the process. If you have any accessibility requirements or need a specific format, email belonging@pleo.io. We’ll design a process that works for you.
  • Your data is safe. When you apply, we process your personal data as a data processor. For more information on how Pleo processes personal data, read our Privacy Policy here.
  • Applying for multiple roles? Nothing is stopping you, and we assess every role independently. However, we do look for alignment, so make sure you can explain why your interest and experience are right for each specific role.
  • Reapplying. If you’re applying for the same role again, please wait six months from your last decision before hitting submit.

Title: Product Analyst
Description:
About Air Apps
At Air Apps, we believe in thinking bigger—and moving faster. We’re a family-founded company on a mission to create the world’s first AI-powered Personal & Entrepreneurial Resource Planner (PRP), and we need your passion and ambition to help us change how people plan, work, and live. Born in Lisbon, Portugal, in 2018—and now with offices in both Lisbon and San Francisco—we’ve remained self-funded while reaching over 100 million downloads worldwide.
Our long-term focus drives us to challenge the status quo every day, pushing the boundaries of AI-driven solutions that truly make a difference. Here, you’ll be a creative force, shaping products that empower people across the globe.
Join us on this journey to redefine resource management—and change lives along the way.
The Role
As a Product Analyst at Air Apps, you will analyze both internal and external products to identify potential new functionalities, uncover bottlenecks, and provide data-driven insights to enhance user experience. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams to interpret product performance, optimize features, and support strategic decision-making through actionable recommendations.
Responsibilities

Analyze product usage data to identify trends, friction points, and opportunities for improvement.
Evaluate competitor products to benchmark functionalities and propose innovative solutions.
Develop reports and dashboards to track key performance metrics.
Collaborate with product managers, designers, and engineers to enhance product features based on data insights.
Conduct A/B testing and experimentation to validate new functionalities and improve user engagement.
Provide actionable insights to support product roadmap decisions.
Identify and address bottlenecks in user flows and product performance.

Requirements

Around 3+ years of experience in product analytics, business intelligence, or a related field.
Strong analytical skills with experience in SQL, Python, or R for data analysis.
Proficiency with analytics tools (e.g., Google Analytics, Mixpanel, Amplitude).
Understanding of A/B testing methodologies and statistical analysis.
Experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Looker, Power BI).
Strong communication skills to present insights clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Ability to work in a fast-paced, data-driven environment.

What benefits are we offering?

Apple hardware ecosystem for work.
Annual Bonus
Top-tier Health and Life Insurance for peace of mind.
Transportation Budget to support your commute needs.
Coverflex benefits package for meal allowances, well-being, and more.
Childcare support.
Air Conference - an opportunity to meet the team, collaborate, and grow together.
Pension Fund to support your long-term financial planning.
Urban Sports Club membership to keep you active.
Meals 100% free at the hub.

Diversity & Inclusion
At Air Apps, we are committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We enthusiastically welcome applicants from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We celebrate diversity in all its forms and believe that varied voices and experiences make us stronger.
Application Disclaimer
At Air Apps, we value transparency and integrity in our hiring process. Applicants must submit their own work without any AI-generated assistance. Any use of AI in application materials, assessments, or interviews will result in disqualification.

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

Within the IT department of Natixis BPCESI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques), in Distribution et Data: We are seeking a detail-oriented and analytical Data Analyst to join our team. A strong background in data analysis, statistical methods, and data visualization is required. Work closely with various departments to gather data, analyze trends, and provide actionable insights to support business objectives.

Main Responsibilities


Gather and clean data from various sources, including databases, spreadsheets, and external APIs; maintain and update databases to ensure data integrity and accessibility.

Familiarity with statistical methods and data modeling techniques is a plus.

Strong analytical skills and attention to detail.

Title: Junior Healthcare Data Analyst
HTML:
Learn About Knok

At knok, we dare to lead and humanise the digital transformation of healthcare. We envision a world where everyone has timely access to quality healthcare through digital technology, creating a more equal society. We genuinely believe in it, and you can recognise it in every person who embraces this mission.

Through a Digital Front Door strategy, knok connects patients, providers and healthcare professionals in one place. Our API-first white-label platform enables a continuous, engaging and personalised healthcare experience for all conditions through a cutting-edge Patient Journey Engine.

With regular clinical practice as our main source of knowledge, we leverage ready-to-use data to improve care automation and increase financial savings. Since 2015, we have enabled more than 2.5 million clinical interactions in over 12 countries. Our platform is scalable and AI-ready, enhancing the power of data-driven care to deliver better outcomes during all stages of life.

Are you ready to join us in revolutionising healthcare and making a tangible impact on people's lives?

About The Role

We are looking for a Junior Healthcare Data Analyst to support our teams in turning complex healthcare data into meaningful insights. You'll be working with datasets from different sources, such as clinical operations, insurance processing, and patient journeys - helping us improve care delivery and decision-making.

If you're passionate about using data to make healthcare more accessible and effective, don't stop here - dive deeper!

As an Junior Healthcare Data Analyst, you will:

  • Collect, clean, and analyse healthcare data from multiple sources (e.g. EHR, patient demographics, operational systems), to extract meaningful insights;
  • Develop and maintain dashboards, reports, and visualisations to communicate key metrics and findings to stakeholders, including clinicians, operational teams and leadership team;
  • Collaborate cross-functionally with teams across the organisation, including data science, product management, and clinical operations, to support data-driven decision-making;
  • Perform statistical analysis to support population health management, risk stratification, and clinical outcome optimisation;
  • Contribute to improving data quality by identifying data quality issues and anomalies, and work with relevant stakeholders to address and resolve them

What Makes You a Great Fit For This Journey

  • Bachelor's degree in Biomedical Engineering, Medical Statistics, Biomedical Sciences, Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Health Informatics, or a related field. Master's degree preferred;
  • Experience (academic or professional) with data visualisation tools such as Tableau, Power BI or similar;
  • Technical expertise regarding data models, database design development, data mining and segmentation techniques;
  • Ability to turn complex data into clear insights that support better decision-making;
  • Knowledge of programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis and statistical modeling;
  • Ability to explain a dashboard or an analysis to someone without a technical background, in a simple and practical way;
  • Care when working with data to ensure accuracy, consistency and reliability;
  • Ability to manage several analytical tasks at the same time, prioritising what has the greatest impact on the business and patients

Nice to have:

  • Experience with SQL;
  • Experience with Apache Superset;
  • Previous experience or exposure to the healthcare sector

Recruitment stages

  • People Interview: A conversation to get to know you better, explore your background and motivation, and introduce you to knok, our culture, and the role.
  • Case Study: A practical exercise designed to understand how you approach data, structure your analysis, and turn information into meaningful insights.
  • Final Interview: A conversation with the Hiring Manager where you'll present your case study, explain your reasoning, and discuss your approach in more detail

Title: Business Data Analyst (Maintenance)
Description:
Imagine your career taking you to the depths of innovation and the heights of impact. Our people enable continuous progress. Their commitment, collective expertise, and unique capabilities are the engine room behind SBM Offshore’s True. Blue. Transition. - shaping the future of energy, and beyond.

About Us:

SBM Offshore is a global leader in deepwater ocean infrastructure, delivering floating production solutions across the full asset lifecycle—from design and construction to installation and operation. Supported by a global team of more than 8,000 professionals, the Company operates a long-term, asset-backed business model that delivers high-availability assets and predictable cash flows. SBM Offshore combines engineering expertise, operational reliability, and selective innovation to support safe, efficient, and lower-carbon energy production, while extending its capabilities into new opportunities across the blue economy.

Purpose



As a Business Data Analyst, you analyze and interpret complex data to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development. Work closely with stakeholders to identify data needs, create reports, and develop data models that drive business performance and optimize operational efficiency. Ensure data accuracy and contribute to the continuous improvement of data processes and tools.



Responsibilities



Analyze and interpret complex data sets to provide actionable insights that support business decision-making and strategy development.
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to identify business needs and data requirements, ensuring alignment with organizational goals and objectives.
Develop and maintain data models, dashboards, and reports, providing clear and concise visualizations that communicate key findings to stakeholders.
Ensure data accuracy and integrity by performing data validation, cleansing, and quality checks, maintaining high standards of data governance.
Extract, transform, and load (ETL) data from various sources into analytical tools, ensuring data is prepared and structured for analysis.
Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies within data sets, providing insights that drive business process improvements and operational efficiency.
Support the development and implementation of data-driven strategies, working closely with business units to optimize performance and achieve key objectives.
Present findings and recommendations to senior management and stakeholders, translating complex data insights into understandable and actionable business terms.
Stay current with industry trends and emerging technologies in data analytics, integrating new tools and methodologies to enhance analytical capabilities.
Provide training and support to team members and other departments on data analysis techniques and the use of analytical tools, fostering a data-driven culture within the organization.



Education



Bachelor's degree in data science, business analytics, computer science, statistics, or a related field is required. Certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are highly recommended. Proficiency in data analysis, statistical tools, and business intelligence (BI) platforms is essential. A master’s degree in a related field is preferred but not mandatory.



Experience



Minimum of 5 years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related field, with demonstrated expertise in analyzing business data to support decision-making processes.
Proven experience in collecting, cleaning, and analyzing large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and insights that drive business performance.
Strong technical background with hands-on experience in using data analysis tools and languages such as SQL, Python, R, or Excel, and proficiency in business intelligence platforms like Power BI, Tableau, or Qlik.
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement data models, reports, and dashboards that provide actionable insights to stakeholders across the organization.
Experience in working closely with business units to understand their data needs, translating business requirements into data-driven solutions that support strategic goals.
Proficiency in data visualization techniques, with the ability to present complex data in a clear and compelling manner to both technical and non-technical audiences.
Knowledge of data governance, data quality management, and best practices for ensuring data integrity and accuracy across systems.
Strong problem-solving and analytical skills, with the ability to identify data-related issues and recommend effective solutions to improve business processes.
Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams, including IT, finance, and operations, to support data-driven initiatives.
Relevant certifications such as Certified Business Analysis Professional (CBAP), Microsoft Certified: Data Analyst Associate, or Certified Analytics Professional (CAP) are preferred.



Functional Competencies

Compliance

Governance, Risk and Control

Analytics and reporting

IT Tools and application

Cost and budget control

Business Partnering

Digital savvy

Business Acumen

Contract Management

Management of change application

GENERAL INFORMATION

SBM Offshore N.V. is a listed holding company that is headquartered in Amsterdam. It holds direct and indirect interests in other companies that collectively with SBM Offshore N.V. form the SBM Offshore Group (“the Company”). For further information, please visit our website at www.sbmoffshore.com. The companies in which SBM Offshore N.V., directly and indirectly, owns investments are separate entities.

SBM Offshore is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. SBM Offshore does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, non-disqualifying physical or mental disability, national origin, veteran status, or any other basis covered by appropriate law. All employment is decided on the basis of qualifications, merit, and business need.

Title: Data Analyst - Finance (m/f/d)
HTML:
Chemical Industry | Data Analyst – Finance


Your new Company


Elementis, a Global Specialty Chemicals company with a heritage dating back over 175 years, employs around 1 000 people and operates across multiple continents, serving customers worldwide. Specializing in advanced materials and formulation technologies, Elementis delivers high-performance solutions across personal care, coatings, and industrial and consumer applications.


Elementis’ diverse teams collaborate seamlessly across geographies and functions, combining scientific expertise with a strong culture of innovation, integrity, and sustainability to deliver outstanding value to their customers.


Your new Role


The Data Analyst – Finance transforms complex Datasets into clear, actionable insights that support decision making across the organization. Working within a matrix structure and closely aligned with Finance, this person partners with business stakeholders to understand priorities, interpret financial and operational Data, and deliver high-quality analysis, reporting, dashboards, and presentations.


This person reports to the Business Data Manager, and will collaborate closely with the Finance, Business Leaders, Technical Specialists, and Data Governance teams to support planning cycles, improve reporting capabilities, and strengthen Data-driven decision making across the business.


The Data Analyst – Finance will:

  • Partner with Finance stakeholders to understand business priorities and deliver Data-driven insights that support operational and strategic decision-making;
  • Produce accurate and timely management reporting, analyzing financial performance, identifying variances, trends, risks, and opportunities against plans and forecasts;
  • Support planning, budgeting, forecasting, CAPEX submissions, and actuals-to-plan reconciliations, ensuring Data accuracy and consistency across business systems;
  • Manage provisions, accruals, and financial Data, ensuring information integrity, compliance with Data governance standards, and the reliability of ERP and reporting system outputs;
  • Act as a subject matter expert in key Finance areas (including cost accounting, CAPEX, pricing and margins, fixed costs, working capital, and operational finance);
  • Develop, maintain, and enhance Power BI dashboards, reports, and visualizations to improve business visibility, performance monitoring, and decision-making;
  • Promote self-service reporting capabilities through training, user support, and best-practice guidance on Power BI solutions and planning tools;
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams to strengthen analytical capabilities, optimize reporting processes, and improve Data foundations across the organization;
  • Support business projects, process improvements, and automation initiatives that drive efficiency, performance, and continuous improvement.


A typical day will include analyzing financial performance, maintaining dashboards, supporting planning and forecasting activities, collaborating with Finance and business stakeholders, validating Data quality, and delivering insights that support key business decisions.


Please consider that this role requires availability for occasional travel to other company sites.


What you will need to succeed

As a Data Analyst – Finance, you will need:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field;
  • Professional Accounting Qualification (would be a plus);
  • +3 years of experience within International Manufacturing, Industrial, or Global Business environments.
  • +3 years of experience in Financial Analysis, Finance Support, or other analytical Finance-related roles.
  • Proven experience supporting Business Stakeholders through Financial Analysis, Performance Monitoring, and Data-Driven Decision-Making;
  • Experience developing and maintaining Power BI Dashboards, Reports, and Data Visualizations for Business Performance and Management Reporting;
  • Experience working with ERP systems, large business Datasets, and Data Governance practices to ensure Data Integrity and Reporting Accuracy;
  • Experience working within Matrix Organizations and collaborating with Cross-Functional Teams would be advantageous;
  • Experience in Budgeting, Forecasting, Financial Planning, Variance Analysis, Accruals, Reconciliations, CAPEX, Cost Accounting, Pricing & Margins, Fixed Costs, Working Capital, and Operational Finance;
  • Advanced Excel skills (including Pivot Tables, Complex Data Analysis, and Financial Modelling);
  • Knowledge of Python and/or SQL (would be a plus);
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outputs in a fast-paced international environment;
  • Excellent communication skills – Fluency in English.


What the Company can offer you


Have the opportunity to join a cross-functional team in an international company with a multicultural working environment!


Next Steps


If you are interested in this opportunity, please send us your updated CV. If you are looking for another type of professional challenge, please contact us to discuss other career opportunities, always in complete confidence.

Title: Finance Data & Performance Analyst
Description:
About Unilabs

Headquartered in Geneva and part of the A.P. Moller Group, Unilabs is one of Europe's leading medical diagnostics companies, offering a complete range of laboratory, pathology, genetics, and imaging services to patients across 14 countries. Unilabs invests heavily in technology, equipment, and people - using digital technologies in its state-of-the-art laboratories and imaging institutes - to improve the lives of close to 100 million people every year.

About The Role

To support Unilabs Switzerland Finance in evolving beyond reporting, we are looking for a Finance Data & Performance Analyst to join our Controlling team. This role combines financial reporting, data analytics and process improvement, helping our Controllers focus on value-added analysis, business partnering and finance transformation. The successful candidate will progressively take ownership of selected reporting and planning activities currently performed in Switzerland, while helping improve, standardize and automate them over time.

We are looking for someone who enjoys building sustainable Finance and data solutions, not just fixing individual issues. Success in this role comes from creating scalable processes, trusted data and long-term efficiency gains for the Controlling team.

What You Will Do


Own and improve recurring reporting:


Prepare and maintain financial and operational reporting packages
Support monthly closing, forecasting and budgeting activities
Produce KPI dashboards and performance analyses
Perform variance analyses and investigate unexpected trends
Take ownership of selected recurring reporting activities currently performed by the Swiss Controlling team



Build sustainable data & automation solutions


Develop and enhance Power BI dashboards and reporting tools
Design and implement scalable reporting, automation and data-management solutions
Build standardized datasets, reporting models and analytical tools that can be maintained and used by the wider Finance team
Reduce manual work through simplification, standardization and automation
Promote harmonization of data definitions, reporting logic and performance metrics across Finance, HR and Operations
Ensure solutions are robust, documented and sustainable over time rather than dependent on manual workarounds or individual knowledge



Improve data quality and processes


Investigate data quality and reconciliation issues
Identify root causes of recurring problems and implement sustainable corrective actions
Support alignment between Finance, HR and Operations data sources
Improve reporting governance, documentation and process ownership
Contribute to continuous improvement and finance transformation initiatives



Support business performance analyses


Prepare ad hoc analyses for Finance and Operations teams
Support business cases, productivity initiatives and performance reviews
Help transform data into actionable insights that support decision-making



Requirements

What we are looking for


Bachelor's or Master's degree in Finance, Business Analytics, Data Analytics, Engineer, or related field
3-7 years experience in FP&A, Business Analytics, Data Analytics or Process Improvement roles
Demonstrated experience improving or redesigning reporting, planning or data processes in a structured and sustainable manner
Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail
Advanced Excel and PowerBI skills
Experience with data aggregation & harmonization (via PowerQuery, Knime, Alteryx...)



Nice to have


SQL and/or Python
Experience with ERP and planning systems (D365 or similar)



Who You Are


Curious and proactive
Comfortable working with large datasets
Interested in solving problems and improving processes
Able to translate data into actionable insights
Focused on building long-term solutions rather than temporary fixes
Looking to grow at the intersection of Finance, Data and Business Performance
Pragmatic enough to deliver today's reporting requirements while continuously improving tomorrow's processes



What Success Looks Like After 18 Months


You will have:


Taken ownership of a significant portion of recurring reporting activities previously performed in Switzerland
Reduced manual effort through automation and process improvements
Implemented reporting and data-management solutions that are standardized, documented and sustainable
Improved consistency and harmonization of Finance, HR and Operations data
Developed reporting and analytical tools actively used by the Controlling team
Helped create a Controlling environment that is less dependent on individuals and more supported by robust processes, governance and scalable data solutions
Enabled senior Controllers to dedicate more time to business partnering, performance analysis and strategic initiatives



Benefits


Hybrid working model (office & remote flexibility)
Opportunity to work on Swiss-market healthcare and laboratory platforms with real clinical impact
International, collaborative, and regulated product environment
Competitive compensation and benefits
Long-term ownership of a strategic healthcare product


Why join us?

This is not a traditional reporting role.

You will progressively take ownership of reporting activities while helping automate and simplify them. Your success will be measured not only by the quality of the reporting you deliver, but also by the efficiency improvements and analytical capabilities you enable across the Controlling team.

You will work closely with experienced Controllers in Switzerland and gain exposure to budgeting, forecasting, performance management, business partnering and finance transformation initiatives.

Description:
Company Description

Natixis in Portugal is a Centre of Expertise whose mission is to transform traditional banking by developing innovative solutions for the business, operations and work culture of Groupe BPCE worldwide.

As part of Groupe BPCE’s international division, Natixis in Portugal designs and delivers solutions for its two core areas — Corporate & Investment Banking and Asset & Wealth Management — as well as transversal services that support all entities across the Group.

With more than 3,000 employees representing 46 nationalities, the teams work across Information Technology, Banking Support Activities, and Compliance, in an integrated, inclusive, and cross-functional way, supporting all business lines and platforms of the Group.

A disruptive mindset and a culture of proximity and agility identify Natixis in Portugal Team and reflect the company's mission to transform traditional banking at a global scale: a perfect match in the Portuguese dynamics and entrepreneurial ecosystem.

Job Description

Natixis in Portugal is currently seeking a Senior Data Business Analyst (French Speaker) | BPCE-SI to join its BPCE SI (BPCE Solutions Informatiques) team, within the IT (Information Technologies) department, to work in a hybrid work model in the Porto office, to join a data team.

In this role, you will bridge the gap between business requirements and our Data teams (Data Engineers, Data Analysts). To succeed in this mission, you will not just gather requirements: you will actively dive into the data by writing queries and analyzing our Oracle database tables to understand their structure, quality, and underlying logic.

Key Responsibilities


Write SQL queries to directly query and analyze tables within our database.
Explore and profile raw data to understand its structure, underlying business rules, and to identify potential anomalies.
Work closely with Data teams (Data Engineers, BI, and Analytics) to translate functional business rules into technical requirements.
Draft clear functional and technical specifications (source-to-target data mapping).
Assist business stakeholders in defining their requirements by providing a realistic view of the data actually available in the Oracle systems.
Design and execute test plans (both functional and technical data reconciliation).


Qualifications


Proficiency in SQL (Essential): Strong ability to write complex queries (JOINs, subqueries, analytical functions, etc.) to query databases.
5+ years of solid experience as business analyst.
Oracle Environment: Proven experience working with Oracle databases (using tools such as PL/SQL Developer, TOAD, DBeaver, or SQL Developer).
Data Analysis: Ability to analyze data models (tables, views, primary/foreign keys).
Data Modeling: Basic understanding of data architecture concepts (Data Warehouse, Data Marts).
French: Minimum C1 level (fluent/advanced) is required, as you will interact closely with French-speaking business stakeholders and write functional specifications in French. A good level of English is also required.


We will only consider CVs in English.

Additional Information

Our workplace reflects the vibrant spirit of our locations, with initiatives such as a Green Transportation Budget, electric bikes and a flexible Hybrid Work Policy. We promote wellbeing through the Honolulu Wellness Club, a Prayer Room, a Lactation Room, and themed Villages that inspire creativity and collaboration. Through our ESG and DEI strategies, we are committed to being inclusive, caring, and fair, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.

Applications: open from May 2026

Receiving regular feedback to guide your development

To have graduated in 2025, 2026, or 2027
Impressive Python and SQL skills
A solid foundation in maths and statistics
